description: We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters. Ford’s Electric Vehicles, Digital and Design (EVDD) team is charged with delivering the company’s vision of a fully electric transportation future. EVDD is customer-obsessed, entrepreneurial, and data-driven and is dedicated to delivering industry-leading customer experience for electric vehicle buyers and owners. You’ll join an agile team of doers pioneering our EV future by working collaboratively, staying focused on only what matters, and delivering excellence day in and day out. Join us to make positive change by helping build a better world where every person is free to move and pursue their dreams. In this position... The global supply chain behind UEV must be as innovative as the platform itself. As Global Supply Manager, you’ll own the end-to-end sourcing strategy for critical vehicle spend. You’ll partner with engineering from concept through launch, using first-principles decision-making to deliver breakthrough outcomes. You will lead global supplier negotiations and structure commercial agreements that protect program timing without sacrificing cost leverage. You’ll also play a central role in one of the most complex challenges facing the industry today: designing a supply chain that is resilient to geopolitical risk and compliant with a rapidly evolving global trade and tariff environment. What you'll do... Own end-to-end sourcing strategy for critical spend areas across the UEV platform and follow-on advanced EV programs from sourcing strategy development through SOP, including supplier selection, contracting, and ongoing cost, quality, and delivery performance. Partner with engineering from concept through launch to align sourcing strategy with technical roadmaps, design freeze milestones, and prototype-to-production transitions. Structure commercial agreements that protect program timing without ceding cost leverage. Build first-principles should-cost models with cross-functional teams to drive a ground-up, physics-based part and system cost perspective. Use these models to set negotiation positions, evaluate quote submissions, and challenge supplier pricing line by line. Lead make-vs-buy analysis to ensure we have a best-in-class supply chain that delivers optimal value. Develop the supply base for resilience. Identify and qualify Tier 1 and Tier 2 partners across geographies; build dual-source and regional capacity strategies that address raw material scarcity, geopolitical risk, and an evolving global trade and tariff environment. Drive automation across the supply chain to deliver best-in-class supply chain efficiency. Partner with suppliers to identify opportunities for process automation and robotics. Shape the tools and processes the ADVEV supply chain runs on, including should-cost methodology, supplier and agreement management systems, and AI-enabled analytics that scale how Ford evaluates suppliers, parts, and agreements. You'll have... Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, Operations Management or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience. 5+ years of experience in supply chain management or commodity management. Experience bringing creative negotiation skills and out-of-the-box strategy. Strong relationship management skills with internal and external stakeholders. Even better, you may have... Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, or related field, or MBA. Hands-on experience building and launching highly effective supply chains. Strong written and verbal communication skills. An eagerness to work cross-functionally in a dynamic environment where you are part of a high performing team. A systems approach to design and development with the desire and curiosity to strive for exceptional delivery execution and continuous improvement. Eagerness to expand into new commodity areas as the ADVEV portfolio grows. description: About ITT ITT Inc. description: What You’ll Do The Procurement Associate supports the sourcing and purchasing of materials, equipment, and services critical to pharmaceutical manufacturing and business operations. What We’re Looking For Experience • 0–3 years of procurement, purchasing, or supply chain experience in a manufacturing or cGMP-regulated environment preferred. • Experience working with ERP systems such as SYSPRO, SAP, Oracle, or similar platforms is a plus. • Prior experience coordinating with suppliers, warehouses, and cross-functional stakeholders preferred. Education • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline required. description: About Vantage Data Centers Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands. Procurement Department The team leads these efforts from conception through commissioning, working with Sales, Operations, New Site Development, and Engineering along the way. Procurement also works closely with vendor partners to come up with a vertically integrated design, and we manage these partners to deliver the projects on schedule and budget. One thing that distinguishes Vantage is that our technical staff is given the responsibility and authority to directly drive the process. When compared to external resources, our internal team can align long-term operational sustainability with value engineering and cost metrics to deliver products aligned with corporate goals. This approach empowers each member of the team to drive high- impact decisions and even more impactful results. Position Overview This position will be based on-site at our office in Ashburn, VA in alignment with our flexible work policy (3 days on site required, 2 days flexible). Vantage is looking for a self-starter in the role of a Senior Procurement Analyst to be part of a team that manages OFCI Equipment, which is the second largest individual cost within the construction process, and to become engaged in the supply chain aspects of our Data Centers. In this role, you will be responsible for record keeping, assist in obtaining vendors submittals, maintaining product specifications, working with vendors, working with the Procurement team to ensure specifications are adhered to in accordance to our company process, monitor and managing contracts, prepare status and tracking reports for the company, support the Procurement Managers and Senior Director in their daily tasks. Regular collaboration and coordination are required with our supply chain partners and internal teams such as Engineering, Operations, Legal, as well as multiple Construction Management Teams. Travel will be necessary to various factories for factory witness testing, audits, and on-boarding of new vendors. Minimal travel to Vantage Data Center sites may also be required occasionally. Essential Job Functions The individual will be continuously working with the procurement team to provide the daily assistance needed to ensure the department meets and exceeds its goals with the company. Individual will be a self-starter and with the ability to manage and assist multiple single line diagrams, product specifications and driving OFCI Equipment submittals to closure (approval). Successful candidate will understand RFIs and RFQs for the sourcing of equipment for low voltage switchgear, medium switchgear, transformers, electrical skids, CRAH’s, chillers, generators, UPS’s and other data center equipment systems as needed. Coordinate with vendors on continuous quality improvement. Manage and track equipment status with the vendors such that all scheduled dates set by the construction schedules are met. Analyze and negotiate vendor quotes, change orders and back charges. Learn and manage the financial software to enter PO’s, review invoices, track budgets, allocate equipment from purchase to the projects. Support Procurement Managers and Finance / Accounting with invoicing issues. Drive project-level tasks and milestones assigned by the project management team. Coordinates with vendors for scheduling start-up and commissioning support services from the vendors Maintain and develop supplier relationships. Help develop and maintain record keeping and reports for the business. Continue to work and help refine the procurement processes to make sure they are complying and efficient. Work with compliance to maintain the department and vendors are within guidelines. Work with operational personnel of the Vantage buildings to ensure the proper spare parts and service programs are properly in place and assist with their database. Continue safety evaluations with vendors and project sites to make compliance is met. Senior Analyst should be able to manage the full OFCI equipment package on a VDC development project with minimal support/assistance from a Procurement Manager. Duties Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure clarity of the specifications and operational requirements. Work with finance and compliance to ensure all purchases have appropriately been costed to a project. Help coordinate the approval and release of the necessary equipment per construction schedule. Continue to investigate and work with vendors to make sure their products are best suited for Vantage. Support open and transparent communication with project teams for project delivery success. Negotiate complex requests for equipment and services from suppliers and subcontractors. Manage equipment inventory planning efforts and forecasting. Additional Duties as assigned by Management. Job Requirements Bachelor of Science in engineering, construction science, supply chain management, logistics, business administration, or related field or equivalent experience, is required. 3+ years of experience in a supply chain or construction role is required. Data Center, commercial, or industrial equipment experience is strongly preferred. Ability to learn quickly and drive things to closure. Strong business acumen with a strong commercial background. Knowledge of sourcing and procurement techniques. Travel is expected to be up to 10% but may increase over time as the business evolves. Additional Details Salary Range: $95,000-105,000 Base + Bonus (this range is based on Virginia market data and may vary in other locations) This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community. Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To: Our Buyer Sr. will ensure program requirements are appropriately prioritized and executed to meet the needs Blue Origin. Strong analytical skills, data driven with experience in establishing and tracking program metrics Create and maintain systems and processes to streamline operations. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Conduct spend analysis, supplier evaluations, market research, and benchmarking to identify sourcing opportunities. Partner closely with Operations, Finance, Legal, and business leaders to align procurement activities with organizational goals. Lead cross-functional sourcing initiatives and facilitate stakeholder alignment throughout the procurement process. Represent Procurement in strategic projects and transformation initiatives across US and European markets. Develop and deliver training, guidance, and best practices to support procurement process adoption and compliance. Required Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field required. Experience: 5+ years of progressive procurement and strategic sourcing experience, including category management, supplier negotiations, competitive sourcing events, contract management, and stakeholder engagement. Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and a proactive approach to problem solving. Comfortable managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills. Effective communicator with the ability to build relationships across Procurement, Finance, Legal, and business teams. Droisys believes in diversity, inclusion, and belonging, and we are committed to fostering a diverse work environment

description: Job Summary The Procurement Manager, Major Projects will serve as the primary Procurement partner for major generation and transmission capital projects. This role works closely with Project Management, Engineering, Construction, Supply Chain, Sourcing, Contracts, and Project Controls to develop and execute an integrated procurement plan that supports project timelines, supplier capacity, material availability, and overall project delivery. The role is a senior individual contributor and requires strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to drive results across a matrixed organization without direct authority. Key Responsibilities Lead and maintain integrated procurement plans aligned with project schedules and milestones. Coordinate procurement activities across materials, equipment, services, construction, sourcing, and contracting. Strong experience with procurement, contracting, supplier management, supply markets, lead times, and delivery assurance. Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives without direct authority. Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, problem-solving, and executive communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with utility, generation, transmission, EPC, or infrastructure capital projects. Knowledge of project controls, critical path scheduling, commissioning, and construction sequencing. Experience managing procurement risks for $100M+ capital projects. PMP, CPSM, CPSD, SCM, or similar certification. Experience working in matrixed and portfolio-based organizations.

job_title: Head of Procurement and Supply Chain (Located in the US)
description: The Head of Procurement & Supply Chain will oversee and direct all sourcing, procurement, and supply chain activities for Gilbert's compounding pharmacy network. This position plays a vital role in maintaining a consistent supply of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), compounding materials, packaging materials, and other essential supplies needed for both 503A (patient-specific compounding) and 503B (outsourcing facility) operations. Reporting to the Director of Pharmacy Development & Operations, you'll develop vendor partnerships, negotiate agreements, manage inventory systems, and ensure compliance with FDA, USP, and cGMP standards for efficient and compliant pharmacy operations. Key Responsibilities Strategic Procurement & Vendor Management Develop and implement comprehensive procurement strategies for APIs, excipients, and compounding materials that ensure quality, compliance, cost-effectiveness, and supply continuity. Establish and maintain relationships with FDA-registered API suppliers, ensuring all materials meet USP/NF standards and cGMP requirements. Negotiate contracts, pricing, and terms with suppliers while maintaining quality standards and regulatory compliance. Build redundancy in the supply chain with qualified backup vendors for critical materials. Manage vendor qualification, audits, and ongoing performance evaluation programs. API & Raw Material Sourcing Source and procure Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) from FDA-registered suppliers with appropriate Drug Master Files (DMFs). Ensure all APIs are accompanied by Certificates of Analysis (CoA) and meet compendial specifications. Manage procurement of excipients, preservatives, stabilizers, and other compounding ingredients. Coordinate with Quality Assurance on material testing and release procedures. Maintain current knowledge of API availability, market conditions, and alternative sources. 503A & 503B Compliance Materials Procure all materials necessary for regulatory compliance including environmental monitoring supplies (air sampling, surface testing), cleanroom supplies (garments, gloves, disinfectants), quality control testing materials and reference standards, sterility testing supplies and media, and endotoxin testing materials. Ensure all materials meet requirements for sterile and non-sterile compounding environments. Maintain documentation supporting regulatory inspections (FDA, state boards of pharmacy). Equipment, Packaging & Fulfillment Materials Source and procure compounding equipment (balances, hoods, autoclaves, ovens, etc.) and laboratory equipment for quality testing. Manage procurement of facility infrastructure materials for ISO-classified cleanrooms, including HVAC filters and environmental controls. Procure primary packaging (vials, syringes, bottles, jars) and secondary packaging materials (boxes, labels, shipping containers) that meet FDA and USP container closure requirements. Coordinate with fulfillment operations on shipping supplies, cold chain packaging, and temperature monitoring devices. Inventory & Supply Chain Management Develop and maintain inventory management systems for APIs, excipients, and supplies. Implement just-in-time and safety stock strategies balancing carrying costs with supply security. Monitor expiration dates and coordinate material rotation with pharmacy operations. Establish KPIs for inventory turnover, stock-out prevention, and cost management. Implement ERP or inventory management software systems. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Team Leadership Partner with Quality Assurance on vendor qualification, material specifications, and CoA review. Collaborate with Compounding Operations to forecast material needs and prevent production delays. Work with Regulatory Affairs to ensure procurement practices support licensure and inspections. Build and lead a procurement and supply chain team; develop SOPs for all procurement activities. Foster a culture of compliance, quality, and continuous improvement. Requirements 7+ years of progressive procurement and supply chain experience with at least 5 years in pharmaceutical manufacturing, compounding, or related healthcare industry. Direct experience with 503A and/or 503B compounding pharmacy operations strongly preferred. Deep understanding of FDA regulations for 503A and 503B compounding pharmacies, USP Chapters <795>, <797>, and <800> requirements, and cGMP for pharmaceutical manufacturing. Experience with API sourcing from FDA-registered suppliers and pharmaceutical raw material procurement. Knowledge of sterile compounding, aseptic processing, cleanroom operations, and pharmaceutical quality systems. Strong negotiation and contract management skills with proven vendor relationship management abilities. Proficiency with ERP systems, inventory management software, and procurement platforms. Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Pharmacy, or related field required. Preferred Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) Pharmacy Technician Certification (CPhT). Experience working within a startup or high-growth healthcare company. Existing relationships with API suppliers and pharmaceutical material vendors. What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months) Qualified vendor network established for APIs, excipients, and all critical materials with backup suppliers in place. Inventory management system implemented with zero stock-outs impacting production. All materials sourced meet FDA, USP, and cGMP requirements with full documentation supporting regulatory inspections. Cost savings achieved through strategic sourcing and contract negotiations without compromising quality. Strong collaborative partnerships established with Quality Assurance, Operations, and Regulatory Affairs teams. Standardized procurement SOPs documented and team trained on compliance requirements. Benefits Open to discussion

Initiate & Lead the supplier and product qualification process. Benchmark vendors to identify the opportunities to improve competitive pricing of each project scope. description:
**Company Description**

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. We leverage the latest advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software-defined networking to provide our clients with a competitive edge in an increasingly interconnected world. Our solutions are designed to not only meet the current demands of the digital landscape but to also anticipate and adapt to future challenges.

At Arista we value the diversity of thought and perspectives that each employee brings to the table. We believe that fostering an inclusive environment, where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome, is essential for driving creativity and innovation.

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as Best Engineering Team, Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest standards of quality and performance in everything we do.

**Job Description**

**Who You’ll Work With**

The Commodity Manager is responsible to develop Arista’s commodity strategies for **Thermal / Heat Sinks** (experience with Front end Power Supplies is a plus) in order to drive time to market, continuity of supply and meet cost reduction initiatives. You'll work across the supply chain to support operations and will be collaborating closely with Engineering on sourcing strategies.

The role will require the individual to be familiar with the complete range of strategic sourcing activities. This includes the analysis of spend, the formulation of and implementation of commodity strategies, the negotiation of contracts and the ongoing management of strategic supplier relationships.

**What You’ll Do**

* Creates, implements, and maintains sourcing strategies for assigned commodities to support company requirements.
* Undertakes spend analysis, supplier assessment and supplier selection to agreed processes.
* Develops and implements commodity strategies in line with company and manufacturing initiatives to improve supply chain efficiencies and reduce the total cost of supply chain management.
* Builds cost models (TAC/should cost) to validate commodity strategies and to understand cost drivers.
* Coordinates all activities with Engineering, NPI, and suppliers to ensure the selection of parts with long lifetimes and solid supply availability.
* Working with the site supply chain leads, this individual will manage relationships with suppliers on behalf of Arista.
* Develops a robust commodity supply base which creates and sustains a competitive advantage for Arista, utilizing global markets, leveraging spend, and best in class technologies.
* Monitors/reports on priority projects and savings.
* Ensures that agreed strategic sourcing targets for cost reduction are met in the commodity portfolio. This includes responsibility for meeting improvement plan targets and year on year cost reductions.
* Provides support to NPI teams as required to meet target costs and establish program cost models.
* Negotiations and management of cost models for suppliers to include "hard" money (such as price, volume discounts, etc.) and "soft" money (such as expertise, technical backup, etc.) in the context of Total Acquisition Cost (TAC) and Total Opportunity Cost (TOC).
* Identification and delivery of opportunities for cost reduction.
* Provides input for annual and long-term savings targets.
* Trains/Mentors junior supply chain personnel on strategic sourcing process.
* Ensures appropriate performance measure (Technology, Quality, Cost and Delivery) of supply base and feedback of results.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Operations or Engineering required; Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum 10 years’ experience in a networking environment (preferred), electronics or electrical, purchasing, commodity management and materials management positions. CPIM, CIRM, and/or C.P.M. desired.
* Excellent Program and Project Management Skills.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and Process Variation Reduction (Six Sigma) concepts and tool sets as they relate to materials management.
* Utilize strong team building abilities to lead cross-functional process improvement teams and lead change within the organization. Ability to coordinate cross-site, multi-functional objectives.
* Ability to interface and positively influence at all levels through excellent communication skills.
* Understanding of assigned commodities, materials, and manufacturing processes.
* Strong PC application skills. Including complement of Microsoft Office Software, with strong capabilities in Project and Access.

**Compensation Information:**

The new hire base pay for this role has a salary range of $142,000 to $188,000.

Arista

Description:

**Job Summary:**

The Buyer is responsible for managing the procurement of assigned materials and services necessary for the company's operations. This involves ensuring the efficient flow of materials within the supply chain, maintaining inventory levels, managing supplier performance, and building strong relationships with suppliers. Effective communication with various departments such as production, receiving, quality, accounting, logistics, and engineering is crucial to fulfill customer orders and meet production needs.

**Essential Functions:**

* Plan and organize assigned purchased materials and services according to product build requirements and MRP recommendations. Experience with Syspro a plus.
* Source assigned materials, components, and services for production and operations, and identify alternate suppliers when current sources cannot meet cost, quality, or delivery requirements.
* Prepare and issue requests for quotation (RFQs), and evaluate supplier quotes based on price, quality, lead time, and delivery performance for assigned materials and or services.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and delivery terms with suppliers to secure costs favorable to the Organization.
* Identify and onboard new suppliers and maintain the approved supplier list in accordance with company procedures.
* Use the ERP/MRP system to place, change, and track purchase orders accurately and on time.
* Obtain supplier order confirmations and expedite past-due or at-risk orders to prevent production shortages.
* Coordinate inbound freight with logistics department and communicate delivery delays to affected departments and internal customers.
* Communicate with Engineering on assigned material specifications, and new product introductions to manage material transitions and avoid obsolete stock.
* Provide demand forecasting for assigned commodities by analyzing historical data and market trends to forecast future demand.
* Maintain inventory levels to assigned commodities to prevent stockouts and avoid excessive holding costs, and identify excess or obsolete material.
* Support inventory team and accuracy through cycle counts and variance reviews with inventory team.
* Track supplier performance, including on-time delivery, quality, and lead time, and communication issues to the Purchasing Manager.
* Partner with receiving and accounting to resolve nonconforming material, shortages, over-shipments, and supplier returns via credits (RMA/RTV).
* Investigate and resolve invoice discrepancies in collaboration with accounting.
* Maintain accurate supplier, pricing, lead-time, and item data in the ERP system.
* Collect and maintain purchasing documentation, including purchase orders, supplier agreements, and material certifications, where required.
* Track cost savings and purchase price variance (PPV) and recommend cost-reduction opportunities.

Requirements:

**General Functions:**

* Take responsibility for the quality and timeliness of work assigned, works independently within established and assigned purchasing policies.
* Collaborate with other members of the team to ensure that department goals and deadlines are met on time.
* Uses technical and experiential knowledge to help support the department’s mission.
* Stays current on supplier markets, material pricing, and lead-time trends.
* Attends and actively participates in department meetings to stay informed and follow through on shared responsibilities.
* Works effectively with co-workers and supervisors, sharing knowledge, resources, and experience to achieve goals in a timely fashion, while promoting respect, communication, and teamwork.
* Performs other duties as assigned by the Purchasing Manager.

**Skills and Abilities:**

* Attention to detail: The ability to perform tasks with precision, accuracy, and thoroughness, paying close attention to all aspects of the work and identifying errors or inconsistencies as needed.
* Communication skills: The ability to convey and receive information effectively, clearly, and professionally with co-workers and supervisors. Build strong relationships with assigned vendors.
* Negotiation skills: The ability to reach agreements with suppliers on price, terms, and delivery that meet company needs while maintaining positive supplier relationships.
* Dependability: Reliability and consistency of attendance, punctuality, and completion of assigned tasks according to established standards and expectations with little supervision.
* Initiative: Recognizes situations that warrant initiative and move forward without hesitation; reasonably resolves issues, problems, and situations.
* Time management skills: The ability to prioritize tasks, plan and organize work efficiently, and meet deadlines while maintaining quality standards.
* Technical aptitude: The ability to understand, operate MRP software tools, as well as to learn and adapt to new technologies and processes.
* Critical thinking: The ability to analyze complex

Leads and/or provides expertise to functional project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. Acts as an expert providing direction and guidance to process improvements and establishing policies. Frequently represents the organization to external customers/clients. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for accomplishing work and achieving objectives. May provide mentoring and guidance to lower level employees.

* Understand HPE needs to the industry and drive strategic partnerships to enable well aligned investments !

* Collaborate with the Juniper Commodity SME's to support global sourcing strategy creation and execution.

* Drive value engineering activities with a multi-functional team & project oriented teams

* Support the development from suppliers to enable innovative products/solutions to align with HPE Networking Project need.
* From Project perspective, to mitigate the risks in corporate strategy, supplier financials, corporate compliance, and operations
* Possess understanding of Commodity industry indicators and market intelligence
* Flexibility to handle commodities within the HPE Networking electromechanical commodity space !

* First level university degree or equivalent experience; advanced university degree preferred.

Implementation of the Supply Chain Process, inventory management, and investment recovery processes and programs.

Support and perform activities that successfully implement the Supply Chain Process. * Implementation of the Strategic Sourcing objectives and alliance partnerships to ensure consistent quality of material and timely delivery, price savings, and overall supply chain improvements.
* Maintenance of a qualified supplier pool is available.
* Communicates across business units, with Suppliers, and other stakeholders to successfully source and purchase materials and services.

Oversees the implementation of supplier performance monitoring and associated performance improvement initiatives. Manages complex, high dollar purchasing activities.

Minimum Qualifications:

* Bachelor's Degree in business, engineering, science or related field with 4-7 years' experience or in lieu of degree, 6-9 years of relevant experience.

Overview:

We are seeking a full-time **Buyer 1** at Garmin's U.S. headquarters in the Greater Kansas City area. In this role, you will be responsible for managing the acquisition of assigned commodities and products.

Responsibilities:

**Essential Functions**

* Drive performance to meet world-class levels in supplier Quality, Cost, Delivery and Service (QCDS)
* Responsible for supplier development in the areas of supplier partnering agreements and QCDS
* Manage the planning, ordering and delivery of all components, products and services to ensure on-time delivery across all levels of the organization
* Closely monitor inventory levels of assigned commodities and products to maximize inventory turns and minimize exposure to obsolescence
* Review, analyze, develop and negotiate multiple procurement contracts in support of Garmin’s Master Production Schedule (MPS)
* Prepare cost price analysis for various supplier partnering agreements and projects
* Review and compile inventory costing records, such as Purchase Price Variance (PPV), scrap and rework costs
* Work closely with Engineering, Quality, and Marketing to develop new sources of supply in support of new product development
* Knowledge of department processes and procedures, work instructions and training requirements for the Purchasing Department in support of ISO9000/QS9000
* Continued improvement to ensure departmental goals and metrics are met

Qualifications:

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in a related field **OR** an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
* Demonstrated strong and effective verbal, written, negotiating, analytical, and interpersonal communication skills to work across functional and organizational lines with uncompromising ethics
* Must be a motivated self-starter with a demonstrated proven track record in the ability to prioritize, organize and multi-task in a flexible, fast paced and challenging environment to effectively meet deadlines
* Must possess demonstrated knowledgeable of Manufacturing Resource Planning (MRPII)/Master Production Schedule (MPS) process
* Demonstrated knowledge of manufacturing requirements and ability to asses supplier capabilities
* Demonstrated proficient computer skills using Microsoft Office Word, Excel and PowerPoint

**Desired Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Management, Operations or Material or equivalent experience
* Certified in Production & Inventory Management (CPIM) or Certified Purchasing Manager (CPM)
* Previous experience in a electronics manufacturing or repair purchasing

*Garmin International is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran’s status, age or disability.*

*This position is eligible for Garmin's benefit program. Details can be found here:* *Garmin Benefits*

description:
**Number of Vacancies**

1

**Location**

Edinburg, Texas

**Department**

Procurement Office

**FTE**

1

**FLSA**

Exempt

**Scope of Job**

To provide advanced professional advisory and technical skills necessary in the procurement process to acquire supplies, equipment, and services required by the institution in compliance with all applicable laws, rules, regulation, policies and procedures. Primarily responsible for performing various tasks related to the Procurement Cycle from procurement planning through order fulfillment for complex procurements including institutional master supply/service agreements and licensing and leasing agreements. Assist in the operational planning and administration of an assigned service area(s).

**Description of Duties**

* Administers and directs strategic procurements and discretionary and nondiscretionary competitive bids, including conducting pre-proposal and/or pre-bid conferences, conducting evaluations and determining best value, analyzing supplier responses, creating tabulations and related procurement documentation, and making recommendations for award.
* Prepares, reviews, and analyzes procurement reports to assist with development of procurement management strategies.
* Directly coordinates with appropriate staff, various University departments, UT System (as applicable) and pertinent contractors at all stages of the procurement process to ensure best value is secured in accordance with all applicable State, System, and University procurement regulations, polices, and procedures.
* Provides guidance and support to staff, program managers, principal investigators and faculty in the area of procurement including, but not limited to, reviewing the financial terms and conditions of agreements; ensures appropriateness documents for solicitation, contract renewals, extensions and modifications in accordance with Customer requests and purchasing management.
* Interprets and ensures departmental compliance with federal, state, and local policies including internal UTRGV policies and procedures.
* Prepares statements, reports, projects, estimates, and/or projects as requested.
* Resolves issues/problems that arise with the campus community and/or vendors.
* Functions as an effective liaison between University departments and related contracting entities, and provides direction to University representatives in purchase order negotiations.
* Reviews University spend reports for assigned commodities and identifies potential strategic sourcing initiatives or spend trends and patterns.
* May leads or supports internal teams and task forces, providing functional expertise and guidance on the procurement systems and business processes that may include training purchasing staff as required.
* Maintains supplier and/or supply e-catalogs; creation of and maintenance of item master database records.
* Maximizes usage of contractual item(s) or supplier opportunities; identify possibilities for process improvement, service enhancement and/or cost reductions.
* Reviews and analyzes a range of contracting scopes of work and/or specifications, and researches, redrafts, and develops scope documents as necessary to establish clarity and to secure the best interests of the University; provide direction and leadership to University departments in developing scopes of work/specifications
* Ensures opportunities in university contracts to HUB firms when expected value is of at least $100,000 including commodities, professional services, and construction.
* Coordinates with the Contracts Office and applicable departments on procurement solicitations that will result in formal agreements to ensure appropriate terms are included in the solicitation, and the scope of work will effectively transfer to the agreement; develop resulting agreements.

* Flexible and able to cope with ambiguity
* Planning and organizational skills

description:
**Working Title:** Strategic Buyer

**Business Function:** Supply Chain

**Reports To:** Senior Manager, Supply Chain

**Job Summary**

The Strategic Buyer owns the commercial relationship and long-term performance of assigned suppliers supporting Hologic's production and indirect requirements, including suppliers that manufacture components unique to Hologic. The role supports sourcing, negotiations, cost reduction, supply risk mitigation, and item master data, and owns supplier on-time delivery (OTD).

This position owns strategic procurement activities and supports tactical execution, bridging the Commodity Manager, who sets category strategy, and the Tactical Buyer, who executes purchase orders. The Strategic Buyer uses independent judgment to resolve material issues.

**Essential Duties**

The candidate may be asked to perform other function-related activities in addition to the responsibilities below, as reasonably required by business needs.

* Lead site sourcing in support of the global sourcing and commodity teams, including spend analysis, business award scenarios, cost models, and RFQs.
* Partner with cross-functional teams across the supplier lifecycle, from evaluation, selection, and onboarding through risk mitigation and offboarding, including dual-sourcing strategies with the global sourcing team.
* Support global sourcing on supply agreement negotiations and monitor contract compliance.
* Drive cost reduction through the VIP pipeline and value engineering. Support the annual standard cost update and own purchase price variance review and material quotes.
* Own supplier OTD and long-term performance through scorecards, supplier reviews, and QBRs, and drive actions that reduce delivery risk and business impact.
* Resolve supplier delivery and quality issues with cross-functional partners, including root cause and corrective action.
* Partner with data governance and cross-functional teams to maintain accurate item master data and strategic ERP parameters, including pricing, lead times, MOQ, safety stock, and sourcing rules. Support new supplier and part number setup, as well as engineering and supplier changes.
* Review demand, MRP signals, inventory, and open POs with Planning and Manufacturing. Share forecasts with suppliers and escalate supply risks.
* Guide Tactical Buyers on PO requirements, transactional exceptions, escalated issues, and end-of-life materials. Process POs as needed.
* Improve inventory turns through programs such as supplier Kanban, and lead continuous improvement and site cross-functional projects.
* Represent Supply Chain on New Product teams and define supply chain strategy for new products.

**Physical Demands**

The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

* Sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls.
* Stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field preferred, and/or equivalent experience.

**Experience**

* 5+ years of procurement experience; medical device or pharmaceutical industry experience preferred but not required.
* Experience with an ERP system, MRP logic, and item master data; Oracle experience is a plus.

**Skills**

* CPIM, CPSM, CPM, or PMP certification preferred; APICS involvement is a plus.
* Negotiation, cost modeling, and total cost analysis.
* Supplier relationship management, performance management, and risk management, including dual-sourcing strategy with the global sourcing team.
* Working knowledge of a PLM system such as Agile, change control, and quality processes.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills, with the ability to build collaborative relationships internally and externally.
* Accurate, dependable, and audit-ready, with experience supporting internal and external audits. Ability to work to tight requirements with minimal supervision and sound escalation judgment.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, including advanced Excel and data analysis.

**Compensation**

The annualized base salary range for this role is $77,800 to $121,700, and the position is eligible for an annual bonus. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, education, location, business needs, and market conditions.

**Agency and Third-Party Recruiter Notice**

Agencies that submit resumes to Hologic must have a current, fully executed Hologic Agency Agreement approved by the Human Resources Department. Agencies may only submit candidates for positions when specifically authorized to do so by a Hologic Recruiter. Resumes submitted outside of these terms will not be considered.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Hologic is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer inclusive of disability and veterans.

At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

SUMMARY

Support procurement of items such as materials, components, equipment, supplies, and outsourced services that are required for engineering prototype builds and general engineering operations.

Provides analytical and specialized administrative support to relieve executive, director, and/or staff managers of complex details and advanced administrative duties.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Coordinate executives, directors and/or manager’s calendar, meetings, correspondence and presentations as needed.

Coordinate and arrange meetings facilities and records and transcribe minutes of meetings.

Participate or lead special projects and/or events as needed.

Serve as the administrative liaison with others within and outside the company regarding administrative issues relating to purchasing, personnel, facilities and operations.

Plan and prepare for customer visits and corporate events.

Serve as resource to others in the resolution of complex problems and issues.

Issue Purchase Orders to pricing, terms & conditions that are negotiated and agreed to by Jabil Commodity Managers and Buyers. Ensure suppliers’ adherence to established agreements.

Processes purchase requisitions and purchase orders through Coupa.

Optimize order management process to ensure effective communication with suppliers.

Support Accounts Payable in resolving invoice discrepancies.

Handles shipping and receiving packages.

Processes new vendor onboarding using Jabil’s systems.

Perform analysis and reporting of purchase history and supplier performance.

Adheres to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor.

Comply and follow all procedures within the company security policy.

May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

MANAGEMENT & SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

Reports to Sr. Manager of Engineering Operations

Job is NOT directly responsible for managing other employees (e.g., hiring/termination and/or pay decisions, performance management).

JOB QUALIFICATIONS EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

Typically requires a minimum of 6+ years of related experience.

Or an equivalent combination of education, training or experience.

BE AWARE OF FRAUD: When applying for a job at Jabil you will be contacted via correspondence through our official job portal with a jabil.com e-mail address; direct phone call from a member of the Jabil team; or direct e-mail with a jabil.com e-mail address. Jabil does not request payments for interviews or at any other point during the hiring process. Jabil will not ask for your personal identifying information such as a social security number, birth certificate, financial institution, driver’s license number or passport information over the phone or via e-mail. If you believe you are a victim of identity theft, contact the Federal Bureau of Investigations internet crime hotline (www.ic3.gov), the Federal Trade Commission identity theft hotline (www.identitytheft.gov) and/or your local police department. Any scam job listings should be reported to whatever website it was posted in.

**Jabil, including its subsidiaries, is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.**

**Accessibility Accommodation**
===============================

If you are a qualified individual with a disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access Jabil.com/Careers site as a result of your disability. You can request a reasonable accommodation by sending an e-mail to Always\\_Accessible@Jabil.com or calling 727-803-7988 with the nature of your request and contact information. Please do not direct any other general employment related questions to this e-mail or phone number. Please note that only those inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to.

description:
**POSITION GOAL**
-----------------

To coordinate, within assigned categories, the professional purchasing of a variety of categories of complex materials, supplies and equipment to support a broad range of diverse instructional and technical school system programs. The position also provides technical guidance to school administrators originating requests to purchase electronic and other specialized equipment and services.

**ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------------------------

The Purchasing Agent IV shall carry out the essential performance responsibilities listed below:

* Supervise staff as assigned in the performance of job duties.
* Write, edit, recommend, and coordinate highly technical product specifications and bid conditions and analyze price comparison with market trends, economy and availability of products to determine the procurement process for obtaining the most suitable product at the lowest and best price for assigned categories.
* Expedite follow-up on all purchase orders within area of assigned responsibility.
* Work with committees of teachers, curriculum planners, principals, and department heads in to formulate and upgrade specifications and evaluation of bids.
* Meet and interact effectively with the general public, staff members, administrators and other contact persons, using tact and good judgment.
* Maintain complete responsibility for the formal bid process in area of assigned commodity responsibility.
* Exercise direct contact with vendors to ensure performance and follow-up on identified discrepancies.
* Purchase materials, supplies, and equipment in areas of assigned responsibility.
* Ensure proper handling of school and department requisitions and secure lowest possible cost for items needed.
* Solicit written and telephone price quotations.
* Assist in the coordination of purchases for all new schools.
* Maintain vendor file in area of assigned commodity responsibility.
* Maintain requisition log in area of assigned responsibility.
* Assign vendor code numbers to purchase requisitions.
* Perform and promote all activities in compliance with the equal employment and nondiscrimination policies of The School Board of Broward County, Florida.
* Participate in training programs offered to enhance the individual skills and proficiency related to job responsibilities.
* Review current developments, literature and technical sources of information related to job responsibilities.
* Ensure adherence to safety rules and procedures.
* Follow federal and state laws, as well as School Board policies.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the immediate supervisor or designee.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**
---------------------------------------

* An earned bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.
* A minimum of six (6) years, within the last nine (9) years of experience and/or training in the field related to the title of the position or six (6) years of satisfactory experience in the job assignment of Buyer or Purchasing Agent with The School Board of Broward County, Florida.
* Ability to communicate effectively with a diverse group of requestors and vendors.
* Knowledge and experience in preparing bid specifications in categories of complex technical materials, supplies and equipment of governmental or school system programs.
* Certified Purchasing Manager (CPM), Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM), or equivalent certification from an accredited institution.
* Computer skills as required for the position.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**
-----------------------------------------

* Certified Professional Public Buyer (CPPB), Certified Purchasing Procurement Officer (CPPO), or equivalent certification from an accredited institution and public school procurement experience.
* SAP experience in Procurement Modules.
* Bilingual skills.

**SIGNIFICANT CONTACTS-frequency, contact, purpose**
----------------------------------------------------

Frequently works with District administrators, planners, principals and department heads to gain information to develop bid specifications and obtain customer feedback for performance improvement; frequently works with outside vendors to negotiate contract terms.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**
-------------------------

Light work: Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently as needed to move objects.

**TERMS OF EMPLOYMENT**
-----------------------

Salary and benefits shall be paid consistent with the District's approved compensation plan. Length of the work year and hours of employment shall be those established by the School Board.

**LINK TO JOB DESCRIPTION**
---------------------------

To review the complete job description for this position access the following website: https://www.browardschools.com/Page/36072 and search by Job Code. The Job Code for this position is: DD-078

**The company built on breakthroughs.**
**Join us.**

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.

Come break through with us.

The Global Supply Management (GSM) Function is recognized as a critical function for business success. It delivers the training, tools and opportunities needed to create innovative solutions for the function & the corporation. GSM has leading edge, effective processes to anticipate and exceed customer requirements.

**Role Purpose**

Leads the development and execution of Global Supply Management (GSM) Strategic Sourcing strategies, policies, tactics and objectives for assigned complex global commodities that align and are linked with the business units, commercial, supply chain and manufacturing strategies.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Purchasing Manager to be accountable for the full procurement function: ensuring electronic components and materials are sourced, purchased, and delivered on time and on cost to support PCBA production across Avalir's aerospace/defense, space, and medical programs. This role partners closely with Engineering, Planning, Quality, Receiving, Program Management, and executive leadership, and serves as the escalation point for supplier performance, material shortages, and customer commitments. The Purchasing Manager reports to the Director of Supply Chain and regularly contributes purchasing performance data, including purchase price variance for executive-level review.

**About Avalir**

Avalir (formerly Electronic Source Company) is a leading electronic manufacturing services (EMS) provider, delivering quick-response, high-reliability printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) built on world-class manufacturing equipment, practices, and technology. The assemblies Avalir builds support mission-critical end products, from missile guidance to satellite systems, for industry-leading customers. Avalir's business is approximately 70% aerospace & defense, 25% space, and 5% medical, reflecting a customer base that demands the highest standards of quality, traceability, and on-time delivery.

**ITAR Notice**

This position supports programs subject to ITAR and EAR export control regulations. Candidates must be U.S. citizens or permanent residents.

**REPORTING STRUCTURE**

**Reports To**

Director of Supply Chain, with regular visibility and reporting to executive leadership on purchasing performance, cost, and purchase price variance (PPV).

**Direct Reports**

* Senior Buyers
* Buyers
* MRO Buyer

The team is based in Chatsworth, CA and includes remote team members on the East Coast. The team is expected to grow as the business scales, and the Purchasing Manager will lead its structure, recruitment, and development.

**Key Working Relationships**

Internal: Supply Chain leadership, Planning, Engineering, Quality, Program Management, Estimating/Quoting, Receiving, Stockroom, Document Control, Finance, and Operations. External: component manufacturers, franchised distributors, brokers (under counterfeit-mitigation controls), contract service providers, and customers.

**THE PERSON WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

This is an opportunity for a hands-on purchasing leader to help develop, shape, and grow Avalir’s purchasing and supply chain function. We are looking for someone who wants to build, not just maintain, and who takes real pride in developing the people around them.

* **Proactive and driven –** Takes ownership, anticipates supply risks and problems before they reach the production floor, and acts without waiting to be asked. Brings energy, urgency, and a strong sense of accountability for results.
* **A builder –** Excited by the chance to develop, shape, and grow the purchasing and supply chain function, putting in place the processes, systems, structure, and talent needed to scale with the business.
* **Collaborative –** Builds strong, trusted relationships across Engineering, Planning, Quality, Program Management, and Operations, as well as with suppliers and customers. Sees supply chain as a team effort and works to find solutions rather than assign blame.
* **A coach, mentor, and developer of people –** Genuinely invested in growing others; able to coach, mentor, and develop buyers into stronger professionals and future leaders as the function expands.
* **Hands-on and grounded –** Comfortable rolling up their sleeves on day-to-day buying, expediting, and supplier issues when needed, while keeping sight of the bigger strategic picture.
* **A continuous improver –** Curious, data-driven, and always looking for a better way to work, whether in process, systems, supplier strategy, or team capability.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a team of Senior Buyers, Buyers, and the MRO Buyer, including remote team members on the East Coast; set goals, conduct performance reviews, and manage individual development plans
* Recruit and onboard talent as the team grows; define team structure, roles, account and commodity coverage, backup, and succession planning to scale the function

**Procurement Operations**

* Ensure components are sourced and purchased accurately and on time to customer BOMs, build schedules, and committed ship dates; oversee PO creation, approval, backlog, acknowledgements, and expediting/de-expediting in Epicor Kinetic ERP
* Drive proactive resolution of component shortages through expedites, alternates, and substitutions, and maintain accurate ERP purchasing data (item master, approved manufacturers, pricing, lead times) so MRP output can be relied on
* Support Estimating/Quoting with accurate component pricing, lead times, and availability for customer RFQs

**Cost, Inventory & Financial Performance**

* Own

description:
At Spectrum Control, most departments operate on a 4-day, 10-hour work schedule in exchange for a **3-day weekend**. We offer competitive wages and PTO, plus our benefits begin on **day 1** of employment. Come join a workforce where we put you first!

**JOB SUMMARY:** The Commodity Manager is responsible for developing and executing commodity strategies that support Spectrum Control’s operational, financial, and customer objectives across multiple manufacturing locations. This hands-on, people manager will lead and develop a team of three commodity professionals while remaining actively involved in major supplier negotiations, contracting, cost reduction, risk mitigation, and supplier performance management.

Working closely with Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Program Management, the Commodity Manager will build a reliable and competitive supply base for highly engineered products serving the aerospace, defense, and other high-reliability markets. The role requires strong commercial judgment, technical sourcing experience, and the ability to balance strategic initiatives with immediate business and production needs.

**Compensation Range:** The expected compensation range for this position is $130,000 - 160,000.00 annually.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

Commodity Strategy:

* Spend Analytics
* Develop commodity strategy framework, supplier strategies.
* Implement major commodity strategies aligned with business objectives, customer requirements, and manufacturing needs.
* Manage supplier relationships and performance, improve lead time, mitigate supplier/supply risk.
* Identify and execute cost-reduction, productivity, value-engineering, and working-capital improvement opportunities.
* Identify opportunities for supplier base optimization.

People Management and Development:

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of commodity professionals, establishing clear priorities, performance expectations, and development plans.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators for cost savings, lead time reduction, risk mitigation.
* Jointed ownership with Material Management team for purchase-price variance, delivery, lead time, and risk reduction.

Maintain hands-on involvements:

* SRM.
* Critical supplier selection, negotiations, contracting, cost analysis, and resolution of critical supply issues.
* Partner with Engineering and Operations to support supplier transitions and make-versus-buy decisions.

Continuous Improvement:

* Collaborate across Spectrum Control locations to standardize commodity practices, leverage enterprise-wide spend, and improve supply-chain performance.
* Automation and AI- actively seek opportunities to introduce new tools and automation.
* Establish and implement KPIs, best practice commodity framework and processes.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, Operations, or a related field; advanced degree or professional certification is preferred.
* 7+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, commodity management or supply-chain management, including 2+ years of direct people management experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing sourcing, procurement, or commodity-management professionals.
* Experience sourcing technical components, materials, or manufacturing services within aerospace, defense, electronics, or another highly regulated manufacturing environment.
* Strong background in supplier negotiations, contract development, cost analysis, commodity strategy, and supplier performance management.
* Ability to understand technical requirements, drawings, specifications, bills of material, cost drivers, and manufacturing processes.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders across Engineering, Operations, Quality, Finance, and Program Management.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage strategic priorities while responding effectively to urgent production and supplier-related challenges.
* Proficiency with ERP/MRP systems, Microsoft Office applications, and data-analysis or business-intelligence tools.
* Ability and willingness to travel approximately 30%.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

* This position will be based at Spectrum Control’s facility in Marlborough, MA.
* The role operates in a professional office environment with regular interaction on the manufacturing floor and at supplier facilities.
* Approximately 30% travel is required to Spectrum Control locations, supplier sites, and other business-related destinations.
* The role requires frequent collaboration across multiple locations and functions.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities

The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employ

description:
The Purchasing Manager is responsible for leading and managing all direct and indirect procurement activities to support business objectives, manufacturing operations, and customer requirements. This role develops sourcing strategies, manages supplier relationships, negotiates contracts, and drives cost reduction initiatives while ensuring the uninterrupted supply of materials, components, equipment, and services.

The Purchasing Manager will work closely with Operations, Engineering, Quality, Program Management, Finance, and suppliers to optimize procurement performance. The ideal candidate will possess strong automotive Tier 1 supplier experience and proven success managing commercial relationships and negotiations with OEM customers and suppliers.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead all direct and indirect purchasing activities for manufacturing operations.
* Develop and execute purchasing strategies aligned with regional and global business objectives.
* Manage sourcing, supplier selection, RFQs, negotiations, and contract administration.
* Establish and maintain strategic relationships with suppliers and service providers.
* Support customer programs, product launches, engineering changes, and production requirements.
* Negotiate pricing, commercial terms, tooling agreements, and long-term supply contracts.
* Analyze market trends, commodity fluctuations, and supply chain risks to develop mitigation strategies.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve operational, quality, delivery, and financial objectives.
* Drive annual cost reduction initiatives and support budget planning activities.
* Monitor supplier performance, including quality, delivery, responsiveness, and cost competitiveness.
* Lead supplier business reviews and corrective action activities when performance issues arise.
* Manage inventory levels to support production while minimizing working capital investment.
* Ensure compliance with company purchasing policies, customer requirements, and applicable regulations.
* Develop procurement metrics and reports to support management decision-making.
* Support regional purchasing initiatives led by the Head of Purchasing Americas.
* Lead, mentor, and develop purchasing team members.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field.
* CPSM, CPM, APICS/ASCM, or other purchasing certifications preferred.

**Experience**

* Minimum of 7 years of progressive purchasing and procurement experience within an automotive manufacturing environment.
* Minimum of 3 years of leadership or management experience.
* Experience working for an Automotive Tier 1 supplier is required.
* Demonstrated experience managing both direct and indirect purchasing processes.
* Proven experience negotiating commercial agreements, pricing, and supplier contracts.
* Experience supporting automotive OEM customer programs and launch activities.
* Strong understanding of automotive supply chain requirements, customer expectations, and production planning processes.
* Experience with global sourcing and supplier development preferred.

**Leadership Expectations**

* Demonstrates integrity, accountability, and sound business judgment.
* Serves as a strategic business partner to leadership and operational teams.
* Builds strong supplier partnerships that support organizational objectives.
* Drives continuous improvement, cost competitiveness, and supply chain excellence.
* Promotes a culture of collaboration, innovation, and employee development.

**Carcoustics Tech Center North America is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.**

US Citizens or Green Card Holders Only

Local Candidates Only - No relocation offered!

Must have experience with indirect procurement & capital equipment related to manufacturing / production of automotive seating or automotive interiors / interior products or components

**Position Title:** Buyer ? Indirect Procurement & Capital
**Department:** Finance
**Reports To:** Plant Controller
**FLSA Status:** Exempt
**Employment Status:** Full-Time, Salaried
**Work Arrangement:** On-Site

**POSITION SUMMARY**

LM Manufacturing, LLC is a Tier 1 automotive supplier responsible for manufacturing complete seat systems for the Ford Bronco and Ford Ranger.

The Buyer ? Indirect Procurement & Capital is responsible for leading the competitive sourcing, procurement, contract management, and financial analysis of the Company's indirect expenditures. The position has primary responsibility for approximately $5?7 million in annual variable overhead (VOH) and indirect spend, in addition to significant capital expenditures associated with new product launches, plant improvements, and ongoing operations.

Reporting to the Plant Controller, the Buyer serves as the primary commercial purchasing resource for indirect goods and services across the facility. This position partners closely with department managers to understand operational and technical requirements while independently managing the commercial sourcing process, including supplier identification, competitive bidding, negotiations, financial analysis, and sourcing recommendations.

The Buyer is expected to challenge historical purchasing practices, increase competition within the supplier base, identify measurable cost-reduction opportunities, strengthen purchasing controls and separation of duties, and provide senior leadership with clear, data-driven sourcing recommendations.

Production raw materials are not within the scope of this position, as production material sourcing is directed by LM Manufacturing's customer.

**Strategic Sourcing and Procurement**

* Lead competitive sourcing activities for indirect goods and services, including capital equipment, MRO materials and equipment, tooling and fixtures, IT hardware and software, facility maintenance and construction, temporary labor, professional services, safety and PPE, office supplies, freight and logistics, utilities, janitorial services, security, landscaping, and other plant expenditures.
* Develop and issue RFQs and RFPs, establish bid requirements, solicit competitive quotations, and manage supplier bidding processes.
* Identify, evaluate, and develop new suppliers while maintaining effective commercial relationships with existing vendors.
* Negotiate supplier pricing, payment terms, commercial terms, service levels, and other conditions to achieve the best overall value for LM Manufacturing.
* Challenge historical purchasing practices and existing supplier relationships when competitive alternatives may provide improved cost, service, quality, or commercial terms.
* Develop detailed bid analyses and sourcing recommendation packages for presentation to senior leadership for final sourcing decisions.
* Create, release, and maintain purchase orders within SAP in accordance with established authorization and procurement requirements.
* Respond to plant purchasing needs with appropriate urgency while maintaining competitive sourcing standards and internal controls.

**Capital Procurement**

* Lead the commercial sourcing process for capital equipment and projects from initial RFQ through negotiation and sourcing recommendation.
* Partner with Engineering, Maintenance, Operations, and other stakeholders to ensure technical requirements and specifications are clearly defined prior to supplier solicitation.
* Develop comprehensive commercial comparisons of competing capital proposals, considering purchase price, installation costs, operating costs, payment terms, timing, and other relevant total-cost factors.
* Support ROI, payback, and other financial analyses associated with proposed capital investments.
* Negotiate commercial terms and coordinate contracts and purchase orders following final sourcing approval.
* Support capital sourcing associated with new product launches, plant improvements, and other major projects.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

We are seeking an experienced Buyer to support hardware supply chain procurement across Amazon Leo's satellite constellation. The role is responsible for purchase order management and delivery of satellite materials to meet production and engineering schedules. This role will work with multiple Supply Chain Managers and business functions in a team environment. You will work cross-functionally with supply chain managers, planning, warehouse, quality, and production.

Key job responsibilities
1. Place and manage purchase orders in SAP, working with Global Commodity Managers and category teams to support production and NPI builds.
2. Own and report on procurement metrics, including on-time delivery to need-by date, on-time delivery to promise date, PO health, and open PO aging.

3. Drive root cause analysis and corrective actions when metrics miss target.
4. Manage and resolve PO-to-invoice discrepancies, returns, and quality issues with suppliers to prevent payment delays and receiving holds.
5. Onboard new suppliers into procurement systems, ensuring all required documentation, contracts, and compliance records are complete before first PO.
6. Ensure compliance with correct export and qualify flow-down requirements applicable to the Leo program.
7. Monitor safety stock and flag supply delays early and work with the team to develop mitigation plans, escalate critical shortages, and expedite parts.
8. Create and improve procurement processes including standard work, PO management playbooks, and supplier performance tracking to improve efficiency and reduce errors.
9. Collaborate with internal customers and provide a high level of customer service, including recommending solutions, resources and alternative supply options.

About the team
Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. Amazon has ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious and earn trust.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Innovation is part of our DNA! Our goal is to be Earth's most customer-centric company, and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join an ambitious program that continues to push the state of the art in space based systems design and wireless systems.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in Business, Procurement, Logistics, Accounting, Supply Chain Management, Supply Chain Analysis, Construction, or other related fields
* 2+ years of supply chain management within a procurement organization experience
* Experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Workday), or experience or equivalent experience in finance roles
* Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Can demonstrate proficiency in Microsoft Excel or equivalent spreadsheet tools

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2+ years of working with external suppliers experience
* Experience in transportation or supply chain within a high-volume logistics, manufacturing or engineering environment
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of end-to-end order management
* Knowledge of import and export compliance requirements

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amaz

* Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Can demonstrate proficiency in Microsoft Excel or equivalent spreadsheet tools
