* Experience in transportation or supply chain within a high-volume logistics, manufacturing or engineering environment
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of end-to-end order management
* Knowledge of import and export compliance requirements

**About Veeco**
You probably don’t realize it, but what we do at Veeco touches the lives of every person, every day. It’s a bold statement, but it’s true. From the smartphones in our pockets that access the world’s collective knowledge, to the cloud-based services where all that information lives, to high-speed wireless communication and computing power needed to drive artificial intelligence, augmented and virtual reality, gaming and so much more, our technology is all around us.

We design, develop, manufacture, and service highly complex, cutting-edge machines used by our customers to create the essential devices that drive the digital age, connect the world, and improve the human experience. Along with the world’s leading technology companies, many of which are household names, we help solve their most difficult material science challenges, enabling technologies for a more connected, sustainable, and convenient world.

We’re looking for material difference-makers to join our growing team. Interested? Learn more at www.veeco.com/careers.

**OVERVIEW**

Veeco is seeking a strategic Category Manager to transform how we source the technologies, components, and manufacturing capabilities behind our advanced equipment. Depending on the candidate’s expertise and business needs, this high-impact role may support either OEM commercial off-the-shelf products or build-to-print custom manufacturing suppliers. We are looking for a candidate with deep strength in either supplier category who can shape global sourcing strategies, strengthen supply resilience, and deliver measurable business value.

The Category Manager will convert business and technical requirements into actionable category roadmaps, resilient supplier strategies, and commercial agreements that deliver measurable improvements in cost, quality, delivery, capacity, innovation, and supply continuity. This role serves as a strategic partner to Engineering, Operations, Quality, Planning, Finance, and Supply Chain leadership, using market intelligence and sound judgment to influence decisions and strengthen Veeco's global supply network.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Category Strategy and Market Intelligence**

* Own and drive global category strategies, multi-year roadmaps, sourcing plans, and supplier segmentation for assigned direct-material or equipment categories, with accountability for business results.
* Analyze global markets, technologies, cost drivers, capacity, lead times, geopolitical exposure, and supplier trends to guide sourcing decisions.
* Build category plans that align product roadmaps and production requirements with cost objectives and long-term supply resilience.

**Supplier Model and Supply Base Management**

* Lead supplier strategies for an assigned category aligned with the candidate’s expertise and business needs, supporting either OEM commercial off-the-shelf products or build-to-print custom manufacturing.
* **OEM commercial off-the-shelf:** Manage OEM and authorized-channel relationships; evaluate technology and product roadmaps, pricing, availability, lead times, allocation, warranty, service, and total cost of ownership; and lead lifecycle, end-of-life, obsolescence, and supply-continuity planning.
* **Build-to-print custom manufacturing:** Translate drawings, specifications, bills of materials, and quality requirements into sourcing and supplier-execution plans; assess manufacturability, process capability, tooling, capacity, cost drivers, and production readiness; and coordinate qualification, first-article approval, revision control, and engineering changes.
* Develop, qualify, rationalize, and strengthen the applicable global supplier network through performance data, business reviews, corrective actions, improvement plans, and supplier development.

**Strategic Sourcing and Commercial Leadership**

* Lead RFIs, RFQs, competitive bids, supplier selections, and sourcing transitions from requirements definition through implementation.
* Negotiate pricing, lead times, capacity commitments, payment terms, intellectual property protections, warranties, service levels, and other complex commercial terms.
* Apply should-cost, cost-modeling, market, and financial analysis to deliver savings, cost avoidance, and value-improvement opportunities.

**Cross-Functional Execution and Supplier Performance**

* Partner with Engineering, Operations, Quality, Planning, and Finance to optimize technical requirements, manufacturability, cost, quality, delivery, and risk.
* Establish clear supplier expectations and drive measurable improvements in cost, quality, delivery, responsiveness, and capacity, including corrective action and executive escalation when required.
* Coordinate sourcing decisions, supplier readiness, and continuity plans for production changes, engineering revisions, demand shifts, and product lifecycle events.

**Risk Management and Executive Communication**

* Anticipate and mitigate

Life changing therapies. Global impact. Bridge to thousands of biopharma companies and their patients.

**We are PCI.**

Our investment is in People who make an impact, drive progress and create a better tomorrow. Our strategy includes building teams across our global network to pioneer and shape the future of PCI.

**SUMMARY:**

The Buyer II (Direct/GMP or Indirect) is responsible for providing tactical support to the Supply Chain Management operations across all business locations or other Indirect business functions such as Engineering, Facilities, IT, Marketing etc. This position supports the development and execution of manufacturing inventory plans or business plans that achieve optimal customer delivery performance while minimizing total inventory investment and logistics cost or other business costs. This position partners cross functionally to support business growth, improve customer service, and reduce costs.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS-OTHER DUTIES MAY BE ASSIGNED:**

* Provides tactical support to Supply Chain Management operations.
* Negotiates pricing and contract terms with suppliers to reduce business risk and provide favorable commercial outcomes.
* For GMP, evaluates current inventory and material lead times, including analysis of delivery conditions, to ensure that the materials will be available for corresponding activities.
* Monitors purchasing systems and procedures and ensures compliance to company authorizations, policies, and procedures with respect to the purchasing function.
* Researches suppliers, pricing, cost effectiveness, and availability of material and commodities.
* Establishes and maintains vendor relationships and monitors suppliers OTIF.
* Identifies and resolves purchasing related issues for materials and manages suppliers associated with respective commodities.
* Utilizes and assists with implementation of systems (ERP, etc.) to help drive automation/continuous improvement programs.
* Prepares and issues purchase orders and change notices.
* Regular and reliable attendance on a full time basis [or in accordance with posted schedule].
* Responsible for exhibiting professional behavior with both internal and external business associates that reflects positively on the company and is consistent with the company’s policies and practices.
* Embodies Aji Bio-Pharma’s cultural values and aligns daily actions with department goals and company culture.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a business related discipline or equivalent experience required. Working towards membership of professional body such as ISM, APICs or CIPS.
* Three to four (3-4) years of related experience, including a minimum of 1-2 years in a GMP environment.
* Strategic thinker, able to articulate a clear vision and align the Procurement & Planning strategy to business objectives.
* Proven ability to effectively negotiate with suppliers to achieve desired commercial outcomes for the organization.
* Able to work in an orderly and methodical fashion to solve problems.
* Working knowledge of planning (MRP) and or E-Procurement systems and Source to Pay Process.

The hiring rate for this position is $76,000 - $85,500 plus eligibility for an annual performance bonus. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to specific and relevant experience, education, credentials, geography, and subject matter expertise. PCI offers full-time employees a competitive benefits package that includes paid time off, health insurance coverage (including dental and vision), a flexible spending account, and a 401(k) plan.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

**DEFINITION**

The incumbent works under supervision of the appropriate administrator in Business Services, to perform technical duties associated with purchasing commodities and services for the college. Provides comprehensive training and daily assistance to District personnel concerning related activities and promotes and values the mission and vision of the college.

**CLASS CHARACTERISTICS**

The incumbent in this position will work under limited direction and will be assigned technical purchasing duties that require great attention to detail, good working knowledge of subject matter and accounting functions for the assigned office as well as of public educational institutions. Incumbents may serve as a lead worker over entry level incumbents or student workers in the performance of these functions. Incumbents may assist the purchasing supervisor and perform the functions of providing technical support to the purchasing process with specific responsibility for processing purchasing documents, materials responding to related inquiries and maintain vendor/source information and inventories.

**Essential Functions and Qualifications**
------------------------------------------

* Examines and analyzes departmental purchase requisitions for completeness and accuracy of information in accordance with district purchasing policies and procedures; contacts department or initiator to clarify or complete information; determines method to process requisition based on dollar amount and timeliness required.

* Communicates with staff regarding purchasing procedures and requirements; assists departments in initiating requisitions

* Prepares purchase requisitions, and processes all purchase requisitions into purchase orders.

* Distributes purchase order documents and places orders according to established procedures; communicates with personnel, vendors, and various outside agencies to exchange information and resolve any questions, issues or concerns associated with purchase orders.

* Audits all requisitions for accuracy, account codes, backup documentation, appropriate tax rate, fixed asset and bid thresholds, and California Uniform Public Construction Cost Accounting Act (CUPCCAA) requirements in accordance with the college’s purchasing policies and procedures.

* Reviews independent contract agreements and professional service agreements for accuracy, completeness, and full signature execution; confirms the required tax forms are completed correctly; faxes the Notice of Independent Contractor to the California Employment Development Department (EDD).

* Generates annual open purchase orders for Business Services.

* Processes Purchase Order Change Requests for revisions and/or corrections to purchase orders; runs purchasing reports for history of receipts and payments; disencumber and reopen purchase orders.

* Disencumber and reopen purchase orders as needed throughout the year; works closely with accounts payable staff at fiscal year-end to determine which purchase orders can be closed or rolled to the next Fiscal Year (FY).

* Trains all users of financial software system in the requisition and receiving modules; updates and maintains training documents.

* Receipts all incoming district checks and cash received in the business services department; reconciles receipt log with accounts receivable deposit reports to ensure that all checks and cash have been deposited.

* Assists in the maintenance of fixed asset records; confers with department representatives to determine purchasing needs and specifications; communicates with Facilities for generation of a fixed asset tag.

* Assists with the purchasing and tracking of Furniture, Fixtures & Equipment (FF&E) for construction/bond projects.

* Assists in maintaining college credit card program, process related transactions and maintains credit card records.

* Assists in the ongoing maintenance and testing of the current software systems and/or implementation of new software systems and applications.

* Assists with competitive bid process and the preparation of and development of bid documents; coordinates bid schedule with Facilities staff and associate superintendent/vice president of finance and administration (VPFA) office personnel. Submits required public notifications related to formal and informal bids; assists with bid openings and preparation of documents for action by Board of Trustees.

* Processes vendor requests which includes; reviewing W-9 forms, determining vendor type, entering 1099 information if required, maintaining vendor information including creation and updating in the financial software system.

* Processes shipping and receiving requests to add funds to the postage machine.

* Assists purchasing supervisor with a variety of complex and technical duties.

* Assists in assuring compliance with Public Contract Code and established laws.

* Assists with Annual CUPCCAA contractor regis

description:
**Job Description:**

What does a cell phone in your pocket, a spaceship, and an electric vehicle have in common?

Ellsworth Adhesives provides materials that help make each of those products!

Ellsworth Corporation, a global, industry leading distributor of specialty chemicals and equipment and adhesive manufacturer currently has an Associate Buyer opportunity. This role reports into EDS, an Ellsworth Corporation company, located in Sparks, NV and is a fully on-site/in office position.

Want to continue to grow your career? This is an exciting time to be a part of Ellsworth, come join our team!

Ellsworth Dispensing Solutions provides the solutions to make parts. We are the knowledge leader in dispensing solutions. Ellsworth Corporation, a global, industry leading distributor of specialty chemicals and equipment and adhesive manufacturer currently has a Field Service Technician opportunity at Ellsworth Dispensing Solutions, located in Sparks, NV. Click here to find out more about the markets we serve and here to learn about our consumer and manufacturing products!

This role executes all functions of procurement up to and until the point of receipt and develops and leverages supplier relationships for operational and cost saving initiatives for assigned commodity categories. It also works with the Planning Team to ensure optimal stocking strategies to meet Customer demand at the best price point of purchase.

**Responsibilities**

* Submits daily purchase orders based on material requirements and manages the process through release, confirmation, non-conformance, and delivery.
* Negotiates returns and non-conformance with Suppliers and ensures Suppliers are adhering to negotiated pricing and the business terms of the agreement.
* Develops and maintains Supplier relationships to facilitate prompt resolution of issues (expedites, sales and customer service questions / concerns, customer specifications, product conformity, logistics, etc.,)
* Collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to resolve pricing questions, confirm current costs, and obtain quotes for products.
* Collaborates with the Planning Team to ensure accurate inventory levels throughout the Commodity.
* Provides feedback to the Sourcing Team on Supplier Scorecards and KPIs, participates in regular supplier performance reviews.
* Provides input to the Sourcing and Commercial Team for regular reviews within the commodity to ensure the right mix of Suppliers and products.

**PERKS & BENEFITS**

As an industry leader, we offer a competitive wage, bonus plan, and a comprehensive benefit package which includes Health, Prescription, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Flexible Spending, 401(k), Employee Assistance, Paid Time Off and Holidays, Wellness Program, Social Events, Community Involvement and much more! Click Here for a summary of Employee Benefits.

**Qualifications**

* 1+ years of experience in purchasing or related field
* Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college in Supply Chain, Finance, or related field. Other combinations of education and experience may be considered as equivalent.
* Professional certification in purchasing or supply chain management desired (Certified Purchasing Professional (CPP) through the American Purchasing Society or supply chain certification through APICS preferred.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to build supplier relationships
* Ability to learn in a fast-paced environment and work independently within standard operating procedures.
* Ability to build understanding of the entire supply chain within a commodity and become familiar with relevant industry regulations and standards
* Effectively communicates supply disruptions throughout the business.
* Continuous Improvement experience desired

* Negotiating skills
* Analytical skills

* Attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment
* Proficient with MS Office applications, ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) software, etc.

description:
Applied Composites (AC) is seeking a **Buyer** who uses expertise in performing a variety of purchasing activities including pricing, negotiating terms, volume discounts, long-term contracts and delivery of goods'services with suppliers. Applies government laws and regulations while conducting procurement activities and ensures alignment with management objectives.

**About AC:** Come and join the Applied Composites team. We are a leading provider of complex composite components, assemblies, engineering and tooling to the aerospace, defense and space system markets. Our employees are treated with respect and given the support, knowledge, and resources they need to thrive. If you are looking for a company that values and develops its employees while offering engaging work, Applied Composites may be the place for you.

**Job Accountabilities:**

* Prepares and processes requisitions and purchase orders for the procurement of goods, services and supplies
* Performs on time delivery of products or services, and negotiates with suppliers to reach highest quality at best value
* Initiates bid/quote process for services, supplies and equipment; prepares bid documents and oversees the bid process; performs bid analysis and makes recommendations regarding purchases
* Resolves problems and issues arising from purchase of services, supplies and equipment
* Evaluates reports to define the need for the purchased product(s), prepares request for quotations, evaluates quotes, selects suppliers, creates and approves purchase orders (POs)
* Manages specific custom commodities with high viability to balance demand and maintains an understanding of each supplier’s capabilities and current capacity
* Applies understanding of basic market drivers, so that reasonable pricing can be determined and supply risk reduced
* Develops appropriate sources of supply and maintains cooperative working relationships with vendors to stay current with trends and technologies, products and services
* Maintains current and accurate purchase order data in the purchasing system (e.g. delivery dates, pricing, change orders)
* Other responsibilities as assigned

**Job Specifications:**

**Education:** Post-secondary degree or equivalent combination of relevant education and work experience that will allow successful performance of job expectations
**Years’ Experience:** 3-5 years of relevant experience
**Skills:**

* Experienced in acquiring materials necessary for manufacturing and the organization, while maintaining relationships with vendors
* Demonstrated ability to write specifications, prepare bid documents, handle bidding process and analyze all bid results
* Strong experience negotiating license contracts with a track record of success
* Solves complex problems and exercises judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal), with ability to drive tasks to completion
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite

**Benefits:**

At Applied Composites, we recognize how important your career and benefits are to you and your family. We offer a full suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability coverage, accident insurance, critical illness insurance, basic and supplemental life insurance, employee assistance plan, retirement savings and matching, tuition reimbursement and other developmental opportunities. We are committed to supporting the way you live and work.

*AC is an Equal Opportunity Employer Veterans/Disabled - Affirmative Action Employer.*

*This position requires the use of information which is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). All applicants must be U.S. persons within the meaning of ITAR. ITAR defines a U.S. person as a U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident (i.e. 'Green Card Holder'), Political Asylee, or Refugee.*

description:
The Buyer I supports the purchasing team by ordering materials, parts, equipment, and supplies needed for the organization. This role helps ensure that items are ordered at a good price, meet quality standards, and arrive on time. description:
At Aquatech, we tackle the challenges of water scarcity and complexity by leveraging technology, expertise, and financing to deliver comprehensive solutions that reduce carbon and recycled water footprint. As a leading global provider of water and process technology solutions, we help the world's most recognized companies achieve their sustainability and operational goals by implementing innovative approaches for water reuse, desalination, minimal and zero liquid discharge, and critical minerals recovery. Our work catalyzes the transition toward a more sustainable future and showcases our commitment to addressing water's role in climate adaptation. Learn more at www.aquatech.com.

Aquatech has an immediate need for a full-time Industrial Engineer of Supply Chain & Procurement - Buyer to work in our Houston office. The hours are Monday to Friday 8:00 am to 5:00 pm. The Industrial Engineer of Supply Chain & Procurement - Buyer will report to the Procurement Manager, will perform the duties described in the job description below, and will be considered an Exempt employee.

The ideal candidate will have a background in procurement, specifically within the technical commodities industry of valves, pumps, vessels, and other water treatment equipment. This candidate will have savvy negotiation skills, be highly organized, a relationship builder, customer service driven, and a team player.

**Job Description:**

* Promptly purchase all commodities and technical equipment (e.g., pumps, valves, controls, vessels, and piping) for the manufacturer of water and wastewater treatment systems
* Copies data and compiles records and reports.
* Operated computer terminal to input and retrieve data.
* Purchases supplies.
* Data entry of all purchase orders.
* Assisting other departments when it is required.
* Review requisitions.
* Confers with vendors to obtain product or service information such as price, availability, and delivery schedule.
* Prepares purchase orders or bid requests. Receive and contact vendors to find out the status of an order.
* Contact vendors with discrepancies in quantity and quality.
* I interfaced with all departments and resolved problems and issues with needed purchase items.
* Review bid proposals and negotiate contracts within budgetary limitations and scope of authority.
* Traveling when needed to meet project requirements.

**Skill Requirements:**

* Ability to get quotations from vendors for projects & review them.
* Ability to negotiate supplier prices and purchase commodities for projects expediting to meet the due date.
* Ability to approve supplier invoices, manage appropriate purchasing budget, check for missing material in the shop, and follow up on partial deliveries.
* Ability to maintain budget reports.
* Ability to handle nonconformance with the Quality department.
* Knowledge of industrial water and wastewater treatment systems is preferred.
* Prior purchasing experience with international vendors is desired.
* Working knowledge of SAP.

**Benefits:**

Aquatech offers a comprehensive benefits package, including paid time off, company-paid holidays, and a 401 (k) plan. All benefits are based on eligibility.

**Essential Functions:**

To succeed in this job, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above and below represent the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

**Physical Job Demands:**

Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time and limited walking and standing.

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering
* Two (2) years of experience is preferred
* One (1) year of experience with SAP is preferred

description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

The Buyer 1 role performs purchasing activities in support of production and company’s operation requirements at the functional or business unit (BU) level. This role works with BU Planning Team and/or Director of Supply Chain in managing procurement related deliverables, as per company standard practice, to support customer materials and our internal Supply Chain metrics. Success in the role includes a positive and proactive approach to ensure continuity and quality of materials, maintain inventory at planned levels and monitor cost. Also demonstrates strong communication and organizational skills.

**DUTIES/ RESPONSIBILITIES** include, but not limited to:

* Collaborate with the regional & site customer focus team(s) to support customer material and business needs.
* Send Purchase Order Action (POA) reports to suppliers and manage PO Actions in weekly basis
* Generate and manage ERP purchase order releases for production and new product launch

* Monitor, track, and provide feedback to accurately communicate the PO Status to CFT (Customer Focus Team)
* Maintain and set up parts in ERP as needed (Preferred supplier, Prime MPN, MOQ/MPQ, Leadtime, NCNR)
* Work with Materials Planner to obtain customer authorization on pricing, NCNR, premium freight, and materials liability
* Source for material shortages to reduce delivery impact yet minimizing unfavorable PPV/CMP & excess inventory
* Manage material escalations with Commodity Management and suppliers
* Manage Material Review Board (MRB) items related to quality, receiving issues, ECO, and NCR including returns to suppliers
* Execute contract changes
* Execute PFEP (Plan for Every Part)/VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory) changes recommended by Program Leader/Supply Chain Leader
* Adhere to supplier approval and review processes
* Management and maintenance of Suppliers with activities related to selection, forecasting, monitoring performance, and supplier corrective actions
* Drive cost reduction and supplier negotiations for items not owned by commodity management
* Collaborate with Materials Planner on inventory reduction plans
* Work with Finance/Supplier/Commodity Manager to resolve invoice issues

### **Badger Meter - Where Every Drop Counts and So Do You**

At Badger Meter, we're more than a leading global water technology company - we're innovators with a mission: to preserve and protect the world's most precious resource. For over **120** years, our trusted solutions have enabled our customers to optimize the delivery and use of water, maximize revenue and reduce waste.

Every employee at Badger Meter is an important part of our success. Here, your work doesn't just move a business forward - it shapes a more sustainable future. We are committed to building a workplace where we celebrate differences, empower voices, and encourage fresh ideas that drive innovation.

When you join us, you'll find:

* **Purpose-driven work** that makes a real difference in communities around the globe.
* **Career growth and development opportunities** designed to help you achieve your potential.
* **A supportive, inclusive** **culture** where collaboration and creativity thrive.

Be part of something bigger. At Badger Meter, your contributions will ripple far beyond the workplace - creating lasting change for people and the planet.

### **What You Will Contribute:**

Buyer II takes ownership of supplier performance, strategic sourcing initiatives, and cost reduction efforts. The role evaluates supplier capabilities, negotiates contracts, drives corrective actions, and develops supplier improvement programs. Buyer II exercises independent judgment and plays an active role in influencing sourcing decisions and procurement outcomes.

**Job Duties:**

* Analyzes and schedules material purchases utilizing Material Requirements Planning (MRP) systems.
* Analyzes material availability, reviews and sets planning parameters and issues purchase orders as necessary to meet production requirements at optimum inventory levels for assigned commodities.
* Actively manages purchase orders through ongoing communication with suppliers and internal production teams to ensure on-time delivery.
* Resolves invoice exceptions after receipt of product.
* Initiates and negotiates contracts with suppliers for material required by Company to meet customer requirements.
* Works cross-functionally to execute supply chain strategies for products and services.
* Requests and evaluates supplier quotations to determine best overall value beyond cost.
* Promotes company’s ISO quality requirements to suppliers and ensures compliance to standards for material purchases by leading corrective action efforts with underperforming suppliers.
* Assess and mitigate supplier performance metrics such as on time delivery, quality, responsiveness and PPV. Develops on-going continuous improvement programs with major suppliers; major emphasis being cost reduction, quality improvement and in time delivery.
* Effectively engages in problem resolution on such items as defective purchases, invoice problems, order changes and cancellations, etc.
* Develops and cultivates good business relations with current and potential suppliers, negotiating price, terms and conditions of purchase and delivery through organization.
* Organizes and leads supplier meetings to align goals and drive compliance to Company standards.
* Prepare and present information to groups both internal and external to Company.
Tracking and follow up for all action items discussed.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college, or equivalent experience
3-5 years’ experience in a Supply Chain role

**Qualifications:**

* The ability to read engineering drawings to decipher product specifications is required.
* Intermediate understanding of Procurement activities and negotiating
* Position requires a basic understanding of production and inventory control and forecasting procedures.
* Intermediate understanding of cost standards and accounts for variance to standard.
* Intermediate level in MS Word, MS Excel, MS Outlook, MRP, ERP, Internet
* Advanced in Verbal and Written Skills
* Strong time management and multi-tasking skills

### **Competitive Total Rewards at Badger Meter:**

* Competitive Pay
* Annual Bonus
* Eligible for Annual Pay Increases
* Comprehensive Health, Vision, and Dental Coverage
* 15 days Paid Time Off + 11 Paid Holidays
* Two Ways to Save for Retirement: Badger Meter contributes 25 cents for every dollar you contribute to the plan, up to 7% of your eligible compensation. In addition to the match, the company will also contribute 5% of your eligible compensation to your Defined Contribution account on an annual basis. Additional access to a certified financial planner to help ensure your money is working for you, at no cost!
* Employer Paid benefits including: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Basic Group Life Insurance, Short Term Disability, and more
* Educational Assistance – Tuition Reimbursement up to $5,250
* Voluntary benefits including : Additional Life Insurance, Long Term Disability, Accident and Critical Illness coverage

Job Description:

**Position Summary:**

The Senior Buyer is responsible for sourcing and purchasing materials, components, fabricated products, and services supporting the company’s manufacturing and distribution operations. This role will focus on products and engineered solutions sold to data-center customers, including air compressors, pumps, valves, piping systems, fabricated skids, and related equipment.

The successful candidate will have extensive purchasing experience in both manufacturing and distribution environments, strong knowledge of ERP and material-planning systems, and the technical ability to understand engineered products, drawings, specifications, bills of material, and customer requirements. This position will work closely with Engineering, Operations, Sales, Quality, Inventory Management, and suppliers to ensure materials are available at the right cost, quality, and delivery performance.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Source and purchase air compressors, pumps, valves, piping components, fabricated skids, motors, controls, instrumentation, and related materials used in data-center applications.
* Manage purchasing activities for both stocked distribution products and engineered-to-order manufacturing projects.
* Review customer requirements, bills of material, engineering drawings, specifications, and production schedules to determine material requirements.
* Issue requests for quotation, analyze supplier proposals, negotiate pricing and commercial terms, and issue purchase orders.
* Develop sourcing strategies that improve product availability, reduce total cost, shorten lead times, and strengthen supply-chain continuity.
* Work closely with Engineering and Project Management to source technically compliant components for custom skid packages and integrated systems.
* Monitor purchase orders, supplier acknowledgments, production schedules, and delivery commitments to ensure materials arrive on time.
* Identify potential material shortages, long-lead-time items, and supply risks before they affect customer delivery or manufacturing schedules.

**Job Title:** Purchasing Specialist (Buyer)
**Job Location:** San Francisco-USA-94128
**Work Location Type:** On-Site
**Salary Range:** $25.00 - 32.00 per hour

**About us**
------------

Since 1942, SkyChefs has taken culinary excellence to new heights. As a trusted partner to the nation’s leading airlines and retailers, we proudly deliver millions of meals and exceptional service experiences every year across 43 sites throughout the United States. Built on a legacy of operational excellence, culinary expertise, and continuous innovation, we are committed to setting the industry standard in aviation culinary, airline services, last-mile logistics, and retail commerce. From the kitchen to the runway, our teams work together to deliver quality, reliability, and service at every altitude. Our people are the heart of everything we do. At SkyChefs, a career is more than a job – it’s an opportunity to grow, lead, and make an impact in a fast-paced, team-driven environment. Join America’s first, foremost, and finest and take your career to new heights.

**Role Purpose Statement**
--------------------------

The plays a vital role in supporting an efficient and reliable supply chain by sourcing, purchasing, and managing assigned categories of goods and services. This position is responsible for developing and maintaining strong supplier relationships while ensuring the timely availability of products needed to support daily operations.

Key responsibilities include procuring produce, frozen foods, and other food-related commodities, monitoring inventory levels, and managing expired or obsolete inventory to minimize waste, control costs, and maximize operational efficiency.

Working closely with internal stakeholders, vendors, and Customer Service Center teams, the Buyer helps drive supply chain performance by ensuring product availability, maintaining cost-effective purchasing practices, and supporting the delivery of exceptional service to both internal and external customers. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound decision-making, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

**Main Accountabilities**
-------------------------

* Conduct market research on products, suppliers, and pricing to identify sources that meet customer specifications, quality standards, and business requirements.
* Monitor product costs and market trends, proactively recommending solutions to mitigate the impact of price fluctuations.
* Strategically source food ingredients and products to achieve the optimal balance of cost, quality, and availability while meeting customer and Retail Sales requirements.
* Coordinate purchasing activities with vendors, including pricing updates, order cancellations, discontinued items, approved substitutions, backorders, delivery schedule changes, and invoice discrepancy resolution.
* Prepare, analyze, and maintain ingredient costing throughout the menu development process, incorporating supplier cost revisions as needed.
* Leverage knowledge of product availability, supplier capabilities, and industry innovations to recommend standardized products and value-driven solutions to customers.
* Support customer projects by ensuring purchases align with negotiated pricing agreements and established sourcing strategies.
* Assist with menu presentation preparation, including ordering product samples, confirming receipt, and collaborating with Category Managers to validate ingredient and packaging costs.
* Partner with Program Management and Pricing teams to ensure sourced products meet customer specifications and program requirements.
* Establish and maintain new product records within distribution and internal LSG systems.
* Collaborate with Customer Service Centers (CSC) to minimize dead stock inventory through resale opportunities, inventory transfers, or salvage solutions.
* Negotiate supplier agreements, evaluate vendor quotations, and ensure competitive pricing and product specifications through strategic sourcing and supplier benchmarking.
* Support Quality Assurance initiatives by collecting and maintaining product specifications, nutritional information, and related documentation.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Customer satisfaction and responsiveness
* On-time and within-budget completion of sourcing and customer projects
* Product cost optimization and savings achievement
* Supplier performance and service levels
* Inventory management and reduction of excess/dead stock
* Process efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives
* Compliance with customer specifications, quality standards, and purchasing policies

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**
------------------------------------

1 to 3 years of purchasing, procurement, supply chain, or related experience required
Working knowledge of SAP preferred
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain effective relationships with internal stakeholders and business partners

#### **Summary**

Responsible for the purchase of multiple commodities including raw materials, machined components, outside processing, and support services. Responsible for negotiating with manufacturers or service providers on prices and deliver dates to make sure they are in line with company goals and needs.

#### **Job Duties and Responsibilities**

Other tasks and duties may be required as directed.

* Create purchase orders (POs) for Raw material, Machined parts, Purchased parts and OSP Processes.
* Create Request for Quote (RFQ) for Raw material, Machined parts, Purchased parts and OSP Processes.
* Use discretion and independent judgment to procure components, materials and equipment that meet demand while making decisions on economic order quantities factoring in considerations such as price, delivery costs, demand levels, timing, market trends and potential for design changes/obsolescence.
* Align product deliveries to minimize inventory while ensuring that production and service needs are being met.
* Assess financial and schedule risks in order to recommend volume buys, etc.
* Review key purchasing drivers (lead time, safety stock, lot size) and identify areas where drivers need to be adjusted to ensure it meets the current needs of the business.
* Using quantitative skills/methods to analyze components/raw materials costs.
* Perform variance analyses for price changes.
* Monitor delinquent PO reports and Reschedule reports to ensure delivery needs are met.
* Follow up with suppliers on delivery of orders and manage change issues as they occur.
* Assist reconciling open PO report for accuracy, past due items, and work with accounting regarding invoicing discrepancies.
* Maintain suppliers’ manufacturing schedules to support in-house production.

#### **Qualification Requirements**

* **Education/Experience**
+ Bachelor’s Degree (B.A. or B.S.) from four-year college or university; or two to four years’ experience and/or training in a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* **Language Skills**
+ Good command of the English language, both written and spoken.
+ Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
+ Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
+ Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
+ Ability to speak effectively before small groups of customers or employees.
* **Math Skills**
+ Must have the ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Must be capable to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.
+ Must be capable to calculate figures and amounts, such as, discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume.
+ Must have the ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry.
* **Reasoning Skills**
+ Must have the ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Must be capable to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions, such as, mathematical, and/or diagram form, and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
* **Computer/ Office Skills**
+ Basic windows/internet browser
+ ERP/Inventory
+ Microsoft Office – Excel, Word, Power Point
+ Typing
+ 10-key
+ Blueprint Reading
+ Strong knowledge of raw materials
+ Mil standards, processing specifications

#### **Physical Demands and Work Environment**

* **Physical Demands**
+ Frequent Activities: Sitting, typing, handling objects, reaching, talking/hearing, lifting/pushing/pulling up to 10 lbs.
+ Occasional activities: Standing, walking, , lifting/pushing/pulling up to 25 lbs
+ Rare activities: Climbing/balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, lifting/pushing/pulling heavy weights (50–100+ lbs)
* **Vision Requirements**
+ Frequent: Close vision and computer work
+ Occasional: Ability to adjust focus and color vision
+ Rare: Distance vision, depth perception, peripheral vision
* **Work Environment**
+ Frequent exposure: Quiet noise conditions
+ Occasional exposure: Mechanical parts, fumes, airborne particles, toxic chemicals, and moderate-to-loud noise.
+ Rare exposure: High places, outdoor weather, electrical shock, and vibrations, and very quiet or very loud noise levels.

#### **About Crissair, Inc.**

Since 1954, Crissair has manufactured high-quality precision components for nearly every airframe manufacturer and major subcontractor in the industry for both military and commercial aircraft. Crissair’s primary objective is designing, developing and manufacturing superior quality hydraulic, fuel and pneumatic system components of all complexity levels. Strict design specifications and rigorous quality criteria are the essential factors in Criss

description:
Are you a highly organized and detail-oriented Buyer ready to be at the center of a fast-paced manufacturing environment? Exxelia is seeking a dedicated individual to manage purchasing activities for our manufacturing goods and services. In this role, you will be instrumental in a variety of essential functions, from preparing and tracking purchase orders to negotiating with suppliers to ensure cost-effectiveness and timely delivery. If you're a proactive problem-solver with a knack for building strong supplier relationships, this is an excellent opportunity to make a tangible impact on our operational success.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage all purchasing activities by preparing, approving, and tracking purchase orders, ensuring accuracy in the Sage MRP system, and resolving any issues related to specifications, pricing, or delivery with suppliers.
* Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with suppliers through regular communication and negotiation of pricing, quality, and delivery schedules.
* Collaborate with the sourcing team to identify and evaluate new and alternative suppliers for specific commodities and custom designs.
* Partner with the production staff to maintain inventory accuracy in the Sage MRP system for automatic re-order points.
* Work closely with the Quality Assurance team to uphold and improve purchasing standards in line with ISO, AS9100, and 13485 regulations.
* Contribute to overall operational goals by partnering with the Finance team on reporting and inventory management, and by participating in planning and decision-making to achieve targets in product cost, quality, inventory, and delivery.
* Facilitate product validation, first article inspection, incoming inspection, and source inspection processes.
* Manage and resolve invoice discrepancies.
* Perform additional duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience as a Buyer or similar role in a manufacturing environment.
* Proven ability to source, select and manage a diverse supply base.
* Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Excel.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
* High school diploma or equivalent.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with an MRP system, inventory management and cost/price analysis.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing standards – ISO, 13485, FDA, AS9100.

Exxelia is committed to equal opportunity for all, without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic.

Job Type: Full-time

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Will you now, or in the future, require sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g. H-1B visa status)?

Ability to Commute:

* Longwood, FL 32750 (Required)

Work Location: In person

description:
Dewberry is seeking a **Procurement Assistant/Buyer** in our corporate headquarters located in Fairfax VA. Reporting to the Procurement Manager, the selected candidate will support the procurement team by managing procurement tasks, tracking inventory, consulting with vendors, and assisting in product selection and pricing strategies. The Buyer shall conduct business in accordance with the standard operating procedures of this organization and/or in accordance with company best practices.

*Dewberry is a leading, market-facing professional services firm with more than 60 locations and 2,500 professionals nationwide. What sets us apart from our competitors are our people. At Dewberry, we seek out exceptional talent and strive to deliver the highest quality of services to our clients. Whether you’re an experienced professional or a new graduate, you’ll have the chance to collaborate with the best and brightest and work on innovative and complex projects at the forefront of the industry. Our commitment to excellence stems from our personal integrity and from other defining attributes, which we call “Dewberry at Work,” that have inspired our employees to be successful for more than a half-century.*

* Receive and review requisitions for completeness, accuracy, and clarity
* Conduct market research for assigned commodities and identify potential suppliers
* Perform initial evaluation and screening of potential suppliers
* Prepare purchase orders in accordance with procurement policies
* Oversee Dewberry supplier’s portals (review and approve orders entered, etc.)
* Monitor and expedite orders to ensure timely delivery and resolve delays
* Manage discrepancies during the receiving process, including 2/3-way matching
* Reconcile invoices and coordinate with Accounts Payable as needed
* Provide ERP user assistance and support for ERP system training
* Oversee and manage special projects assigned
* Supports day-to-day procurement activities

* High School Diploma or equivalent required; bachelor’s degree preferred
* 1+ years of experience in procurement/purchasing or related field preferred
* Strong analytical, organizational, and time management skills
* Strong understanding of procurement principles and practices
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
* Experience with Deltek Vantagepoint a plus
* Ability to multitask, work under pressure and maintain mindfulness

*Don’t meet every single requirement? At Dewberry we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace for our employee’s. So if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the position description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may just be the right candidate for this or other opportunities.*

* At this time, Dewberry will not sponsor a new applicant for work authorization.
* Dewberry is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or sexual orientation.
* All recipients of an offer of employment from Dewberry, will be required to submit to a background screening which may include, but is not limited to, employment verification, educational and other credential verification, driving record check, criminal background check, and an investigative consumer report. These screenings will be conducted by Dewberry’s background vendor of choice and will be conducted in compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local law.

Eugenus, Inc. is seeking an experienced, highly motivated **Senior Buyer** to support the procurement and strategic sourcing of materials, components, equipment, and services for our next-generation semiconductor capital equipment products.

The Senior Buyer will manage assigned suppliers and commodities throughout the procurement lifecycle, from sourcing and supplier selection through negotiation, purchase order execution, delivery, and supplier performance management. This position will play an important role in ensuring material availability, controlling costs, reducing supply-chain risk, and supporting both New Product Introduction (NPI) and production requirements.

The successful candidate will work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Planning, Finance, Program Management, and global procurement teams to ensure suppliers meet Eugenus requirements for **quality, cost, delivery, technology, and responsiveness**.

This position requires a combination of strong purchasing execution, commercial negotiation skills, technical understanding, analytical capability, and proactive supplier management.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Sourcing & Procurement**

* Develop and execute sourcing strategies for assigned commodities and suppliers that support business objectives for cost, quality, delivery, and supply continuity.
* Lead RFQ/RFP activities, including supplier identification, quote solicitation, bid analysis, supplier selection, and commercial negotiations.
* Evaluate suppliers based on quality, technical capability, capacity, cost, lead time, responsiveness, financial considerations, and overall supply-chain risk.
* Negotiate pricing and commercial terms, including lead times, minimum order quantities, payment terms, delivery requirements, cancellation/rescheduling provisions, and other applicable terms.
* Identify and implement opportunities for competitive sourcing, dual sourcing, localization, and supplier consolidation where appropriate.
* Evaluate total cost of ownership when making sourcing and supplier-selection decisions.

**Purchasing & Material Management**

* Manage Purchase Requisition (PR) and Purchase Order (PO) processes supporting R&D and Production.
* Analyze purchase requisitions for accuracy, completeness, specifications, required dates, and appropriate approvals.
* Place and manage purchase orders and provide timely delivery and schedule feedback to internal stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate supplier pricing, lead-time, delivery, and purchasing information within SAP/ERP systems.
* Update product BOMs and purchasing information records with current lead times and pricing.
* Monitor open purchase orders, past-due orders, shortages, and critical material requirements and proactively resolve delivery issues.
* Execute material and trace transactions within the ERP system.
* Maintain accurate delivery schedules in ERP, Material Status reports, and applicable Program Management planning tools.
* Review Clean to Start (CTS) requirements and take appropriate procurement actions to support Engineering Project Plans and Production schedules.

**Supplier Management & Performance**

* Develop and maintain strong working relationships with key suppliers.
* Establish, monitor, and communicate supplier performance against key metrics, including:
+ On-Time Delivery (OTD)
+ Quality
+ Cost
+ Lead time
+ Responsiveness
+ Capacity and supply continuity
* Conduct periodic supplier performance reviews and drive corrective actions when performance does not meet expectations.
* Partner with Quality, Engineering, and Manufacturing to resolve supplier quality issues and support supplier corrective-action activities.
* Work with suppliers to improve delivery performance, reduce lead times, improve quality, and increase overall supply-chain effectiveness.
* Escalate significant supplier performance, capacity, quality, or commercial issues in a timely manner.

**Cost Management & Continuous Improvement**

* Identify, negotiate, implement, and track cost-reduction and cost-avoidance opportunities.
* Analyze supplier quotes, historical pricing, market conditions, and cost drivers to support fact-based negotiations.
* Support annual and project-specific cost-reduction objectives.

description:
About Us:

Welcome to Quality Stainless Inc., founded in 1985 in Minneapolis, MN. We serve the sanitary food and beverage, biopharm, semiconductor, and industrial stainless steel markets as a stocking distributor of 304L and 316L, aluminum, and other specialty alloys. We specialize in quick turnaround custom fabrication and machining, solving system problems and advising on liquid, gas, and vacuum applications.

Visit our Website: qualitystainless.net

Job Description:

The Buyer is an early-career procurement professional who supports purchasing activities across multiple distribution sites in the industrial PVF (pipe, valves, and fittings) industry. Independently purchases assigned commodity/product categories; understands schedule, class, material, and connection requirements; manages suppliers; analyzes inventory; handles shortages; understands documentation requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Execute purchasing activities for direct and indirect materials to support business operations across multiple sites.
* Create, release, and manage purchase orders in the ERP system, ensuring accuracy of pricing, quantities, and delivery dates.
* Coordinate with suppliers to confirm orders, track shipments, and resolve delivery, quality, or invoice discrepancies.
* Support multi-site material requirements by monitoring demand signals, inventory levels, and transfer needs.
* Maintain and update ERP item master data, including lead times, reorder points, reorder quantities, supplier assignments and product pricing.
* Collaborate with production planning, operations, and logistics teams to ensure material availability aligns with production schedules.
* Assist in supplier performance tracking, including on-time delivery and responsiveness metrics.
* Support sourcing and cost-reduction initiatives by gathering supplier data, quotes, and market information.
* Ensure procurement transactions comply with company policies and established purchasing procedures.
* Participate in continuous improvement efforts related to purchasing processes, data accuracy, and supplier communication.

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* 2–4 years of purchasing, materials, or supply chain experience within the industrial plastics industry.
* Exposure to multi-site purchasing or distribution environments required.
* Experience using ERP/MRP systems in a manufacturing or distribution environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.

**Background, Skills, and Abilities**
-------------------------------------

* Foundational understanding of Metallic industrial Piping, valves, and fittings, suppliers, and manufacturing processes with comprehension of grades, finishes, forms, and related processing services.
* Able to recognize standards/ specifications such as ASTM, ASME, ANSI, and sanitary/hygienic requirements applicable
* Up to date with the current industrial PVF market to negotiate for competitive pricing
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and respond effectively to changing production needs.
* Effective communication skills for working with suppliers and internal teams.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to identify purchasing and inventory issues.
* Desire to grow into advanced sourcing, planning, and leadership roles within procurement.

* Utilizes the FAR and DFARS daily for compliance
* Works with various departments on a daily basis such as program management, planning, manufacturing operations accounting, quality, and engineering, shipping, and receiving
* Assists and advises user agency staff and maintains contacts with vendors
* Requires daily use of high-level communication—including written and verbal skills
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Education:**

* Ability to obtain and maintain DoD security clearance if/when required

Any combination of education/experience may be substituted for job requirements at the recommendation of the hiring manager and approval of the COO and CEO*.*

Overview:

Reporting to a Team Lead, Supervisor or Manager, the Buyer I is in an entry-level administrative professional responsible for the proposal or procurement of low dollar, high volume commodities and/or services.

Responsibilities:

* **Proposals:**
+ Reviews the Bill of Material (BOM); creates a Request for Quote (RFQ) form; contacts vendors for quote information; follows up on quote requests; prepares completed proposal packet for review by team lead or manager
+ Works with team lead to ensure BOM details are present; works with departments and program managers for clarification
+ Processes proposals per departmental procedures; continues to revalidate the proposals until win/loss
* **Procurement:**
+ Receives Purchase Requisition list (PR) and prioritizes per program needs; verifies pricing and delivery is current; applies purchase order (PO); verifies and enters any missing information in Costpoint; creates electronic folder for review and approval of all purchase orders
+ Notifies the Program Manager of any part, delivery or other discrepancies for review and approval prior to proceeding with Purchase Order (PO) placement
+ May complete a QA104 part number change request form
+ Submits PO to vendor for acceptance; follows up as required; cancels PO as required
+ Has minimal knowledge to source parts and services; relies on pricing history to select vendors
+ Utilizes the Approved Vendor List; develops vendor relationships; may identify new vendors; makes recommendation to leadership
+ Utilizes system generated reports for quotation data, backup justification, work assignments and PO past due dates
+ Communicates effectively; ensures system notes are provided; requests assistance with purchasing efforts; may respond to facility inquiries and issues to support the purchasing process
+ Utilizes the FAR and DFARS daily for compliance.
+ Performs other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

**Education:**

* High School Diploma or GED required; Bachelors’ degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Contracts Procurement, Finance/Accounting or equitable field preferred

**Experience:**

* Previous purchasing experience preferred; one-year experience in buying equipment, supplies, parts, services a plus

Any combination of education/experience may be substituted for job requirements at the recommendation of the hiring manager and approval of the COO or higher.

Overview:

GCG Custom Engineered Solutions is currently seeking a Buyer to join the Custom Engineered Solutions procurement team!

As a Buyer with our procurement team, you will be responsible for planning and purchasing the raw materials needed to support our cable assembly operations. You’ll play a key role in ensuring materials are available to meet production demand while maintaining appropriate inventory levels, cost control, and supplier performance.

This role requires close coordination with internal teams and suppliers to manage demand signals, execute purchase orders, and maintain a steady flow of materials through the operation. Your work will directly support on-time delivery and overall operational efficiency.

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 7:00am to 4:00pm EST

### **What You’ll Do**

**Procurement Execution & Order Management**

* Manage purchase orders from requisition through receipt, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and alignment with production requirements
* Procure raw materials, MRO, and services at optimal cost, quality, and lead time
* Monitor open orders and proactively manage delivery schedules to prevent shortages or disruptions

**Material Planning & Inventory Management**

* Review MRP outputs in Oracle to plan and maintain appropriate inventory levels for assigned commodities
* Establish and adjust safety stock levels in alignment with production needs and business objectives
* Balance inventory investment with service level expectations to support efficient operations

**Supplier Management & Sourcing**

* Source and evaluate suppliers, obtain quotations, and negotiate pricing and lead times
* Build and maintain strong supplier relationships to support reliability and continuous improvement
* Participate in supplier performance reviews and support corrective actions as needed

**Operational & Cross-Functional Support**

* Partner with production, engineering, and supply chain teams to align material availability with manufacturing schedules
* Resolve material issues including shortages, quality concerns, and supplier discrepancies
* Support cost reduction initiatives and process improvements across the procurement function
* Maintain accurate data and transaction integrity within ERP and procurement systems

### **What You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, or related field preferred
* 3–5 years of experience in a purchasing, buyer, or materials planning role within a manufacturing environment
* Experience working with MRP/ERP systems (Oracle strongly preferred)
* Strong understanding of material planning, inventory control, and procurement processes
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, production-driven environment
* Effective communication and negotiation skills with both internal teams and external suppliers
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and standard business applications
* Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy, follow-through, and problem-solving

### **What We Offer**

* Competitive base salary ranging from $60,000 to $65,000, dependent on relevant experience
* Comprehensive health coverage with multiple plan options (CDHP and PPO)
* Company-paid life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, supplemental insurance options
* Generous time off including PTO, paid holidays, parental leave, and compassionate care leave
* Wellness and support programs (EAP, wellness incentives, telehealth)
* Extras including dental/vision, FSAs/HSAs with company contributions, pet insurance, legal services, and ID theft protection
* An employee-centric culture that values and truly appreciates our most important asset: You!

### **Our Use of AI in Recruiting**

At GCG, we use AI technology to assist with our interviews by automating note-taking, allowing our hiring teams to focus fully on the conversation. This technology supports efficiency and accuracy in capturing candidate insights during interviews but is not used to evaluate resumes. All resume reviews and candidate assessments are conducted directly by our corporate recruiting team and hiring managers to ensure a thoughtful, human-centered approach.

### **About Custom Engineered Solutions (CES)**

GCG Custom Engineered Solutions delivers innovative wire and cable solutions, serving industries including renewable energy, data communications, industrial applications, irrigation, and more. We are committed to engineering excellence, customer-driven innovation, and high-quality products that help businesses solve complex challenges with tailored solutions. Built on a foundation of expertise, flexibility, and humility, we are dedicated to solving customer challenges, adapting to their needs, and continuously improving.

Overview:

**Job Title: Buyer**

**Job Location: Torrance, CA**

**Salary: $70,000-$85,000/yr DOE**

Stellant Systems, a premier manufacturer of critical power amplification products where our technologies and products are unparalleled in the industry. We specialize in the manufacture of microwave devices for ground-based, airborne and satellite communications, industrial and medical equipment, and radar; we are the only U.S. supplier of space-qualified Traveling Wave Tube and Traveling Wave Tube Amplifiers. We combine cutting-edge technology with world-class engineering teams to deliver innovative solutions. Together, we form an invincible company.

As an employer of choice, our goal is to deliver an exceptional employee experience - we recruit diverse, high-performing talent to help our customers exceed their mission needs, which drives our employees to achieve their full potential.

Fundamental to our culture is our focus on core values, inclusivity in the work environment, and a unified dedication to continuous innovation and improvement. In order to serve our vast customer base ranging from the defense industry leaders, to the U.S. and allied militaries, and medical communities, we need the world’s most dedicated and talented people. If these types of projects excite you, we’d love for you to join our team and help us detect, protect, and connect.

Responsibilities:

* Compiles and analyzes statistical data to determine feasibility of buying products and to establish price objectives.
* Approves and qualifies vendors, obtains quotes, examines bids and makes awards
* Follows up on all awards through completion of order
* Negotiates with suppliers and analyzes suppliers’ operations to determine factors that affect prices and to determine lowest cost consistent with quality, reliability, and ability to meet required schedules
* Reviews proposals, negotiates prices, selects, or recommends suppliers, analyzes trends, and maintains necessary records
* Prepares request for proposals (RFP) and bid packages
* Negotiates and settles with suppliers regarding damage claims, rejections, losses, return of materials, over-shipments, cancellations, and engineering changes, within their signature authority
* Obtains quotes, negotiate, and procure materials and services for the best value
* Prepares required paperwork for Purchase Order package, shippers, RFPs/RFQs, supplier and interdepartmental correspondence, etc.
* Verifies accuracy of all documentation such as supplier proposals to purchase orders, file documentation, invoices and receipts, and sign purchase orders
* Interfaces with current and potential suppliers to determine best price and delivery for current requirements and remains abreast of economic and business situations relating to procurement activity
* Maintains total ownership of supplier’s deliveries. Actions taken could include obtaining prints, samples, delivery dates, corrective action, and resolution to discrepant materials. Will likely involve negotiating with supplier when supplier caused rework occurs
* Processes rejected materials back to supplier in a timely manner after receipt of dispositioned NMR.
* Develops new vendors and participates with Engineering in the evaluation and selection of alternate source of supply in accordance with internal policies and procedures
* Responsible for reporting accurate and up to date information both in MRP and in production team meetings. Due to working in a lean production environment, the buyer shall strive to meet a performance metric of 100% current data in both MRP and in shortage reporting in accordance with company procedures
* Interfaces with Engineering and Planning regarding drawing discrepancies, B.O.M., and EO’s. Works with Program Managers on problems which affect meeting contract requirements
* Makes periodic visits to manufacturers and suppliers to ensure that procurement standards are being maintained
* Conducts desk audits on a weekly basis to determine if their desk “queue” is meeting company standards of placing requisitions, updating purchase orders, processing RTVs, invoice resolution, and tracking to completion to avoid delivery impact, and ensure suppliers are meeting current quality acceptance and on time delivery goals
* Other assignments as identified by the Procurement Manager

Qualifications:

**For** **Associate, Procurement (Level 1)**

* Bachelor's degree and 0-2 years of related experience, Master's degree, OR 3 years of experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Strong communication skills
* Demonstrated teamwork orientation
* Strong organizational skills
* Excel and other technical skills that help identify areas for supplier performance improvement
* Ability to work in a very fast paced environment

**For** **Sr. Associate, Procurement (Level 2)**

* Bachelor's degree and at least 2 years of related experience, a Master's degree OR 6 years of experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

**Buyer**

Location: Plymouth, MI
Company: Optimal-EV
Employment Type: Full-Time
Start: Immediate / ASAP

**About Optimal-EV**

Optimal-EV is an innovative electric vehicle manufacturer focused on developing and producing next-generation electric shuttle buses and mobility solutions. We are seeking an experienced Buyer to join our team in Plymouth, Michigan and support our growing manufacturing and purchasing operations.

**Position Summary**

The Buyer will be responsible for purchasing a broad range of materials, components, parts, and services required to support Optimal-EV's manufacturing and engineering operations.

The ideal candidate will have at least 5 years of purchasing experience in an automotive supplier, manufacturing, or small-to-mid-sized business environment. We are particularly interested in candidates who have broad purchasing experience and have been involved with multiple types of materials, components, suppliers, and purchasing activities.

Experience with NetSuite is preferred but not required.

**Key Responsibilities**

Manage day-to-day purchasing activities for production, engineering, and operational requirements.

Purchase a variety of materials, components, parts, and services needed to support manufacturing operations.

Create and manage purchase orders, ensuring accurate pricing, quantities, specifications, and delivery requirements.

Identify and evaluate suppliers based on cost, quality, delivery, and capability.

Request and evaluate supplier quotes and negotiate pricing, lead times, and commercial terms.

Communicate directly with suppliers regarding pricing, availability, delivery schedules, quality concerns, and other purchasing matters.

Monitor open purchase orders and proactively address late or delayed deliveries.

Work closely with Engineering and Manufacturing teams to understand material requirements, specifications, and timing.

Review BOMs, part numbers, material requirements, and other purchasing information.

Coordinate with suppliers to ensure materials are available when needed to support production schedules.

Partner with Quality and suppliers to resolve material and supplier-related issues.

Maintain accurate purchasing records, supplier information, and purchase order data.

Support supplier onboarding and maintain strong supplier relationships.

Monitor material availability and help prevent production shortages.

Identify opportunities for cost savings and improved purchasing efficiency.

Support inventory and material planning activities.

Assist with developing and maintaining supplier performance metrics.

Ensure purchasing activities follow company policies and established processes.

Take ownership of purchasing issues and drive them through resolution.

**Required Qualifications**

Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Purchasing, Operations, Engineering, or a related field.

Minimum of 5 years of purchasing, buying, procurement, or related experience.

Experience working in an automotive supplier, manufacturing company, or small-to-mid-sized business environment.

Strong understanding of purchasing processes, supplier management, purchase orders, pricing, lead times, and material requirements.

Demonstrated experience managing multiple purchasing categories, suppliers, and components.

Strong negotiation, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work independently and take ownership of purchasing activities.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience with NetSuite or another ERP/MRP system.

Automotive manufacturing or automotive supplier experience.

Experience purchasing a broad range of mechanical, electrical, fabricated, machined, or other manufacturing components.

Experience working with engineering drawings, BOMs, part numbers, and material specifications.

Experience with supplier cost negotiations and cost-reduction initiatives.

Experience supporting new product development or production launches.

Knowledge of EV manufacturing and/or electric vehicle components is a plus.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a hands-on Buyer who has broad exposure to purchasing and understands how purchasing decisions directly impact manufacturing operations.

Candidates coming from automotive suppliers, contract manufacturers, or small-to-mid-sized manufacturing companies are strongly preferred because these environments typically provide broader exposure to different commodities, suppliers, components, and purchasing activities.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable wearing multiple hats, working directly with suppliers, supporting Engineering and Manufacturing, resolving material shortages, negotiating pricing, and taking ownership from purchase order placement through delivery.

**Hiring Timeline**
