As a Sr. Buyer, you will be primarily accountable for overseeing the implementation of safety programs, manufacturing schedules, personnel, quality control, and production standards.

**What will you do?**

* Plan, manage, lead, and engage in daily production operations to achieve the key performance indicators (safety, on time delivery, quality, and productivity)
+ Promote and implement ergonomic principles, environmental responsibility and overall employee health and wellness
+ Provide world-class service to internal and external customers
+ Reports to Supply Chain Manager and directly leads a team of front-line supervisors with an indirect scope of hourly workforce across 3 shifts (Mon-Fri).
+ Lead efforts to attain internal certification goals, ISO requirements, and total customer satisfaction
+ Coach, mentor and develop all direct reports
+ Ensure compliance with all quality systems to achieve the required quality levels
+ Manage performance of assigned resources (material, methods, labor, machines)
+ Participate in the development of the Master Production Schedule
+ Champion Lean Manufacturing Initiatives (Schneider Performance System) to drive continuous improvement throughout the plant.
+ Be responsible for people management including goal setting, performance management, competency development, recognition, engagement, and well-being.
+ Define training goals according to competencies and targets
+ Lead change management in accordance with business and plant objectives
+ Promote collaboration, diversity and inclusion within the plant and the organization
+ Lead and coordinate the implementation of programs which support manufacturing strategies & goals

(External) English Qualifications:

**What qualifications will make you successful?**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering or related field is required
+ 5+ years of experience of management and leadership in a manufacturing environment
+ Ability to excel in fast paced, high performance environment
+ Previous experience with P&L responsibility
+ Solid understanding of OSHA guidelines and leading a strong safety culture
+ Experience in the application of Lean Manufacturing methodologies, certification a plus
+ Building a culture of responsiveness and continuous improvement
+ Ability to drive Employee Engagement through leadership, communication, and building the respect at all levels of the organization
+ ISO experience is a plus
+ Strong organizational and analytical skills, results driven, ability to effectively communicate at all levels of the organization
+ Flexible and available to work on off shifts
+ Excellent PC/Tablet and system knowledge, including the ability to analyze data within an MRP system, cloud based platforms (Tableau/AVEVA) and make effective assumptions to drive business results
+ Experience implementing or developing Smart Factory/Digital Factory initiatives

KDC is a network of best-in-class custom formulators and manufacturers of color cosmetics, skincare, haircare, bath & body, fragrance, deodorant, home, health, industrial, and auto care products. KDC delivers high-touch innovation, operational excellence, and speed to market to well-known and emerging beauty, personal, and specialty companies from coast to coast. KDC has its head office in Longueuil, Québec. In addition, KDC has 10 operating facilities located throughout North America. Altogether, the company employs nearly 4,800 talented and dedicated employees in North America.

Purchasing Buyer-Supply Chain

kdc/one | Groveport, OH | Onsite

kdc/one is a global leader in custom formulation, package design, and manufacturing solutions for beauty, personal care, and home care brands. The company focuses on high-touch innovation, operational excellence, and rapid speed to market for many of the world’s most recognized brands. Supported by approximately 15,000 employees, kdc/one develops and launches thousands of products each year. The organization co-develops products for more than 1,000 brands, offering exposure to diverse projects and markets for team members.

Are you a purchasing professional who enjoys negotiating, solving problems, and making sure the right materials are available when they’re needed? kdc/one is looking for an experienced Buyer to join our Supply Chain team in Groveport, Ohio.

This is an onsite opportunity where you’ll play an important role in supporting production, managing supplier relationships, controlling costs, and keeping materials flowing efficiently.

Why Join kdc/one?

We believe great people deserve more than just a job. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you both at work and beyond, including:

* Competitive compensation based on experience
* 5% annual bonus opportunity
* Medical, dental and vision benefits
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Company-paid holidays
* Career growth and development opportunities
* And more!

What You'll Do

* Purchase raw materials, equipment, tools, parts, supplies and services to support production needs
* Review material requirements and utilize MRP to plan purchasing activities
* Negotiate and manage vendor costs while meeting site requirements
* Build and maintain strong supplier relationships while monitoring cost, quality and service
* Place purchase orders and coordinate delivery schedules
* Monitor inventory levels, lead times and supplier capacity
* Expedite or delay deliveries as customer and production needs change
* Maintain accurate material information and purchasing data in SAP
* Partner with Quality, Production, Finance, Inventory Control and suppliers to resolve material and purchasing issues
* Review and approve purchasing documentation and invoices
* Help manage slow-moving and obsolete inventory
* Support continuous improvement of purchasing processes and workflows

What We're Looking For

* 3+ years of experience in a Buyer/Purchasing role
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering or a related field preferred; equivalent manufacturing experience will be considered
* Manufacturing experience strongly preferred
* Experience with SAP/ERP systems and MRP
* Strong negotiation, problem-solving and organizational skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across departments
* APICS or C.P.I.M. certification is a plus

The Environment

This is an onsite role based at our Groveport manufacturing facility. While you'll spend time in an office environment, you'll also regularly interact with our production floor and warehouse operations.

**Location:** Groveport, OH

If you're ready to take the next step in your purchasing career and make a direct impact on operations, we'd like to hear from you.

Seniority Level

Mid-Senior level

Industry

Industrial Machinery Manufacturing

Employment Type

Full-time

KDC-ONE is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, age, sex, gender, disability or any other characteristic protected by law. I understand that employment with KDC-ONE Company is at-will, meaning that I or KDC-ONE Company may terminate my employment at any time, or for any reason consistent with applicable state or federal law. I understand that KDC-One requires the successful completion of a drug and/or alcohol test as a condition of employment.

description:
Technical Buyer - Electric Motors

**Department:** Purchasing

**Location:** FEDCO Headquarters, Monroe, Michigan

**Employment Status:** Full-Time, Exempt

**Reports To:** Supply Chain Manager

**Position Summary**
====================

The Technical Buyer - Electric Motors sources and manages electric motors, variable frequency drives (VFDs), and related components for FEDCO products and customer projects. This purchasing role requires the technical knowledge to evaluate requirements, compare proposals, identify specification gaps, and coordinate questions with Engineering, Sales, Quality, and suppliers.

The position owns quotations, purchase orders, pricing, delivery performance, negotiations, and supplier relationships while balancing cost, quality, lead time, compliance, and customer requirements.

**Essential Responsibilities**
==============================

**Purchasing and Order Execution**
----------------------------------

* Request, evaluate, and compare supplier quotations for motors, VFDs, accessories, and related components.
* Create and manage purchase orders; verify pricing, quantities, specifications, documentation, and delivery dates.
* Resolve supplier acknowledgement discrepancies involving configuration, price, lead time, freight, warranty, or terms.
* Monitor open orders and delivery commitments; escalate risks and drive recovery actions.
* Maintain accurate ERP data and coordinate expedites, changes, cancellations, returns, warranty claims, and corrective actions.

**Technical Motor Purchasing**
------------------------------

* Review motor data sheets, drawings, customer specifications, and application requirements to confirm the required configuration.
* Compare ratings, voltage, frequency, speed, frame, enclosure, efficiency, mounting, duty, hazardous-area requirements, and accessories.
* Identify exceptions or missing information and coordinate approvals with Engineering, Sales, Quality, customers, and suppliers.
* Confirm NEMA or IEC construction, regional electrical requirements, and certifications; support motor and VFD sourcing without assuming final design authority.

**Supplier Sourcing and Commercial Management**
-----------------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain qualified domestic and global sources for standard and engineered motor requirements.
* Negotiate pricing, lead times, payment terms, freight, warranties, minimum quantities, stocking arrangements, and supply agreements.
* Evaluate total landed cost, including freight, tariffs, duties, quality risk, lead time, and inventory impact.
* Support supplier qualification and performance reviews; track quality, delivery, responsiveness, cost, technical support, market conditions, and supply risks.

**Cross-Functional Support and Improvement**
--------------------------------------------

* Partner with Planning and Operations on forecasts, inventory, shortages, and project priorities.
* Support product development, engineering changes, value analysis, standardization, and cost reduction.
* Provide motor pricing, lead-time, sourcing, and technical information for quotations and customer orders.
* Maintain supplier records and reports, comply with purchasing, quality, and trade requirements, and perform other duties as assigned.

**Performance Expectations**
============================

Success in this role may be evaluated through:

* Supplier quality, delivery, responsiveness, cost control, and technical support.
* Accuracy of sourcing decisions, purchase orders, documentation, and supplier commitments.
* Cost savings, risk avoidance, timely support, clear communication, organized records, and follow-through.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent technical training and relevant experience may be considered.
* Five or more years of purchasing, sourcing, or supplier-management experience involving electric motors, drives, rotating equipment, or industrial electrical components.
* Experience buying three-phase induction motors, working with manufacturers or distributors, developing requests for quotation, comparing proposals, negotiating terms, and managing orders through delivery.
* International sourcing, landed-cost analysis, and engineered-to-order manufacturing experience preferred.
* Working knowledge of ERP/MRP systems, purchasing controls, Microsoft Office, and relevant motor certifications.
* Professional purchasing certification is a plus; ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.

*FEDCO is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.*

description:
The Enviva team is driven by our shared vision for a renewable energy future. We are a fast-growing, purpose-driven, global energy company specializing in delivering sustainable wood bioenergy solutions. We are the world's largest producer of sustainable wood pellets, which provide a low-carbon alternative to fossil fuels.

The Procurement Specialist has an important role in the Procurement Organization with the responsibility for the sourcing of equipment, goods, and services while reducing cost and ensuring on time delivery to meet organizations goals and objectives. This person will be responsible for managing and communicating the requirements of the organization to the supply base. This position will also facilitate the operations and implement procedures for effective stockroom management.

**Responsibilities**

* Evaluate approved requisitions for accuracy and potential cost savings.

* Execute approved purchase orders and distribute to approved vendors.

* Maintain vendor database utilizing current vendors and only adding vendors with added value to the organization.

* Manage relationships with key suppliers to maintain quality of goods, timely delivery and compliance with the organizations terms and conditions.

* Focus on consolidating vendors by developing synergies with other sites within the organization to achieve optimum cost savings.

* Support and implement Procurement leadership cost saving initiatives.

* Measure and hold suppliers accountable for performance as measured in supplier scorecards.

* Manage on-site vendors to ensure all procedures are followed.

* Coordinate with accounting to ensure pricing/invoicing accuracy.

* Assists receiving with delivery discrepancies.

* Support continuous improvement throughout the organization.

* Establish and implement procedures to ensure organization and effectiveness of the stockroom.

* Evaluate and determine proper inventory levels for the stockroom.

* Effectively communicate potential supply disruptions throughout the organization.

* Promote safety initiatives and enforce the organization's safety policies.

* Execute Enviva's OEMS System, Gembas, Coaching, Visual Administration, 5's, Material Strategy, Root Cause Analysis, Material and information flow, 7 wastes, VA and NVA activities, Continuous Improvement, TPM, Communication.

**Qualifications**

* Professional career on engineering, business or related - Desirable

* Strong Background on Commercial Negotiations.

* Stockroom management experience required.

* Professional Level of experience in the manufacturing industry is required.

* Basic knowledge on MRP.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in Purchasing/Materials Management areas.

**Physical Requirements**

* Primarily office-based with periodic visits to manufacturing facilities and warehouses.
* Ability to travel occasionally to supplier locations and company facilities.
* Ability to safely enter industrial environments while wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE).

This position is not eligible for visa support.

**EEO Statement**

Enviva is dedicated to the principles of equal employment opportunity (EEO) in any term, condition or privilege of employment. Enviva does not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, ancestry, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, uniform service member, genetic information or any other status protected by law. Enviva complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which we operate.

**Job Description:**

Location: Remote (Midwest Preferred)

Employment Type: Contract

Afinitas is seeking a Contract Sourcing Specialist to help build candidate pipelines for frontline production and manufacturing positions across multiple locations.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys finding talent, engaging candidates, and helping organizations fill critical manufacturing positions. You'll partner closely with our Talent Acquisition team to identify and connect with production employees, skilled trades professionals, and other manufacturing talent needed to support our growing operations.

While this is a remote position, we are seeking candidates located in the Midwest who are familiar with regional labor markets and manufacturing talent pools.

What You'll Do

* Source candidates for production, assembly, machining, welding, maintenance, and other manufacturing roles.

* Build active talent pipelines across multiple sites and regions.

* Conduct candidate outreach through phone, email, text, social media, and recruiting platforms.

* Screen candidates and assess qualifications, availability, and interest.

* Schedule qualified candidates for interviews with recruiters and hiring managers.

* Maintain candidate records and sourcing activity within our ATS.

* Support hiring campaigns, workforce initiatives, and recruiting events as needed.

* Develop talent pools for recurring and hard-to-fill manufacturing positions.

What We're Looking For

* Experience sourcing or recruiting for manufacturing, production, warehouse, industrial, or skilled trades positions.

* Strong candidate sourcing and outreach skills.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

* Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.

* Experience using recruiting technology, job boards, and sourcing platforms.

* Familiarity with Midwest labor markets and manufacturing talent communities strongly preferred.

* Experience supporting multi-site manufacturing operations is a plus.

Why Join Us

* Flexible contract opportunity.

* Fully remote work environment.

* Opportunity to partner with multiple manufacturing locations and make an immediate impact.

* Collaborative team focused on solving hiring challenges and building strong workforce pipelines.

* Competitive hourly compensation based on experience.

The approximate pay range for this position is $35 - $50/hour. Please note that the pay range is a good faith estimate at the time of posting and may vary based on factors such as experience, skills, and geographic location.

If you're passionate about finding talent and building pipelines that help manufacturing operations succeed, we'd love to hear from you.

The Sr. Strategic Sourcing Manager, Category Partnerships will lead regional Procurement engagement with the global Strategic Sourcing Categories across Direct and Indirect categories on behalf of Mars Snacking North America (MSNA). This Associate will own the Procurement relationship with assigned strategic sourcing categories, and act as the primary point of contact for related business partners. **Job Level Descriptor:**

* Strategic Category Management and Source-to-Contract Activities
* Supplier Relationship Management and Governance
* Regional Leadership and Stakeholder Management

**Primary responsibilities include:**

* Regional Sourcing Commercial Leadership: Directs the end-to-end sourcing strategy and execution for all regionally segmented categories. Provides critical leadership in representation of the region to deliver on key business objectives.
* Global Partnership Performance Accountability: Acts as the primary strategic liaison between the region, center of excellence and Mars Global Services, championing regional needs and priorities. Ensures partners are held accountable for delivering against key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs) for Procurement related activities and objectives.

* 7-10 years of experience with strategic sourcing, supplier/customer management, innovation management and business partnering.
* Total Delivered Cost Reduction and Working Capital Improvements
* Supplier Performance Relationship Management

* Leadership: Proven experience managing cross-functional projects and leading team members in a matrixed or dotted-line reporting environment.
* Negotiation Influence: Exceptional negotiation, stakeholder management, and communication skills to influence both local teams and global corporate centers.
* A passion for driving value for our business by leveraging various sourcing channels.
* Bachelors degree required, Masters degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Finance preferred
* CPSM, CIPs or equivalent preferred

Education Professional Qualifications

* Minimum requirement of Bachelor’s degree in Procurement, Supply Chain/Logistics/Materials Management or Finance and/or the equivalent combination of education and work experience.

* CPM/CPSM, CIPS or other analogous professional certification preferred

description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**Foundry Advanced Packaging Sourcing Manager**

**THE ROLE:**

* Coordinate the management and spend of AMD’s strategic foundry suppliers with specific focus on post fab / advanced packaging services reporting to the Director Foundry Procurement.
* Develop the global procurement strategy for foundry with specific focus on post fab and advanced packaging; implementing a supplier development program that has a coordinated long-term approach on cost, quality, and service.
* Build and maintain supplier relationships.
* Provide analytical support and recommendations regarding sourcing strategies, requirements planning, and cost improvement.

**THE PERSON:**

* Problem Solving Specialist
* Drives sophisticated solutions and recommendations for complex issues through the analysis of the situation and available data.
* Exercises judgment in selecting the methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for acquiring results.
* Networks with key contacts outside area of expertise.
* Excellent communication & people skills.
* Capable of initiating and leading new projects to enable procurement scalability in support of AMD growth.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Collaborate with partners and foundry team members to understand and develop negotiation strategies to drive cost targets.
* Develop, implement, and lead critical foundry procurement management processes based on feedback from team members and partners. This may include (but not limited to): NPI/NRE procurement program management / order execution, Spend/Savings reporting, support emergency ordering process, tracking payables/receivables initiatives, ongoing critical action tracking/reporting and accountability.
* Own the overall driven bidding process including analysis, price negotiation, and driving business awards.
* Implement contracts to minimize AMD risk and enable supplier accountability for non-performance
* Lead Supplier Performance Management (SPM) and be responsible for the quarterly scorecard process to review service levels on cost, technology, quality, service, and flexibility.
* Develop and optimally communicate a foundry post fab / advanced packaging commodity strategy which fully reflects key partner inputs to AMD Senior Management Team. Provide updates on a regular basis to supervise progress against plan.
* Collaborate and formalize foundry post fab / advanced packaging market research and benchmarking processes.
* Collaborates with suppliers to communicate AMD requirements.
* Ownership of spend, savings and forecasting for Foundry post fab / advanced packaging supplier.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**

* Extensive Founry or Semiconductor experience (specific to post fab and advanced packaging service offerings is ideal)
* Strong Engineering background is a plus
* Stong Negotiation and Sourcing skills
* Supply Chain Management (SCM) familiarity
* Experience working in an engineering or semiconductor company
* Understanding of regional and global markets and cultures

**ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:**

BS/BA degree

MBA

**Location:**

Austin, TX

**This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.**

*AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.*

*AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. AMD’s “Responsible AI Policy” is available* *here.*

*This posting is for an existing vacancy.*

job_title: Warehouse Procurement Manager, AWS Cloud Logistics
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. At AWS Cloud Logistics, we support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for warehousing safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

This position is located in Austin, TX.

AWS Infrastructure is looking for a talented, driven, and highly analytical, Contract Logistics Procurement Mgr with a hunger for driving change and impact at a global scale to join AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain (AIS) team. The successful candidate will have strong analytical and communication skills, and a passion for using data to drive business decisions. You are analytical and creative, and you don’t quit until you solve the problem. You thrive by providing data-driven decision support and business intelligence that is timely, accurate, and actionable.

Key job responsibilities

* Lead sourcing, procurement, and contract operations for global contract logistics and warehousing services.
* Establish annual financial plans and create operating rhythms to measure execution vs established targets.
* Build and manage operating rhythms to simplify and automate business processes to ensure compliance with agreed terms and reduce procurement lead times.
* Draft contractual requirements in cooperation with business partners which encourage continued customer focus deliver reduced service costs.
* Manage supplier relationships including contractual negotiations, service performance, capability development.
* Dive deep to uncover areas of opportunity, present written business recommendations, and lead global projects which deliver reduced service costs.

A day in the life

* Recommend, develop, and implement policies that guide the organization in accurately estimating service cost and delivering annual profit and loss (P&L).
* Develop new business relationships and competencies.
* Partner with supply and operations teams to develop capacity models, guide network strategy, and inform capital investment decisions.
* Own Controllership activities including invoice auditing to identify discrepancies.
* Partner with business partners to draft, maintain, and standardize contractual requirements.
* Design exception-based reporting highlighting and analyzing outliers.
* Lead weekly discussions reporting on financial performance to plan and areas of improvement.
* Manage and support finance and accounting activities globally with multiple currencies.

About the team
\\*Why AWS\\*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

\\*Diverse Experiences\\*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

\\*Work/Life Balance\\*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

\\*Inclusive Team Culture\\*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

\\*Mentorship and Career Growth\\*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bac

*First Solar reserves the right to offer you a role most applicable to your experience and skillset.*

**Basic Job Functions:**

Lead procurement cross-functional teams for Tier 2 categories resulting in procurement decisions delivering the highest quality, reliability, and value to meet First Solar requirements. Develop strong business relationships and strategic alliances supporting First Solar’s growth plan.

**Education/Experience:**

* BS/BA degree plus 5 or more years of experience in a related technical or business field or 8 years of experience in a related technical or business field
* Strong knowledge of operational purchasing processes & concepts
* Experience in the glass industry, glass manufacturing, or sourcing of glass and related materials is preferred, but not required.
* ISM and APICS Certification preferred.

**Required Skills/Competencies:**

* Decision Making:
+ Participates with executives to establish strategic plans and objectives.
+ Select, evaluate, and develop category plan objectives in areas of technology, quality, cost, flexibility, and service.
+ Execute projects consistent with achieving overall supply management organizational goals.
+ Implement sourcing decisions based on team consensus to weighted scorecard.
* Problem Solving:

+ Assess, define, and resolve complex supply chain and procurement issues without supervision.
+ Apply root cause analysis and derive corrective actions and assess adequacy of the analyses and plans proposed by suppliers managed.
+ Apply appropriate competitive cost benchmarks, financial analysis, and risk management techniques to solve issues.
+ Able to influence internal customers and executives to achieve mutually beneficial solutions.
* Project Management:

+ Understands and demonstrates advanced project management skills.
+ Demonstrated ability to successfully manage multiple projects at the same time, and to close projects on time.
+ Effectively manages relationships and peer deliverables to successful project completion.
* Interaction:

+ Highly effective communicator, including oral, written and presentation preparation
+ Interacts primarily with peers, senior managers, and executives within First Solar.
+ Interaction requires the ability to influence others, frequently associates with higher position, to achieve organizational goals.
+ Often acts as team leader of cross-functional group for ad-hoc or standing projects.
+ Routine interaction with directors, VPs or “C” level executives of suppliers managed.
+ Builds deep industry relationships and category subject matter expertise.
* Negotiation:

+ Performs market and cost analysis.
+ Issues RFIs/RFQs/RFPs.
+ Develops and executes negotiation plan.
+ Conducts negotiation within approved negotiation parameters and authority.
+ Documents commercial terms and drafts contract agreements and amendments.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Lead global commodity management activities for glass, including development of sourcing strategies that support competitive cost, supply assurance, capacity requirements, supplier development, and risk mitigation.
* Develop and implement a global sourcing with specific negotiation strategies to achieve cost, supply assurance and risk mitigation objectives.
* Lead commercial negotiations with managed supply partners.
* Coordinate aggregation of all sites demand for supplier forecasting and leveraging for cost reduction.
* Proactively manage supplier base ensuring supply with no adverse impact on factory ramp plans.
* Utilize formal benchmarking methods to determine best in class processes and drive improvement.
* Develop and implement cost-reduction programs using Cost- of-Ownership (COO) analysis, cost build-up analysis and supplier competition.
* Measure and track supply performance within spend category.
* Implement inventory optimization programs to optimize inventory turns, inventory investment and service level performance.
* Effectively communicate with appropriate management levels both internally and externally.
* Lead cross functional team and manage supply chain to goals for quality, technology, cost, flexibility and service.
* Demonstrate project management skills in leading cross functional teams.
* Conduct business dealings with the highest level of integrity and regard for legal and environmental issues.
* Other duties as assigned.
* Job description subject to change at any time

**Reporting Relationships:**

* Reports to Commodity Leader or Director, Global Supply Chain.

**Travel:**

* Up to 20%

**Estimated Salary Range:**

* $84,200 - $120,000 annually

Office Physical Requirements:

The procurement team undertake logistics-related service and physical procurement as well as service provider management work in line with the development of logistics business. Qualifications

**Minimum Qualification(s):** - Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Packaging Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. - 5+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, or category management, including at least 3 years of direct packaging sourcing experience. - Direct sourcing experience in corrugated, flexible packaging, protective packaging, mailers, or other fulfillment packaging categories. - Proven experience leading end-to-end sourcing processes, including RFQs/RFPs, supplier evaluation, negotiation, contracting, and implementation. - Demonstrated track record of negotiating multi-million-dollar contracts and delivering measurable savings. - Strong experience with should-cost modeling, total-cost-of-ownership analysis, and packaging cost drivers. - Strong supplier management, analytical, negotiation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. description:
**Company Description**

The Audio Business Division of Electro-Voice Dynacord LLC is headquartered in Burnsville, Minnesota. Our product segments include Critical Communications Systems, Pro Sound, and Public Address & Conferencing. With our premium brands: **Dynacord, Electro-Voice, RTS and Telex**, we are committed to delivering innovative solutions that shape the future of sound.

At KEENFINITY, we are a globally leading provider of innovative and professional security and communication solutions. With over 4,200 employees in over 50 countries worldwide, our ambition is clear: we offer more than just technology – we secure, connect, and amplify the moments that matter in life.

Next to our passion for technology we’re very passionate about our work environment. Based on values such as trust, appreciation, and accountability we all work together to shape the future – boldly, customer-focused and with a strong team spirit.

**Job Description**

The Senior Procurement Manager is responsible for managing the procurement buyers and strategic sourcing processes within the group. This includes:

* Responsible for overall within the BU segment for procurement activities including sourcing, supplier performance management, NPI’s, strategic suppliers development.

**Job ID:** 41922 | **Location:** The Woodlands, Texas, USA | **Work Model:** Onsite

As **Senior Procurement Manager – Site & Maintenance**, you will drive end-to-end sourcing strategies across key indirect categories — including facilities management, MRO, utilities, energy, and fluids — ensuring Clariant's production sites and offices operate at peak efficiency. Working at the intersection of strategy and execution, you will deliver measurable P&L impact through savings initiatives, supplier development, and value transformation projects, while collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders and global procurement teams. This is a high-visibility role that offers the autonomy to shape category strategy, challenge the status quo, and elevate procurement as a true business partner — making it an ideal opportunity for an ambitious, agile procurement professional looking to make a tangible impact at a leading global specialty chemicals company.

**Responsibilities**

* Define and regularly review category strategies for Site & Maintenance (facilities management, MRO, utilities, energy, and fluids) in alignment with the regional Head of Indirect Spend, leveraging procurement analytics tools, commodity forecasts, and market intelligence
* Implement site & maintenance sourcing best practices using a Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) approach to drive efficiency and cost optimization
* Deliver business objectives against clear financial and non-financial KPIs, ensuring measurable P&L impact across the organization
* Manage and optimize the existing supplier base while proactively identifying, developing, and onboarding new suppliers to challenge and improve current performance
* Drive supplier base simplification and tail spend management to reduce complexity and increase procurement efficiency
* Lead value transformation projects in close coordination with regional and global stakeholders, from ideation through to execution
* Build and manage strong relationships with strategic suppliers and key stakeholders across all business units and locations
* Actively participate in regional and global performance management forums, including the Indirect Spend SteerCo
* Simplify and automate non-value-added procurement activities to free up capacity for higher-impact initiatives
* Execute multiple sourcing initiatives simultaneously with an agile mindset, sense of urgency, and a results-driven approach
* Elevate the value perception of procurement within each business unit by consistently delivering tangible, quantifiable outcomes

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field with preferably 10+ years of proven procurement experience in a multinational organization; MBA is a plus
* Demonstrated track record in indirect categories such as facilities management, MRO, utilities, or energy
* In-depth category knowledge and ability to develop and execute strategic sourcing plans with clear KPIs and measurable outcomes
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken; proficiency in Spanish or Portuguese is a plus
* Continuous Improvement certification (e.g. Lean, Six Sigma) is an advantage
* Willingness to travel up to 20%, primarily within the United States

**What´s in it for you?**

* Medical/Dental/Vision Insurances
* Paid Holidays
* PTO time with a carry-over benefit
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Wellness Program
* EAP Program
* Spending and Savings Accounts
* Life/AD&D Insurance
* Disability Insurance
* Pet Insurance
* Online discount Mall
* Auto/Home Insurance
* Identity Theft Protection
* Legal Services Plan

description: ### **A Snapshot of Your Day** The Global Project Procurement Manager (PPM), as part of the Project Core Team starting from the project tender through until handover to warranty, coordinates the complete project procurement and identifies, drives, implements solutions for the project. The PPM is a single point of contact who is knowledgeable and able to apply the full procurement process value. Driving for the best competitive solutions aligning with all relevant x-functions. The PPM oversees and steers procurement relevant aspects during the whole Project Lifecycle and defines the Sourcing Strategy alongside the Project Core Team / Procurement Community and closely links it to the overall project strategy! **How You’ll Make an Impact** * Define and align procurement strategy with the Project Core Team and Procurement Community during the whole Project Lifecycle. Driver of early involvement of tailored Sourcing Strategies in each project (including consistent price escalation formula and robust supplier offers as basis for cost calculation). * Ensuring implementation of the Procurement Strategy and appropriate processes for Off- and Onshore scope of works by setting up the Procurement Collaboration Model with the respective region. * Lead all aspects of market situations and provide strategies for Risk Mitigation and opportunity realization. Controlling Procurement activities and resources, engaging with relevant parties (such as Regional Unit, Engineering, Scheduler, Commercial Project Manager) to optimize Costs, Schedule and Quality Requirements. * Analyzing whole supply and service scope, reviewing Customer Contracts on Procurement risks, performing Risk Analysis, preparing negotiations with suppliers, and translating back-to-backs to Project specific Supplier Contract standards. * Providing support to the specialist buyers, Commodity Managers in charge of the relevant material filed, to secure the projects goals on the best terms, holding contract and price negotiations for non-managed material fields. * Providing relevant Procurement data for project controlling as well as compiling all essential information to deliver qualified reporting (e.g. for Project Team, Customer, Procurement Management). **What You Bring** * Bachelors in business administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or related field. (Or combined equivalent of education and work experience.) 8+ years’ experience in completing complex projects. * Problem solving mentality, regardless of how big or small the problem! Strong organizational skills and excellent communication. * PMP Certification or similar and SAP experience preferred but not required. Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States without need for current or future employer-sponsored work authorization. Siemens Energy employees with current visa sponsorship may be eligible for internal transfers. **About the Team** **Gas Services** Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. **Who is Siemens Energy?** At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo **Rewards** * Career growth and development opportunities; supportive work culture * Company paid Health and wellness benefits * Paid Time Off and paid holidays * 401K savings plan with company match * Family building benefits * Parental leave https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

description:
Description:

Pilatus is hiring a Procurement Manager to join our team in Sarasota, FL. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining supplier performance in accordance with agreed contractual terms and real-time business needs. Pilatus is a global company based in Switzerland with a worldwide supplier base and this position is focused on the suppliers located in North America. The primary focus is resolution of issues that require face-to-face onsite presence, on short notice and over an extended period of time. The position is expected to be forward-thinking and to recommend and implement strategies for improving supplier performance and meeting production and customer support requirements. Take your career to the next level with Pilatus Aircraft USA Ltd.

* Assists with proactive and successful management of assigned suppliers within the North American supplier portfolio
* Hold suppliers accountable to contractual obligations, commitments, and Key Performance Indicators
* Solves crisis and secures execution of recovery plans.
* Perform supplier risk analysis, develop and execute mitigation actions that protects Pilatus’s production plan
* Communicate proactively with all Pilatus supply chain stakeholders
* Escalate issues when needed according to roles and responsibilities
* Travel on short notice for in-person supplier visits as required
* Support ongoing supplier management tasks
* Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and the procurement team in Switzerland
* Collaborate with internal departments and stakeholders, including leading projects and meetings
* Support tracking of supply chain KPIs
* Participate actively in the improvement of procurement processes and management of cross-divisional projects
* Participate in special projects as required
* Act as liaison for procurement activities in European and North American Pilatus offices

Requirements:

**Skills/Qualifications**

* Minimum B.S. in Supply Chain Management or equivalent; graduate degree is an advantage
* Minimum 5 years of experience in a supply chain and/or procurement role in the aircraft industry
* Experience with business intelligence tools and supply chain analytics
* Willingness and ability to travel both domestically and internationally, sometimes on short notice
* Ability to develop relationships and interact effectively with both internal and external stakeholders across varied business areas
* Good knowledge in lean principles and tools
* Experience with ERP/MRP software
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, Outlook)
* This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

This is an individual contributor role with no direct people-management responsibilities.

The hiring range is $68,000 - $94,000 per year. This range represents Pilatus Aircraft USA Ltd.’s estimate of the compensation reasonably expected for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant skills and experience, education, job location, internal equity, market data, and business considerations. The hiring range may be modified in the future based on business or market conditions. Any bonus, incentive compensation, benefits, or other forms of compensation are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans, programs, and policies and may be modified in accordance with applicable law.

Interested and qualified candidates should submit their application as soon as possible. Please note that this announcement may close at any time; early applications are encouraged.

With over 3,000 employees and about 200 apprentices at its headquarters in Stans, Switzerland, completion center in Broomfield, Colorado, and multiple service centers across Westminster, MD, Rock Hill, SC, Chamblee, GA and Sarasota, FL, the Pilatus family unites people from over 40 countries. We offer a secure, innovative, international, and sustainable work environment. Courage, vision, and outstanding performance have made us a strong company. Our culture is shaped by a high level of quality awareness, close customer relationships, and a high degree of employee commitment.

Pilatus Aircraft USA Ltd. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

The pay range is $73,000.00 - $132,000.00

Pay is based on several factors which vary based on position. These include labor markets and in some instances may include education, work experience and certifications. In addition to your pay, Target cares about and invests in you as a team member, so that you can take care of yourself and your family. Target offers eligible team members and their dependents comprehensive health benefits and programs, which may include medical, vision, dental, life insurance and more, to help you and your family take care of your whole selves. Other benefits for eligible team members include 401(k), employee discount, short term disability, long term disability, paid sick leave, paid national holidays, and paid vacation. Find competitive benefits from financial and education to well-being and beyond at https://corporate.target.com/careers/benefits.

**About us:**

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

A role in Buying means working with several diverse vendors to choose the best product mix, both in-store and online. We help determine where to localize, while calibrating market positioning and acting as brand managers. Here, you’ll own a wide SKU count so that your work is varied and challenging. Through cross-functional collaboration, instinct and creativity, you will be the expert on the guest, the market and the competition.

A **Buyer** helps create omni-channel growth by planning profitable and locally relevant assortments using your grasp of guest shopping behavior, assortment requirements and competitors. You will influence and negotiate with vendors to achieve results and identify gaps and opportunities. Your flexibility in reacting to business results and your ability to translate financial metrics and data into actionable strategies will be critical. * Provide a point of view on assortment changes based on market assessment, prediction of purchasing needs, and productivity assessment of sales data

* Partner with Marketing, Digital and Packaging teams to achieve strategic business objectives and Go to Market vision

* Support Buyer/ Sr. Buyer with strategic initiatives and applicable milestone meetings

* Ability to develop and maintain strong cross-functional relationships

* Communicates and translates information in a well thought-out, concise, and easy to understand manner in both verbal and written form

* Demonstrates effective organizational skills and good time management

* Willing to travel for market and store trips

* Innate curiosity and passion for product and customer satisfaction

Signet Jewelers is the world's largest retailer of diamond jewelry, operating more than 2,800 stores worldwide under the iconic brands: Kay Jewelers, Zales, Jared, H.Samuel, Ernest Jones, Peoples, Banter by Piercing Pagoda, Rocksbox, JamesAllen.com and Diamonds Direct. We are a people-first company and this core value is at the heart of everything we do, from empowering our valued team members, to collaborating with our customers, to fostering the communities in which we live and serve. People – and the love their actions inspire – are what drive us. We’re not only proud of the love we inspire outside our walls, we’re especially proud of the diversity, inclusion and equity we’re inspiring inside. There are dynamic career paths awaiting you – rewarding opportunities to impact the lives of others and inspire love. Join us!

Watch Buyer I is responsible for the end-to-end management of the watch category, including assortment planning, product selection, vendor management, inventory maintenance, and promotional strategies. The Watch Buyer I operates with day-to-day ownership of the category while reporting to the Sr. Buyer and partnering closely to develop and execute overall category strategies.

**Category Management**

o Give input as requested to set Strategic Vision for Category

o Ability to adjust quickly, if needed, to changing market trends, conditions, priorities, and corporate strategies.

o Analyze and React to Business on a weekly basis

o Participate in the development of financial plans and advertising/marketing plans for designated product categories.

o Assist in all business reviews for all designated product categories to Leadership.

o Oversee training and career development for Direct Reports / Team

**Assortment Management & Brand/Vendor Management.**

o Select watch merchandise from established brand partners, ensuring assortments align with consumer demand, brand positioning, and strategic department goals.

o Actively manage the watch assortment lifecycle from initial selection and seasonal assortment planning through inventory management, promotional activity, markdowns, and end of life.

o Partner with Senior Buyer to develop and maintain strategic brand assortments, identifying opportunities to expand key brands, styles, collections, and price points based on customer demand and category performance.

o Build and maintain strong relationships with watch brand partners, strategically managing the vendor base to optimize assortment, inventory, pricing, product availability, and overall category performance.

**Collaboration**

o Coordinate efforts with the marketing, visual display and advertising departments to promote and market key items, programs/brands and categories.

o Merchandise all marketing channel items for designated product categories. Present and justify all catalog/promotional items to merchandise directors and vice presidents.

o Participate in management of open-to-buy for assigned product categories with CMT and update as needed.

o When applicable; work directly with Signet’s accounting department to ensure credits/aging are applied correctly.

o Assist CMT with issues on vendor performance, including late orders and quality control issues.

o Proofing of all advertising materials to ensure accuracy including emails, web site and store signage.

o Work in collaboration with Visual Merchandising team for in-store presentations (planograms).

o Work cross-functionally with stores Ops team, VM, DC team and Planning on store test, Rollouts, RTV’s

**Additional Job Description**

Education Required: Bachelor’s Degree in Fashion Merchandising or related field preferred

Required or Acceptable Job-Related Experience: 2+ years’ experience prior buying experience

Years of Job-Related Experience Required: 2+ years

Technical/Other Skills Required:

o Computer skills with knowledge of Microsoft Office/Excel.

o Strong communication skills (both written and verbal), negotiation skills, attention to detail and accuracy, organizational skills, and math skills (ability to work with numbers and analyze data).

o Ability to be metal free and work in a metal free environment, when necessary, is based on security policy.

o Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

o Ability to work independently as well as a team.

o Ability to lead team if applicable.

o Ability to demonstrate leadership skills.

description:
**YOU WILL BE:**

As Buyer, you will be responsible for the overall merchandising strategy and product direction within assigned categories or departments, aiming to meet or exceed sales, margin, and financial objectives. This role focuses on curating the most distinctive and high-quality merchandise that reflects Saks Global’s exceptional standards and aligns with customer needs and preferences. Leveraging competitive intelligence, customer insights, and business analysis, you will ensure a customer-centric assortment that drives performance. In addition to leading the purchasing and negotiation of merchandise, you will partner with Merchandise Planners to develop and execute strategies that maximize business opportunities. As the Buyer, you will also manage and mentor a team of Associate Buyers, Assistant Buyers, and Coordinators, fostering collaboration and ensuring alignment with business goals

**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**

Assortment Strategy

* Provide input on category and pre-season planning strategy in collaboration with Planners based on past performance and knowledge on trends/brand insights, and execute on the strategy throughout the season
* Build customer-centered assortment framework and allocation strategy based on customer and trend insights from Stores, Digital, CACI and Fashion and provide guidelines for allocation teams to follow
* Set strategies for product display and flow (e.g., launch dates, weeks of full-price selling, cross-sell opportunities, collection considerations) in alignment with guardrails from Planning and Marketing

Market Activities

* Lead market prep activities and attend market to select the best product in alignment with guardrails from Planning (e.g., Checkbook, OTB) and category direction from BP & Buying Leads (e.g., omni strategy, banner differentiation)
* Coordinate buys with brand partners, collaborate on exclusive merchandise, manage day-to-day communication around in-season brand performance, trending styles, chase opportunities and resolve escalated order management issues

In-Season Management

* Review daily performance reports and work closely with Planner counterparts to gather insights on trending products, categories, brands, etc., pull in-season levers to optimize performance and prepare for monthly OTB meetings to provide bottoms-up context and escalate opportunities and risks to Leads

description:
**JOB SUMMARY**

The **Buyer** **(Home Organization)** plays a critical role in shaping and executing the category strategy for a designated department. With a strong understanding of product development, pricing architecture, and customer behavior, the Buyer is responsible for building a compelling, brand-right assortment that drives both financial results and customer engagement. This role requires a blend of creativity, analytical skills, and market insight to deliver innovative product stories that differentiate the brand and meet evolving customer expectations.

The ideal candidate is a well-rounded merchant with a passion for products and a strong ability to translate insights into strategy. They will lead cross-functional teams, including Planning, Sourcing, and Go-to-Market partners, ensuring each category reflects a clear vision, a strong value proposition, and meaningful differentiation in the market.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* **Cross-Functional Team Leadership**
Demonstrates the ability to lead and inspire cross-functional teams, including individuals who do not report directly. Success in this role requires strong influence, collaboration, and communication skills to foster alignment and drive high performance across diverse teams. The ability to build consensus and lead through influence is a crucial competency for an At-Home Buyer.
* **Category Strategy & Assortment Planning**
Develop and execute customer-focused merchandise strategies and seasonal assortment plans that support financial objectives and reflect brand values.
* Partner with Planning & Sourcing to build season assortment plans; Planning to own input & management of the tool, with support from Buyer on item intent & retail and sourcing for cost confirmation.
* **Product Expertise & Development**
Act as the category product expert, with deep knowledge of quality tiers, construction, pricing, and brand-appropriate product selection. Lead curation of newness and product stories that create customer excitement and drive productivity.
* **Business & Financial Management**
Partner with Planning to build merchandise financial plans and by-door assortments. Manage Open to Buy and take decisive action in-season to achieve sales, margin, and inventory goals.
* **Vendor & Sourcing Collaboration**
Communicate category/item strategy and target expectations to sourcing, ensuring sourcing's ability to negotiate costs, improve margins, and optimize the vendor matrix based on strategic needs of the business. Build and maintain strong relationships with key product partners.
* I **n-Season Performance Optimization**
Analyze weekly, monthly, and seasonal sales data to identify risks and opportunities. React quickly to trends and adjust strategies to maximize profitability.
* **Inventory & Markdown Management**
Collaborate with Planning on assortment intent and season priorities. While planning will manage inventory levels and markdown strategies that balance margin and sell-through, it will be imperative to provide the inputs to ensure strategic goals are met.
* **Market & Competitive Analysis**
Conduct structured competitive shops and gather marketplace intelligence to inform strategy, uncover whitespace, and ensure assortment differentiation.
* **Cross-Functional Execution**
Work closely with Marketing, eCommerce/Digital and Visual Merchandising to ensure cohesive go-to-market execution and alignment on brand and business goals.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience.
* 5-7 years of experience in buying, merchandising, or category management in a retail or consumer-focused organization.
* Strong product sensibility and understanding of pricing, quality, and customer value
* Demonstrated ability to build product assortment and deliver financial results
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and communication skills
* Passionate about the customer, brand storytelling, and product innovation

**About the Role:**

As a CBRE Procurement Manager, you'll be responsible for managing a team of employees responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and managing service provider for outsourced services. You will also assist a client or department with the development and execution of sourcing and procurement strategies.

This job is part of the Procurement function. They are responsible for sourcing and purchasing goods, services, or raw materials from vendors and suppliers.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Provide formal supervision to employees. Monitor the training and development of staff. Conduct performance evaluations and coaching. Oversee the recruiting and hiring of new employees.
* Coordinate and manage the team's daily activities. Establish work schedules, assign tasks, and cross-train staff. Work with business stakeholders, operational shared services team members, and sponsors to develop, coordinate, and execute strategy at local and regional levels.
* Set and track staff and department deadlines. Mentor and coach as needed.
* Draft, review, negotiate, and maintain contracts and other business documents in support of the purchase of goods and services.
* Review the process of contract terminations, expirations, extensions, and renewals. Inform peers and corporate management staff of changes or results.
* Manage supplier and contractor certification process. Conduct periodic visits to supplier work locations to review vendor performance.
* Mentor and educate on contemporary outsourcing practices and the value of applying them.
* Analyze account-wide facility management services spend, suppliers, operations, and statement of works to identify opportunities for value creation.
* Assist with creating RTFs, selecting solutions, and negotiating. Prepare and maintain contracts with national and regional service providers. Ensure contracts adhere to company standards.
* Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Influence parties of shared interests to reach an agreement. Deal with sensitive issues.
* Apply knowledge of own discipline and how own discipline integrates with others to achieve team and departmental objectives.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve day-to-day and moderately complex issues which may or may not be evident in existing systems and processes.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor's Degree preferred with 3-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. C.P.M., C.P.S.M. or N.A.C.M. certifications or eligibility preferred.
* Experience in the areas of staffing, selection, training, development, coaching, mentoring, measuring, appraising, and rewarding performance and retention preferred.
* Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations and handle problems.
* Leadership skills to motivate team impact on quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of the job discipline and department.
* In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset.
* Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

**Equal Employment Opportunity:** CBRE has a long-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

**Candidate Accommodations:** CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. CBRE provides reasonable accommodations in job application procedures for individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance due to a disability in the application or recruitment process, please submit a request via email at recruitingaccommodations@cbre.com or via telephone at +1 866 225 3099 (U.S.) and +1 866 388 4346 (Canada).

description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The Role:

As a Sr Sourcing Deputy, you will play a crucial role in executing procurement processes, managing supplier relationships, and driving cost efficiencies. The focus will be on strategic sourcing and supplier management, including negotiations, contracting, and supplier performance. You will need to collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with company goals and market trends.

Your Contribution:

* Develop and implement sourcing strategies that align with the company’s overall goals and objective

* Gathering and analyzing information about the market, including competitors, customers, trends and products

* Manage sourcing and procurement for electronic components.
* Oversee supplier management and negotiate pricing and contracts.
* Lead new supplier selection and vendor management.
* Responsible for cost negotiations, drive cost reduction strategies and identify sourcing opportunities.
* Collaborate with internal teams to provide market trend analysis; provide supplier roadmap and market trend & analysis to internal customers on regular basis
* Develop and maintain positive relationships with suppliers and partners.
* Ensure business continuity and risk mitigation strategies are in place, work on long term component capacity planning and identifying sourcing bottlenecks

Your Qualifications and Skills:

* At least 6-8 years of sourcing experience, especially in electronic components.
* High proficiency in English, both spoken and written.
* Strong analytical, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work globally across regions (US, EMEA, AP).
* Experience in strategic sourcing and international procurement.
* Ability to understand market drivers and cost structures.
* Strong interpersonal skills for effective collaboration.
* Proven track record in supplier and cost management.
* Knowledge of financial analysis related to sourcing.

Work Location and Model:

At Logitech, we empower global collaboration by providing a flexible hybrid work model. Depending on the role and team needs, this may include working remotely, on-premises, or a blend of both.

This is a hybrid position. The successful candidate is expected to work onsite at our San Jose, CA office 2–3 days per week, with the remaining days remote. Specific onsite days will be coordinated with your manager and team.

Compensation:

This position offers an annual base salary typically between $ 116,000 and $ 152,000 . In certain circumstances, higher compensation will be considered based on the business need, candidate experience, and skills.

Benefits:

Logitech offers benefits such as Medical Coverage, Dental Coverage, Vision Coverage, Traditional and Roth 401(k) Plans, Flexible Spending Accounts, Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP), Basic and Additional Life Insurance, Disability Coverage, Adoption and Surrogacy Assistance, Tuition Reimbursement Plans, Commuter Benefits, Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, Bereavement Leave, and Paid Parental Leave.

Logitech also offers Wellness Programs, Health Savings Account Plans, access to Expert Medical Opinions, Identity Theft Protection, Breast Milk Delivery to Nursing Mothers on Business Travel, access to a Group Legal Plan, Donations Matching Programs, Employee Product Discounts, and access to Auto, Home, and Pet Insurance.

#LI-SN1

Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in-house.

Logitech is an amazing place to work because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature as well as by design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. If you feel you are the right candidate for the opportunity, we strongly recommend that you apply. We want to meet you!

We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments that are designed to be flexible and help you to care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future. We believe that good health means more than getting medical care when you need it. Logitech supports a culture that encourages individuals to achieve good physical, financial, emotional, intellectual and social wellbeing so we all can create, achieve and enjoy more and support our families. We can’t wait to tell you more about them being that there are too many to list here and they vary based on location.

All qualified applicants

Description:

Join Amrize as a Project Procurement Manager, Construction and help construct what's next. If you're ready to put your skills to work on projects that matter — and build a career with a company that’s building North America — we want to hear from you!

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The Project Procurement Manager, Construction will oversee all aspects of procurement for the project including for all capital equipment, building materials, construction related services and raw materials. This position will manage supplier relationships, strategic sourcing and procurement processes and ensure the timely and cost-effective acquisition of materials and services essential for the project. The Procurement Manager must utilize a proactive approach to optimizing procurement strategies and place a strong focus on cost reduction, quality assurance and supply chain efficiency.

**WHAT YOU’LL ACCOMPLISH**

* Develop and implement procurement strategies that align with the Project’s business goals and operational requirements.
* Lead cross-functional teams to manage procurement projects from initiation through to completion, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
* Negotiate contracts and terms with suppliers, vendors, and service providers to secure advantageous terms.
* Conduct market research and supplier evaluations to identify and onboard reliable suppliers and subcontractors.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including engineering, production, logistics, quality assurance, and finance departments, to forecast demand and ensure an uninterrupted supply of materials.
* Monitor and manage supplier performance to ensure compliance with contractual obligations and performance metrics.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance procurement processes, reduce costs, and improve supplier performance.
* Ensure compliance with procurement activities' legal, regulatory, and environmental policies and standards.
* Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to health, safety and environmental policies in all work environments and areas. Promote a culture of safety and exhibit these behaviors.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* Education: Bachelor’s Degree
* Field of Study Preferred: Supply Chain Management, business administration, engineering or related field

**Required Work Experience:**

* Minimum 7+ years experience in Procurement or Supply Chain Management, preferably within a construction manufacturing environment and/or a greenfield plant environment.
* Certification in supply chain management or procurement is a plus.
* 7+ years of managing suppier relationships, strategic soucing and handling negotiations

**Required Computer and Software Skills:**

* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite
* Experience working with Procore or similar project management software Proficient in procurement software and systems

**Travel Requirements:**

* Occasional, but regular overnight travel to the project site and to suppliers for meetings and presentations

**Additional Requirements:**

* Demonstrate detailed and efficient organization skills
* Demonstrate excellent oral and written communication skills
* Work well under pressure to meet project deadlines
* Show high levels of commitment to detail
* Strong knowledge of procurement processes, supply chain management, and strategic sourcing principles.
* Strong knowledge and project procurement experience with greenfield and brownfield expansions.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Must have strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
* Solid understanding of manufacturing processes and materials.
* Project management skills, including planning, scheduling, and managing budgets.
* Familiarity with capital projects including engineering and construction
