At AMEWAS, we don’t just support defense- we shape it. For over 40 years, we’ve been a trusted partner of the Department of Defense (DoD) by providing cutting-edge engineering, testing, and evaluation for U.S. Navy weapons systems.

Our people are the heart of our mission. Across our headquarters in California, Maryland, and offices in Orlando, FL, and San Diego, CA, you'll find a diverse and driven team committed to making a real impact for our Nation’s Warfighters.

If you're ready to grow your skills, be challenged by meaningful work, and contribute to something bigger…this is where you belong.

Come do work that matters. Join AMEWAS.

**The Position:**
AMEWAS is seeking a highly motivated and talented Procurement Associate-Journeyman to support Electromagnetic Environmental Effects. The salary range of this position is $62,900.00 - $75,300.00 and is commensurate with experience. This position is not eligible for remote work; on-site support is required.

Patuxent River, MD, located in the California-Lexington Park area, is Maryland’s #1 City Hiring the Most High-Tech Workers. To learn more about the surrounding area, please visit: www.visitstmarysmd.com

The Integrated Battlespace Simulation and Test (IBST) Department’s E3 facility is the center of excellence in aircraft E3 Research, Development, Test, and Evaluation. With IBST at the helm, we're not just preparing for the future but shaping it.

A typical day as a Procurement Associate-Journeyman may include:

* Manages/Coordinates a variety of procurement activities from purchase request through order completion
* Communicates regularly with management, internal customers, and vendors regarding order status, pricing, delivery schedules, purchase requirements, and the status of purchasing packages
* Prepares and issues purchase orders
* Obtains and evaluates vendor quotes
* Prepares higher-dollar, complex purchasing packages in accordance with company policies, contract requirements, and applicable procurement regulations
* Monitors/Tracks available funding and expenditures against assigned contracts and purchase requirements
* Ensures purchases remain within authorized funding and contract limitations
* Receives and accepts packages delivered to the company and properly documents receipt in Costpoint

* Answers phone calls and emails and assists management/other departments with procurement-related questions

* Performs other procurement related duties and responsibilities as necessary
* Supports the overall operation of the Procurement department

* HS Diploma or equivalent
* 3 years of experience in purchasing or procurement within a government contracting, defense, aerospace, engineering, manufacturing, or other highly regulated environment
* Experience with Deltek Costpoint, including purchase orders and procurement transactions
* Experience processing/tracking a high volume of purchase orders, including pricing, quantities, funding, invoices, order status, and vendor/stakeholder follow-up

* The ability to follow procurement policies, procedures, contract requirements, and internal controls
* The ability to maintain confidentiality when handling procurement, pricing, vendor, contract, and funding information

**Associate Supply Chain Buyer**

**Description**

***Who We Are***

Textron Systems is part of Textron, a $14 billion, multi-industry company employing 35,000 talented makers, thinkers, creators and doers worldwide. We make things that fly, hover, zoom and launch. Things that move people. Protect soldiers. Power industries. We serve customers in industries spanning aerospace and defense, specialized vehicles, turf care and fuel systems.

This role is in Textron System’s **Supply Chain** business area. Visit TextronSystems.com & Lycoming.com to read more about who we are and the products we make\\!

***About This Role***

In this role, you will be responsible for:

* Purchase materials from supplies at the lowest cost consistent with considerations of quality, reliability of source and urgency of need
* Study market trends, interview vendors and recommends sources of supply
* Solicit and analyze quotations required to satisfy all the requirements of the authorizing source documentation
* Monitor outstanding orders to ensure timely deliveries of quality products to maintain production, following up on orders to expedite shipment and delivery as needed
* Negotiate for any adjustments resulting from price analysis, discrepant materials, surplus or obsolete materials, contract terminations or a purchase order cancellation
* Obtain certifications of delivery and conduct item delivery validation. Check and improve payment of invoices
* Develop and maintain necessary records and files for compliance purposes. Support preparation of proposal cost data
* Preferred candidate will be knowledgeable in weld process, mechanical and custom fab.

**Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing or have completed a bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain or a related field.
* Ability to plan, organize and manage multiple priorities efficiently
* Effective verbal and written communications skills
* Basic Microsoft Office application skills with emphasis in MS Excel

***How We Care***

At Textron Systems, our talented people make us successful. Our Company is committed to offering employees opportunities to grow and develop. Our benefits and compensation packages are designed to help our talented employees excel and achieve their goals, so they can make a difference every day in and outside of the workplace. Below are just a few examples\\!

* Flexible Work Schedules

* Education Assistance

* Career Development & Training Opportunities

* Wellness Program (including Fitness Reimbursement)

* Medical, Dental, Vision & 401(K) with Company Funding

* Paid Parental Leave

***Are you a Military Veteran?***

Textron's products and services are trusted everyday by those who protect our country. We are dedicated to hiring these Veterans and aim to translate their skills to make an impact on our Company.

**AI Readiness:** Textron expects employees to use AI-enabled tools responsibly and effectively. Candidates should be comfortable learning and applying these tools, evaluating AI-generated output with sound judgment, and using AI in line with company policy and ethical standards. Prior experience with specific tools is not required — we value curiosity, adaptability, and good judgment.

**EEO Statement**

Textron is committed to providing Equal Opportunity in Employment, to all applicants and employees regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, military status, veteran status, disability, sex (including pregnancy and sexual orientation), genetic information or any other characteristic protected by law.

**Job Function:** Supply Chain

**Schedule:** Full-time

**Job Level:** Individual Contributor

**Job Type:** Standard

**Shift:** First Shift

description:
Since 1976, **Furniture Mart USA** has been more than just a furniture retailer, it’s a place where people come to build careers, not just jobs. We believe in hiring great people and giving them the tools to grow, thrive, and make a difference. If you're passionate about helping others transform their house into a home, you’ll feel right at home here too.

Join a team that’s built on trust, teamwork, and a shared commitment to excellence. Whether you're just starting out or looking to take your career to the next level, **Furniture Mart USA** is where your future begins.

**Our mission is simple: Transform houses into homes, employees into family, and customers into friends.** If you share our vision and values, we invite you to join our team.

**Starting Wage: $22-28/hour depending on experience**

**Summary:**

* **Full-Time (40 hrs/wk): Monday-Friday, 8:00AM-5:00PM**
* Monitor supply levels and make appropriate purchases as necessary
* Evaluate vendors to determine best price and quality of supplies purchased while negotiating prices accordingly
* Receive and process all requests for supplies made by various company departments and locations.
* Allocate appropriate cost to proper location
* Retains records on purchases/requests/filled orders
* Responsible for licensing and registration of all fleet vehicles
* Travel Arrangements-Flights, Hotels, Conference rooms
* Reviews, codes and approves all invoices related to items purchased
* Coordinates and purchases food needs for meetings and events
* Contacts suppliers to schedule or expedite deliveries, to resolve shortages, missed or late deliveries, and other concerns
* Prepares, maintains, and reviews purchasing files, reports and price lists
* Tracks the status of requisitions, contracts, and orders
* Purchasing of Cell Phones and Managing of corporate account
* Purchasing of company uniforms
* Participates in department and company improvement activities, positively contributing to the team
* Proactively communicates issues and action taken or needed with Manager and/or Supervisor
* Maintains good attendance, punctuality and safe work practices
* Work in conjunction with Fleet Manager.
* Other duties as assigned

**REQUIREMENTS/QUALIFICATIONS:**

* One-year certificate from college or technical school; or three to six months related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Effective collaborator and communicator
* Strong facilitation and problem-solving skills
* Ability to communicate well with external and internal customers and management.
* Self-motivated and absolute attention to detail

**Benefits: What’s in It for You?**
As a full-time member of our Furniture Mart USA family, you will enjoy:

* Paid training
* Full benefits package: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Paid Time Off, and more
* 401(k) with employer match
* Big employee & family discounts on furniture and mattresses

**Furniture Mart USA is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

description:
Principal Associate, Sourcing Manager

At Capital One, we dare to dream, disrupt and deliver a better way. Our goal is simple — bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change. We are seeking a **Principal Associate, Sourcing Manager** to join our **Enterprise Supplier Management (ESM) Team**! In ESM, we empower associates to deliver their best by cultivating a culture of inclusion and belonging, where varying perspectives and opinions are valued. We embrace each other’s differences and encourage all team members to lean into their talents and skills to deliver experiences for both internal and external clients.

This Sourcing position will develop strategy for and execute high risk and high impact procurement efforts across the company. This is an individual contributor role. Working in concert with business partners and subject matter experts, the **Sourcing Manager** will develop an in-depth understanding of client needs and supply markets, then apply rigorous procurement methodology and analytics to ensure those client’s needs will be met by the selected supplier(s). This role will lead projects in indirect categories of spend include, but not limited to Marketing related services, Professional Services, IT related Services.

The selected candidate will have experience in strategic sourcing – ideally in the technology or financial services industry. He or she will have demonstrated the ability to drive positive business outcomes through the supply chain, have great communication and influence skills, high analytical proficiency, and demonstrated ability to negotiate complex agreements.

**Responsibilities:**

* Analyze external industry trends and benchmarks, as well as develop and share market insights
* Clearly articulates cost drivers and pricing analysis for strategy formulation. Leads the development of make–versus-buy strategies

- Leads innovative sourcing methods - balance cost, speed, and quality based on internal customer needs

* Build strong internal and external relationships, understand the procurement parameters and look for new opportunities
* Consult with internal clients and business partners to identify opportunities to drive cost savings and efficiency in the supply chain
* Build buy in and communicate across multiple levels of the organization and across multiple lines of business
* Manage multiple projects concurrently in an autonomous environment
* Develop and implement procurement strategies including RFx, eSourcing, direct negotiations, etc.
* Use procurement software tools
* Support the development and execution of category strategies
* Support the negotiation of commercial terms for large contracts
* Develop communications and presentations at the Executive level

**Basic Qualifications:**

* At least 3 years of experience in sourcing and procurement
* At least 2 years of experience in risk management
* At least 2 years of experience in negotiating supplier agreements

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Bachelor's Degree or Military Experience

* 5+ years of experience in outsourcing and procurement
* 4+ years of experience in risk management

At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

Sales Territory: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain
Plano, TX: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain
McLean, VA: $120,800 - $137,900 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain
Richmond, VA: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain
New York, NY: $131,800 - $150,500 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain
Riverwoods, IL: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.

Overview:

We are authentic, professional providers of fun, focused on building a Great Place To Work For All by staying true to our mission: “Life’s a Party, We’re Makin’ It Fun!” and “So Much Fun It’s Scary!”

At Spencer’s and Spirit, we do the right thing always-integrity, fairness, respect, and transparency are our foundation. You will find our culture to be inclusive, passionate, resilient, and one that values differences and embraces all.

**One Team / One Goal**

We are leaders and owners of our business success. Whether it’s developing new and exclusive costumes, quality testing products, or implementing technology solutions, our teams understand the value of working collaboratively to embrace change through innovation, curiosity, and thoughtfulness.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

* *Flexible work environment*
* *Career advancement*
* *Competitive base salary*
* *Bonus opportunity*
* *Vacation, Personal, Sick and Holiday pay*
* *Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Life and AD&D insurance*
* *401k with a company match*
* *30% merchandise discount*

Responsibilities:

The Associate Buyer manages purchasing and inventory for specific departments, driving sales and profitability through collaboration with internal teams and external partners. They assist in curating assortments, ensuring timely deliveries, and analyzing sales performance. The role also involves identifying new products and trends through research and competitive shopping. Additionally, the Associate Buyer helps guide and train Assistant Buyers and Senior Assistant Buyers.

* Responsible for building, creating & managing merchandise assortments that align with market and consumer trends, to be presented to the Buyer. Assortment creation includes selecting and developing merchandise by considering quality, sourcing, timing, delivery, mix, and price
* Analyze weekly sales and item performance to find opportunities and strategies to drive sales and margin
* Prepare merchandise and reports for weekly team meetings
* Manage entire product lifecycle from creation, tracking of the purchase orders, samples, merchandising in store, to markdowns and discards
* Responsible for making purchasing decisions independently that satisfy the customer demand and achieve sales, turn and margin plan
* Travel to store locations to review product mix, gather feedback, and share information with the merchant team
* Attend trade shows and travel to vendor locations to grow and maintain professional relationships with external partners, as well as gain insight on new trends and opportunities
* Maintain and grow professional relationships with external suppliers and internal partners via telephone, email, and face-to-face meetings
* Partner with leadership and planning counterparts to manage the OTB and to identify opportunities in style count, sales goals, and inventory flow
* Manage markdowns and promotion strategies

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree (B. A.) from four-year college or university; and 5+ years experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Proven ability to develop and implement strategies that drive business growth
* Exceptional written and verbal communication abilities, facilitating clear and effective dialogue with stakeholders
* Ability to work independently while also thriving in collaborative environments, taking initiative to drive projects forward
* Strong aptitude for partnering with cross-functional teams to achieve shared goals and enhance organizational effectiveness
* Skilled in developing, planning, presenting, and executing strategic initiatives that align with business objectives

*The pay range reflects the potential base salary range for this role. Individual base pay is determined by various factors such as relevant experience and skills, and the scope and responsibilities of the position.*

Pay Range: $70,000 - $80,000

Posted Date 10/06/2026

Description Principal Associate, Sourcing Manager

At Capital One, we dare to dream, disrupt and deliver a better way. Our goal is simple — bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change. We are seeking a **Principal Associate, Sourcing Manager** to join our **Enterprise Supplier Management (ESM) Team**! In ESM, we empower associates to deliver their best by cultivating a culture of inclusion and belonging, where varying perspectives and opinions are valued. We embrace each other’s differences and encourage all team members to lean into their talents and skills to deliver experiences for both internal and external clients.

This Sourcing position will develop strategy for and execute high risk and high impact procurement efforts across the company. This is an individual contributor role. Working in concert with business partners and subject matter experts, the **Sourcing Manager** will develop an in-depth understanding of client needs and supply markets, then apply rigorous procurement methodology and analytics to ensure those client’s needs will be met by the selected supplier(s). This role will lead projects in indirect categories of spend include, but not limited to Marketing related services, Professional Services, IT related Services.

The selected candidate will have experience in strategic sourcing – ideally in the technology or financial services industry. He or she will have demonstrated the ability to drive positive business outcomes through the supply chain, have great communication and influence skills, high analytical proficiency, and demonstrated ability to negotiate complex agreements.

**Responsibilities:**

* Analyze external industry trends and benchmarks, as well as develop and share market insights

* Clearly articulates cost drivers and pricing analysis for strategy formulation. Leads the development of make–versus-buy strategies

- Leads innovative sourcing methods - balance cost, speed, and quality based on internal customer needs

* Build strong internal and external relationships, understand the procurement parameters and look for new opportunities

* Consult with internal clients and business partners to identify opportunities to drive cost savings and efficiency in the supply chain

* Build buy in and communicate across multiple levels of the organization and across multiple lines of business

* Manage multiple projects concurrently in an autonomous environment

* Develop and implement procurement strategies including RFx, eSourcing, direct negotiations, etc.

* Use procurement software tools

* Support the development and execution of category strategies

* Support the negotiation of commercial terms for large contracts

* Develop communications and presentations at the Executive level

**Basic Qualifications:**

* At least 3 years of experience in sourcing and procurement

* At least 2 years of experience in risk management

* At least 2 years of experience in negotiating supplier agreements

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Bachelor's Degree or Military Experience

* 5+ years of experience in outsourcing and procurement

* 4+ years of experience in risk management

At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

Sales Territory: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain

Plano, TX: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain

McLean, VA: $120,800 - $137,900 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain

Richmond, VA: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain

New York, NY: $131,800 - $150,500 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain

Riverwoods, IL: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.

Responsibilities:

**Job Summary:** As an Associate Fresh Buyer, you'll train and work with a BDM to learn about product assortment, placement, purchase, price negotiation, distribution, cost negotiation, reacting to customer demand, and planning future category strategy. This position is an orientation job for Partners with limited experience in Business Development Management (BDM) or Buyer functions.

**Key Responsibilities & Essential Functions:**

* Supply Chain & Inventory Management:
+ Associate Fresh Buyer is a developmental role for Fresh Buyer.
+ Works with set vendor base
+ Executes purchase orders for a pre-defined set of items.
+ Executes (buys to) pre-determined item level product specifications.
+ Somewhat seasonal with little market fluctuations
+ Executes the Supply Chain needs for determined ad/promo items
+ Executes pre-determined supply chain from Suppliers to warehouses then into stores¿
+ Purchase order replenishment
+ Days on hand Inventory levels and Freshness guarantees
+ Markdowns to move shorter dated items
+ Executes out of spec product /load rejections to ensure stores receive the highest quality products
+ Shrink management controls
+ Supplier service level targets
+ Executes the outbound product flow from the HEB warehouse network into the entire network of HEB banner stores (HEB/CM/MT/Joe V's).

* Supplier Cost & Pricing:
+ Supplier Cost Management:
+ Executes pre-determined costs that follows FB and BDM cost negotiations
+ Minimal market price knowledge needed
+ Executes pre-determined item level costing that follows category strategy
+ Executes BDM contract & cost negotiations

* Strategic Planning:
+ Supplier Cost Management
+ Executes pre-determined costs that follows FB and BDM cost negotiations
+ Basic understanding of market pricing is needed
+ Executes pre-determined item level costing that follows category strategy
+ Executes BDM contract & cost negotiations

*The responsibilities and essential functions outlined above describe the general nature and level of work assigned to this position. This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. Duties and responsibilities may be modified at any time based on business needs. Employees may be required to perform other job-related tasks as requested by their supervisor, subject to reasonable accommodations.*

**Qualifications & Key Requirements:**

**Work Experience:**

* 3+ years of experience in business, merchandising / retail, or Store Operations
* Category management, buying, supply chain, promotional planning, category analysis, merchandising, or other buying related experiences are a plus

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office
* Ability to multi-task and perform under pressure
* Strong analytical and organizational skills
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and negotiation skills -
* Working knowledge of product information data flow (item, vendor, cost, price), category trends, promotional planning, category performance analysis, systems, process, and analysis
* Strong verbal / written communication and presentation skills
* Analytical and problem-solving skills
* Negotiating and influencing skills
* Organization and project management skills
* PC skills (MS Office and job-related software / programs)
* Ability to manage multiple priorities / deadlines and shift focus between tasks; attention to detail
* Ability to work collaboratively on cross-functional teams and company-wide initiatives
* Ability to navigate the organization and solve problems within / across departments
* Ability to recommend proactive solutions with limited direction and input
* Initiative: willingness to take risks

**Education:**

* Degree in business, economics, marketing, or related field preferred

**Licenses/Certifications:**

**Physical Demands & Working Conditions:**

* Function in a fast-paced, retail, office environment
* Travel by car or plane with overnight stays
* Work extended hours; sit for extended periods

*The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those a Partner encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

**Last revised:** 08/01/2023

**About Radiant**
-----------------

Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based startup building the world’s first mass-produced, portable nuclear microreactors. The company’s first reactor, Kaleidos, is a 1-megawatt, fail-safe microreactor that can be transported anywhere power is needed and run for up to 5 years without refueling. Portable nuclear power with rapid-deploy capability can replace similar-sized diesel generators and provide critical asset support for hospitals, data centers, remote sites, and military bases. Radiant’s unique, practical approach to nuclear development leverages modern software engineering to rapidly deliver safe, factory-built microreactors that use existing, well-qualified materials. Founded in 2020, Radiant is on track to test its first reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory this summer, with initial customer deliveries beginning in 2028.

**About the Role**
------------------

Radiant is looking for an Indirect Procurement Associate to support sourcing and procurement of indirect goods and services — Facilities, IT, Professional Services, MRO, consumables, and R&D collaborations. This is a hands-on role for someone with strong technical instincts who wants to build skills in supplier evaluation, negotiation, and contract support. You'll work alongside Engineering, Operations, Finance, and Production, and will be paired with more senior procurement staff to develop your commercial and negotiation skill set.

**Responsibilities & Duties**

* Support sourcing efforts for indirect categories (IT, Professional Services, MRO, consumables, R&D collaborations) by gathering technical requirements and evaluating supplier capability against Radiant's engineering needs.
* Assist with drafting and reviewing SOWs, NDAs, and PO terms; help prepare negotiation positions for MSAs and licensing agreements under guidance from senior staff.
* Help manage facilities/MRO procurement tasks — coordinating with vendors on maintenance, repairs, equipment, and small lab build-out needs.
* Track purchase orders through the procure-to-pay cycle, flagging delays or technical mismatches early.
* Act as a day-to-day point of contact for select, lower-complexity suppliers, escalating high-stakes commercial matters to senior procurement staff.
* Contribute technical judgment to cost and quality trade-off discussions.
* Help identify supply chain risks from an engineering/technical perspective (e.g., part obsolescence, service quality issues).
* Support process documentation and improvement efforts.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering (or closely related engineering field) strongly preferred, Supply Chain or similar degrees considered
* 1–3 years of relevant experience; prior procurement/sourcing experience is a plus but not required.
* Strong technical/mechanical aptitude and genuine interest in the commercial side of engineering (supplier selection, cost trade-offs, contracts).
* Good analytical and organizational skills; comfortable learning negotiation and contract fundamentals on the job.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable with ERP/MRP systems and standard office software (or willing to learn quickly).
* Occasional travel to supplier locations (up to 20%).

**Desired Qualifications**

* Exposure to Facilities, MRO, IT, or Professional Services sourcing.
* Coursework or interest in quality systems (ISO 9001, AS9100).
* Interest in the energy/nuclear sector.

**Additional Requirements**

* Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as necessary.
* Must work 100% onsite at El Segundo HQ.

----------------------

* Stock: Substantial incentive stock plan for all full-time employees.
* Medical: 100% up to base silver level plan for employee + 50% dependents, offers up to Platinum plans.
* One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents.
* Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage + 50% for dependents.
* Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents.
* Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits.
* 8-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Additional paid pregnancy leave for CA employees.
* Daily catered lunch. Free snacks and drinks.
* Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation.
* Company and team-bonding events, happy hours and in-person camaraderie.
* Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean.

**Total Compensation and Benefits**
Radiant compensates people for impact and invests in those who continue to raise the bar. Radiant’s new hire compensation package includes base salary, substantial equity grants, and comprehensive health benefits. ***International Shoppes*** has been delivering exceptional service and premium retail experiences to travelers since 1951. We proudly operate across some of the nation's busiest airports, including John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK), Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD), Baltimore / Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport (BWI), Bradley International Airport (BDL), George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH), Daniel K. Inouye International Airport (HNL), and Kahului Airport (OGG). We are committed to providing an outstanding shopping experience while representing many of the world's most recognized luxury, beauty, and lifestyle brands.

**Position Overview:**

The **Associate Buyer of Beauty** is responsible for providing market expertise, filtering the assortment, and establishing quantities that meet the Region's needs and financial goals within open to buy parameters. Demonstrates smart risk-taking in business and product decisions and clearly communicates and manages team to execute these decisions. Supports the Buyers by providing analysis and results for their category, recommends action against the results and follows through on executing this action. Coordinate daily activities across designated departments to facilitate responsibilities.

**Responsibilities:**

* PO Management and Execution
+ Review Brand Sell In and Write Monthly Orders with OTB
+ Review and introduce novelties for various in store activations
* Stock Maintenance- review WOS and opportunity for clean up
+ Duty Paid Allocation management and execution
- Splits/Duty Paid Transfers
- Work with store teams to determine needs of business
* Negotiate vendor returns and destructions
* Review and Implement Vendor Funded Promotions
* Quarterly Store Walkthrough /Attend Vendor Walkthroughs
* Various Ad – Hoc Reporting
* Identify product opportunities and trends which will impact the business and provide results
* Liaise with visual team to ensure that all products are properly on sales floor for optimization

The Purchasing Associate is responsible for supporting the purchasing function through procurement, supplier management, inventory coordination, and ERP system maintenance. This role ensures timely and cost-effective acquisition of materials to support business operations.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:** None

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

· Review the ERP system (SyteLine) to place and monitor purchase orders for sales samples, production, customer, and warehouse requirements.

· Review and resolve supplier invoices.

· Review and resolve goods receipts.

· Set-up logistics for purchase order arrival.

· Enter, update, and maintain supplier pricing.

· Assist with product sourcing and purchasing projects.

· Adjust planning/purchasing parameters based on analytical review.

· Monitor and track supplier non-conformance issues for supplier quality.

· Track the accuracy of purchase orders and monitor on-time delivery metrics to ensure supplier performance meets expectations.

· Monitor inventory including managing minimum and maximum stocking levels.

· Establish and manage stocking agreements using customer forecasts, supplier MOQs, and lead times, while monitoring performance and notifying Sales of over- or under-utilization

· Resolve supplier shipping issues or damage that occurred within transportation.

· Ability to identify seasonal trends in commodity purchasing and adjust accordingly.

· Cross-functional team player with Sales, Customer Service, Production, Accounting, and Warehouse.

· Assist the Production Coordinator in daily purchasing, scheduling, and logistics activities.

· Performs other duties as assigned.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

· Proficiency in companies operating software, MS-Word and MS-Excel. ERP experience preferred.

· Strong analytical and mathematical skills.

· Strong verbal and written communication skills.

· Demonstrate sense of urgency, strong organizational skills, sense of ownership, and possess follow-up / follow through skills.

· Strong attention to detail and appropriate sense of urgency, when working both independently and as a team.

**Education and Experience:**

· High School diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred but not required.

· Prior purchasing experience in a distribution / manufacturing environment preferred.

**Physical Requirements:**

· Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

· Working conditions are normal for an office environment.

· Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.

· Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

· Occasional travel to other Illing locations or supplier sites as required.

**Position: Per Diem Purchasing Associate**

**Location: Barlow Respiratory Hospital, 2000 Stadium Way, Los Angeles**

**Job Summary:**

The Per Diem Purchasing Associate plays a crucial role in the operations of Barlow Respiratory Hospital's Materials Management Department. This position is responsible for the efficient receipt, storage, and distribution of all materials delivered by various vendors to the hospital. The ideal candidate will ensure that all materials are handled efficiently and stored properly, contributing to the smooth operation of hospital services.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Receipt of Deliveries:** Accurately receive materials delivered to the Materials Management Department, ensuring all items are accounted for against delivery documents.
* **Storage:** Properly store all received materials in designated areas, maintaining an organized and efficient inventory system.
* **Distribution:** Timely distribute materials to various departments within the hospital, ensuring that all internal requests for materials are fulfilled accurately and promptly.
* **Inventory Management:** Assist in maintaining accurate inventory records, participating in inventory counts and reconciliations as required.
* **Vendor Coordination:** Interact with vendors during the delivery process to resolve any discrepancies or issues that may arise.
* **Compliance:** Adhere to hospital policies and procedures related to materials handling, storage, and distribution.

**Requirements:**

* Computer literacy, with proficiency in inventory management software and Microsoft Office applications.
* Valid driver’s license, with a clean driving record.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to lift and move heavy items as needed.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Flexibility to work on a per diem basis, with varying hours according to departmental needs.
* **Per Diem position**

**Education and Experience:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Previous experience in materials management, inventory control, or a related field is preferred.
* Hands-on experience with purchasing software (e.g. MediTech) Preferred
* Proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel

Barlow Respiratory Hospital is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals who are passionate about contributing to our team and supporting the health and well-being of our community.

Job Type: Part-time

Pay: From $21.00 per hour

Expected hours: 8.0 – 16.0 per week

Experience:

* Purchasing department : 1 year (Required)

**About Hempel Pipe & Supply**

Hempel Pipe & Supply is a trusted, family-owned distributor of pipe, valves, and fittings (PVF) serving contractors, industrial facilities, and commercial customers throughout the United States. Our team is committed to providing reliable products, strong vendor relationships, and exceptional customer service.

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Purchasing Associate to support our purchasing and supply chain operations.

**Position Summary**

The Purchasing Associate supports the purchasing team by helping manage inventory levels, processing purchase orders, coordinating with vendors, and ensuring products are available to meet customer demand. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, vendors, and internal teams to keep operations running smoothly.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Enter purchase orders for pipe, valves, fittings, and related PVF products
* Track order confirmations, delivery schedules, and backorders
* Maintain accurate inventory levels and product records
* Communicate with vendors regarding pricing, availability, and lead times
* Coordinate with sales and warehouse teams to meet customer demand
* Monitor inventory reports and assist with stock replenishment
* Maintain vendor files and purchasing documentation
* Support cost control and purchasing efficiency initiatives

**Qualifications**

* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, or related field preferred
* 1–3 years of purchasing, inventory, or administrative experience preferred
* Strong organizational and analytical skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and ERP systems
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in industrial distribution, construction supply, or PVF industry
* Familiarity with inventory management systems or ERP software
* Experience working with vendor relationships and supply chain coordination

**Benefits**

* Competitive wage based on experience
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Paid time off and holidays
* Opportunities for career growth within the organization

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates should submit their resume to:

missy@hempelpipe.com

**Job No:** 503928
**Work Type:** Staff Full Time (1500 hours or greater)
**Location:** Dayton, OH
**Category:** Research Institute Staff
**Department:** Procurement - 250231
**Pay Grade:** P1 - Exempt
**Advertised:** October 05, 2026

**Applications close:** October 18, 2026

**Position Summary:**

Join UDRI and help support cutting-edge research through effective, compliant procurement. In this role, you will work with internal teams, suppliers, and subcontractors to source materials, equipment, and services while navigating federal acquisition requirements and University procedures. This is a great opportunity for a procurement professional who enjoys problem-solving, negotiation, and supporting a mission-driven research environment.

Review and approve requests for material, equipment and services in compliance with Federal Government acquisition regulations, uniform guidance and in accordance with University policies and procedures.

Responsibilities include acquiring specifications (design drawings, SOWs, specifications, etc.); identifying and rationalizing source(s); obtaining and analyzing quotes; negotiation; and input and tracking of requisitions in an eProcurement environment.

Acquire, qualify, input and manage sponsor, subcontractor and vendor business information for UDRI.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

Bachelor’s degree in business, accounting, finance or related field OR Associates degree in business plus 3 years of purchasing experience.
Experience with ERP system.
Experience with eProcurement system.
Experience in professional role with procurement fundamentals.
Ability to read and speak English.
Strong organization skills.

Effective telephone, oral communication and interpersonal skills.+-

Proficient with Microsoft Office software suite.
Ability to prioritize work and manage multiple tasks effectively.
Due to the requirements of our research contracts with the U.S. federal government, candidates for this position must be a U.S. citizen.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

While not everyone may possess all of the preferred qualifications, the ideal candidate will bring many of the following:

Familiarity with Federal Acquisition Regulations.
Advanced experience with Deltek CostPoint modules.
Experience with Jaggaer eProcurement system.
Experience in purchasing at a not for profit, research or Government agency.
Certification through Institute for Supply Management.
Familiarity and experience with ISO.

**Special Instructions to Applicants:**

To apply please submit a cover letter addressing each minimum qualification and any applicable preferred qualifications that you meet.

**Closing Statement:**

Informed by its Catholic and Marianist mission, the University is committed to the dignity of every human being. Informed by this commitment, we seek to increase diversity in all of its forms, achieve fair outcomes, and model inclusion across our campus community. The University is committed to policies of affirmative action designed to increase the employment opportunities of individuals with disabilities and protected veterans in compliance with the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 and Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act of 1973.

**About Us**

Heidelberg Materials is one of the world's largest suppliers of building materials. Heidelberg Materials North America operates over 450 locations across the U.S. and Canada with approximately 9,000 employees.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Receive, check in, organize, and maintain parts and materials within the plant storeroom, including completing goods receipts.
* Pull, check out, palletize, and distribute parts and equipment needed by the maintenance and plant teams.
* Maintain accurate inventory and transaction records while helping ensure parts are properly stored and readily available when needed.
* Use SAP to complete basic storeroom transactions, including receiving materials and tracking parts moving in and out of inventory.
* Work closely with maintenance and other plant employees to support daily operational needs while maintaining an organized and efficient storeroom.

**What Are We Looking For**

* Mechanical or maintenance knowledge with the ability to identify and understand common parts and equipment preferred.
* Previous experience in a plant, industrial, warehouse, storeroom, or parts environment is beneficial but not required.
* Basic computer skills; SAP or similar inventory management system experience is preferred but can be trained.
* Dependable, self-motivated, and willing to learn, with the ability to work independently and take initiative.
* Strong communication and teamwork skills with a willingness to assist maintenance and other plant employees as needed.

**Work Environment**

* Fast-paced and dynamic work environment.
* Collaborative team culture with opportunities for professional growth.
* Commitment to safety and sustainability in all operations.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive base salary $46,880 - $55,085
* 401(k) retirement savings plan with an automatic company contribution as well as matching contributions.
* Highly competitive benefits programs, including:
+ Medical, Dental, and Vision along with Prescription Drug Benefits.
+ Health Savings Account (HSA), Health Reimbursement Account (HRA), and Flexible Spending Account (FSA).
+ AD&D, Short- and Long-Term Disability Coverage as well as Basic Life Insurance.
+ Paid Bonding Leave, 15 days of Paid Vacation, 40 hours of Paid Sick Leave, and 10 Paid Holidays.

Equal Opportunity Employer - Minority / Female / Veteran / Disabled

description:
**Company Overview**

Holafly is a high-growth scale-up revolutionising how businesses and travellers connect to the internet abroad. Since 2018, we’ve empowered travellers in over 200 destinations worldwide with secure and reliable eSIM solutions. With a team of 800+ professionals across multiple countries, we are scaling globally to support travellers with seamless, unlimited data connectivity.

We’re not just connecting people—we’re enabling freedom and peace of mind, ensuring our users stay connected from the second they land, wherever their journey takes them.

**The Role**

As our first Head of Procurement, you will build our global procurement function from scratch, directly driving profitability through strategic vendor alignment. Your leadership will secure critical telecom partnerships and transform procurement into a sustainable growth engine.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build Holafly's global procurement strategy from the ground up to support rapid international expansion.
* Negotiate high-stakes telecom contracts to secure top-tier pricing, quality, and SLA terms across markets.
* Establish company-wide procurement policies and vendor risk frameworks for governance.
* Optimize global supplier spend, unlocking cost savings without compromising service quality.
* Scale vendor performance metrics to ensure long-term supplier reliability across 200+ destinations.
* Partner with cross-functional leadership to align procurement goals with overarching product strategy.

**Qualifications**

* Proven procurement leadership, +5 years exp. ideally within a fast-growing scale-up or tech environment.
* Direct experience building procurement frameworks and vendor management workflows from zero.
* Expertise in international contract negotiations and financial analysis for complex service agreements.
* Strong leadership capabilities with a passion for designing scalable processes.

**Nice to Have**

* Background in Telecom, Connectivity, or SaaS environments.
* Knowledge of international vendor compliance and cross-border operations.

**Benefits & Perks**

* Fully Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with trust-based flexibility and a focus on work-life balance.
* Professional Development Stipend: Dedicated budgets for continuous education, courses, and certifications.
* Global Scale-Up Impact: Direct influence on the future of connectivity within an international culture.
* Competitive Package: Enjoy comprehensive benefits, continuous learning, and real opportunities for career growth.

description:
**Summary:**

* The Chief Procurement Officer has oversight for the procurement program for all County offices, including developing and implementing procurement policies and procedures and oversees the professional and clerical staff.

**Essential Duties:**

* Manage the County's centralized purchasing function including the procurement activities of the professional and clerical staff.
* Establish departmental objectives, directs priorities, interprets purchasing policies, rules, and regulations governing procurement activities.
* Maintain relationships with contractors and suppliers to resolve problems, explore new business opportunities and maintain productive partnerships.
* Assist and educate County personnel of all levels in resolving purchasing discrepancies and familiarizing managers with purchasing laws in areas from processing requisitions to conforming to terms and conditions of contracts.
* Develop specifications and documents for solicitation of public Invitations to Bid and Requests for Proposals on major procurements of equipment, materials and services for all County agencies.
* Oversee conduct of the bidding process, insuring compliance with legal, regulatory and other requirements governing public procurement.
* Interview and work with contractors, suppliers, department heads and other officials concerning the purchasing of supplies and equipment.
* Function as chairperson of RFP evaluation committees (when applicable); provides technical expertise concerning contract specifications; analyzes bid and proposal responses, and administers the entire formal public bidding process.
* Participate in professional or collegial organizations that provide information and/or purchasing opportunities for the County, e.g. Lehigh Valley Cooperative Purchasing Council (LVCPC), the Southeastern Pennsylvania Counties Cooperative Purchasing Board (SPCCPB), the Pennsylvania Public Purchasing Association (PAPPA), NIGP: The Institute for Public Procurement.
* Perform related work as needed.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* The Chief Procurement Officer has supervisory responsibility for approximately (6) direct reports.

**Qualifications:**

* To perform this job successfully, the individual in this position must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the minimum knowledge, skills and ability required.

**Education/Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree (B. A.) from four-year college or university; or one to two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum of five (5) years' experience procuring goods and services, and managing competitive bids/proposals with the responsibility of at least $10 million in purchases annually and at least 30 user departments. Public procurement experience preferred, including familiarity with all aspects of Invitations to Bid and Requests for Proposal.
* Thorough knowledge of goals, objectives, methods and techniques applicable to the management of a centralized procurement program.
* Extensive knowledge and understanding of County policies and procedures, general law of contracts and Commonwealth, Federal, cooperative and other types of contracts.
* Thorough knowledge of methods, techniques and legal requirements commonly employed in purchasing commodities and services used by government at the local level.
* Thorough knowledge in using personal computers including Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and Outlook) and internet applications.

Description

The Kentucky Department of Corrections (DOC), Division of Adult Institutions operates 13 correctional facilities that house Kentucky's adult inmate population. The mission of DOC is to protect the citizens of the Commonwealth and to provide a safe, secure and humane environment for staff and offenders in carrying out the mandates of the legislative and judicial processes; and, to provide opportunities for offenders to acquire skills which facilitate non-criminal behavior.

This position is for the new Medical Facility, located on the grounds of Blackburn Correctional Complex.

If you are looking for a career within the Department of Corrections that provides opportunity for career development, then the Department of Corrections may have an opportunity for you! We are hiring a Purchasing Officer I. This position performs beginning level duties in the procurement of and, or, payment of goods and non-professional services on an agency wide-basis.

Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Gathers, prepares and maintains purchase and payment documents.
* Works with vendors to collect quotes, invoices and etc.
* Pro Card Holder and reconciles purchases.
* Monitors purchases made for conformance with the Model Procurement Code, (KRS 45A)
* Performs beginning level duties in the performance of and, or, payment of goods and non-professional services in accordance with the agency’s Small Purchase Authority.
* Performs other duties as directed by Fiscal Manager and Supervisor.

Minimum Requirements

**EDUCATION:** Graduate of a college or university with a bachelor's degree.

**EXPERIENCE, TRAINING, OR SKILLS:** NONE

**Substitute EDUCATION for EXPERIENCE:** NONE

**Substitute EXPERIENCE for EDUCATION:** Experience in purchasing will substitute for the required college on a year for year basis. Certification with the National Institute of Governmental Purchasing as a Certified Professional Public Buyer (CPPB) will substitute for one year of the college requirement OR certification as a Certified Public Purchasing Officer (CPPO) will substitute for two years of the college requirement.

**SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS (AGE, LICENSURE, REGULATION, ETC.):** NONE

Working Conditions

Incumbents working in this job title perform duties in an office setting.

Probationary Period

This job has an initial and promotional probationary period of 6 months, except as provided in KRS 18A.111.

If you have questions about this advertisement, please contact Kasey Schank at Kasey.Schank@ky.gov

An Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D

**SUMMARY**

The Procurement and Asset Management Officer provides organization-wide leadership for procurement, purchasing systems, vendor and contract management, inventory control, and fixed-asset administration. The position establishes and maintains procurement policies, approval workflows, vendor standards, reporting requirements, and system controls designed to promote cost efficiency, accountability, compliance, and operational reliability.

The position has primary responsibility for administering and continuously improving the organization’s procurement and purchase-order systems and works closely with executive leadership, Finance, Accounts Payable, Information Technology, Facilities, and department heads.

The Officer exercises organization-wide functional authority over procurement and asset-management processes within delegated limits established by the Executive Director and the organization’s Procurement Policy. The position supports compliance with the Board-approved budget but does not independently approve organizational budgets, transfer funds, authorize unbudgeted expenditures, or execute contracts unless specifically delegated by the Executive Director. Department heads remain responsible for departmental operations and budgets, subject to executive oversight. This authority is exercised under the direction and oversight of the COO and does not supersede the authority of the Executive Director, CFO, executive team, or Board of Directors

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

Procurement and Strategic Sourcing

* Lead and administer centralized procurement across all departments.
* Develop, recommend, and enforce purchasing policies within delegated authority.
* Review purchasing requests for compliance with policy, budget, specifications, and documentation requirements.
* Manage sourcing, bidding, vendor selection, contract negotiations, renewals, and supplier performance within delegated authority.
* Identify cost savings, cost avoidance, volume discounts, standardization opportunities, and purchasing efficiencies.
* Monitor spending by department, category, vendor, contract, and budget.
* Address noncompliant, emergency, duplicate, unauthorized, and off-contract purchases.

Procurement Systems and Process Improvement

* Administer and continuously improve the organization’s procurement and purchase-order systems, including workflow design, user access, system configuration, data integrity, reporting, documentation, training, procure-to-pay procedures, and coordination with Finance, Accounts Payable, Information Technology, and department users.

* Establish performance measures and continuously improve procurement processes and service delivery.
* Establish inventory standards, item classifications, reorder points, safety-stock levels, cycle counts, and stockroom procedures.
* Maintain accurate inventory records and investigate variances, shortages, excess stock, obsolete materials, and receiving discrepancies.
* Implement barcode or QR-code tracking where appropriate.
* Optimize purchasing schedules, order consolidation, product standardization, and inventory levels.

Fixed-Asset Management

* Maintain accurate records of assets from acquisition through assignment, transfer, maintenance, retirement, and disposal.
* Track equipment, technology, facilities assets, furnishings, and other organizational properties,
* Maintain information regarding asset location, custodian, condition, serial number, warranty, service history, and replacement needs.
* Coordinate asset inventories, reconciliations, transfers, secure disposal, and retirement with Finance, Information Technology, Facilities, and other departments.
* Support lifecycle planning, warranty management, preventive maintenance, and capital-replacement forecasting.

Executive Reporting and Planning

* Provide reports to the COO, CFO, and executive leadership regarding expenditures, savings, PO compliance, vendor performance, contract renewals, inventory accuracy, asset condition, and capital needs.
* Support annual budgeting and multi-year capital planning through analysis of asset age, condition, repair history, useful life, and total cost of ownership.
* Escalate procurement, vendor, compliance, inventory, or asset risks and recommend corrective action.
* **Other Duties:** Perform other related duties as assigned by the COO or Management

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

There are no supervisory responsibilities required in this position.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in procurement, supply chain, business, finance, operations, asset management, or a related field; equivalent experience may substitute.
* Five or more years of progressively responsible experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, contract management, asset management, facilities, or related operations.
* Demonstrated experience implementing or administering procurement, ERP, inventory, or asset-management systems.

Procurement Officer - (26142519)

**Why should you keep reading and consider working here?**

We know you have other work options, but we ask you to consider working with us at the State of Montana Department of Administration (DOA). Our foundation of success is having effective working relationships, built on mutual trust and respect. We will challenge you to be the best you can be and will work hard to provide a work environment that allows you to succeed. (You can learn more about the DOA here.)

**A Little About Our Business**

The State Procurement Services Division (SPSD) leads best-in-class procurement services through integrity, education, transparency, and innovation. We strive to administer effective and responsible procurements to maximize the value of public funds for Montana.

**What is this career opportunity?**
The Department of Administration's State Procurement Services Division is looking for a Procurement Officer who solves problems and communicates exceptionally well to support the Department of Corrections (DOC).

The State of Montana recently implemented a centralized procurement model built around an enterprise procurement team plus agency-based staff who work alongside the agencies they serve. In this role, you'll be a Department of Administration employee located at DOC, providing procurement support directly to the department. You'll be one of four procurement officers reporting to the DOC procurement supervisor.

You would be responsible for overseeing and coordinating all procurement activities within the DOC ensuring procurements and contracts are completed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with applicable laws, policies, procedures, and funding requirements. This position mentor’s DOC staff in procurement procedures, conducts solicitations for goods and services, and provides contract oversight and management of all assigned and on-going contracts.

If you have good judgment, organizational skills, and the ability to explain complex procurement and contracting requirements to a wide range of internal stakeholders you should apply! We are interested in an individual that is experienced in procurement but also open to someone that is passionate about learning and growing in this role.

Responsibilities Include:

* Develop clear scopes of work, specifications, solicitation documents, evaluation criteria, and contract documentation.
* Conduct market research and analyze pricing, proposals, contract terms, and procurement risk.
* Manage competitive solicitations, evaluations, awards, and contract administration in a fair, transparent, and defensible manner.
* Coordinate contract amendments, renewals, corrective actions, and contract closeout activities.
* Maintain ethical conduct, confidentiality, impartiality, and complete audit-ready procurement files.
* Support procurements essential to Corrections operations, including healthcare, food service, safety and security, technology, and other DOC programs.

*In this position you will be afforded the opportunity to telework, however there will be required weekly in office day(s) in Helena. Specific conditions will be outlined as part of the job offer and must adhere to state policy.*

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Public Administration, Communication, or related field; OR
* Associate degree in Business Public Administration, Communication, or related field and two years’ experience in technical writing, research, or project management; OR
* Alternate combinations of education and experience will be considered on a case-by-case basis.

**Competencies:**

*Ability to:*

* Deliver outstanding customer service
* Conduct research, system analysis, and data gathering analysis
* Prioritize multiple projects and deadlines while working independently in a fast-paced public-sector environment.
* Learn the theory, principles, practices and techniques of government contracting
* Learn the State of Montana's procurement process, administrative rules, and federal procurement rules and laws
* Work and effectively communicate with diverse levels of management and stakeholders
* Establish objectives and priorities based on goals and general direction provided by management
* Identify problems, emerging issues and trends, and establish strategies to address them
* Mediate and resolve disputes
* Work independently with minimal supervision

**Does this sound like you?** Please tell us how and why by submitting your **resume,** **cover letter, and three professional business references.**In your cover letter, please explain why you want to join our team to work in this position. *(Please Note: You do not need to complete the “work experience” or the “education & certifications” portion of the application process in our recruiting system.**You only need to upload the requested documentation.)*

**What can you expect from us in return for your work with our agency?**

**Title:** VIB Procurement Officer - #BVI00092

**State Role Title:** Procurement Officer I

**Hiring Range:** Starting salary low $60,000s up to high $60,000s commensurate with experience.

**Pay Band:** 4

**Agency:** Dept for Blind/Vision Impaired

**Location:** Blind & Vision Impaired

**Agency Website:** https://www.dbvi.virginia.gov

**Recruitment Type:** General Public - G

Help keep the mission moving by driving fast, accurate, and compliant purchasing across state and federal systems. If you’re energized by problem‑solving, vendor coordination, and owning a critical link in our production pipeline, we’d love to have you on the team.

**Job Duties:**

The objective/mission of the Virginia Industries for the Blind (VIB) is to employ and develop Virginians who are blind, visually impaired or deaf/blind to achieve their desired level of employment through the manufacture and delivery of quality products and services. To accomplish this objective / mission requires VIB to operate similar to a traditional business; maintaining efficient production, service and retail operations with strict financial controls to assure adhering to VIB's self-funded obligation, i.e., to accomplish its mission without the use of General Funds.

We are seeking a VIB Procurement Officer to process all assigned purchases in accordance with Commonwealth Purchasing Regulations and VIB Procurement Procedures for State-side; and process all assigned purchases in accordance with established federal procurement procedures. Obtains all required approvals for procurements that exceed delegated spend authority of $20,000. Provides procurement guidance to end-users. Assists VIB staff in maintaining and troubleshooting Procurement systems to include: eVA, Odoo, Counter Point (for a short period).

Duties include but are not limited to:

* General Procurement and Contracting
* Contract Management
* Communication, Troubleshooting, and Problem Solving
* Consult with Supervisor on any sensitive vendor or end user issues as they occur
* BSC Back-up Support:
+ Provide back-up support to the VIB Clerk for Counterpoint purchases on an as-need basis.
+ Processes Purchase Orders for EDI administrative items which are not stocked in BSCs.
+ Maintains procurement files to include all required documents.
- Purchase Requisition/specifications.
- Quotes
- Purchase Order and any other related documents.
+ Ensure accurate price quotes are obtained from vendors and/or verify the requested items are available via a contract from which VIB has approval to procure goods and/or services.
+ Receive and relay vendor messages to appropriate staff in an accurate and expedient manner.
+ Key data into Counterpoint within two business days of receiving Purchase Requisitions.
+ Request appropriate approvals prior to issuing Purchase Orders.

Other duties and/or special projects as assigned.

Completes duties and/or projects as needed or directed by supervisor.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

Certification:

* Certification as a Virginia Contracting Associate.

Experience:

* Experience in the development of specifications packages, the management of Commonwealth of VA competitive solicitations and contract awards, processing sole source and emergency determinations.

Knowledge:

* Working knowledge of State procurement laws including but not limited to the Virginia Public Procurement Act (VPPA); and of the Agency Procurement Surplus Property Manual (APSPM).
* Proficiency with eVA procurement systems, e-commerce, and inventory management.

Skills:

* Demonstrated skill in using automated procurement systems, e commerce platforms, and inventory management tools.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Strong oral and written communication skills; demonstrated telephone and customer service skills.
* Proficiency with automated purchasing software, MS Word, Excel, and database management.

Abilities:

* Demonstrated ability to process purchase requisitions into purchase orders in accordance with established policies and procedures supporting base supply operations.
* Demonstrated ability to interpret specifications and complete purchase orders in accordance with applicable policies and procedures.
* Ability to work effectively in a high-volume environment.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with vendors and internal end users.

**Additional Considerations:**

* Experience in Virginia public procurement/purchasing.
* Current Virginia Contract Administration and Risk Management (VCARM), Contracting Officer (VCO) certification or ability to obtain VCARM within one year of hire and VCO within two year(s) of hire; see https://vip.dgs.virginia.gov/ for more information on certification process.

description:
Make an impact on how Delaware does business. As a State Contract Procurement Officer I, you’ll help shape and manage contracts that support state agencies, schools, local governments, and other public organizations across Delaware. You’ll work with agency partners to develop solicitations, evaluate bids, recommend contract awards, manage existing contracts, and help ensure compliance with state procurement requirements. This is an opportunity to build valuable procurement and contract management expertise while contributing to efficient, responsible use of public resources. If you’re analytical, collaborative, detail-oriented, and ready to grow your career in public procurement, we invite you to apply.

**Essential Functions**
-----------------------

Essential functions are fundamental, core functions common to all positions in the class series and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all job duties for any one position in the class. Since class specifications are descriptive and not restrictive, incumbents can complete job duties of similar kind not specifically listed here.

* Manages existing centralized contracts to ensure compliance with terms of contract; monitors vendor performance and resolves contract disputes, complaints and price discrepancies; negotiates changes.
* Provides consultation services; interprets and explains applicable laws, rules, regulations, policies and procedures for contract development, monitoring, accounting, and auditing.
* Develops, reviews, plans and coordinates procurement activities such as writing bid specifications, developing Request for Proposals (RFP) and Invitations to Bid (ITB), advertising for bid, and recommending contract awards.
* Researches, analyzes and interprets technical aspects of bid specifications for goods and professional and non-professional service contracts.
* Develops proposal criteria in coordination with user agencies.
* Develops contract baselines, terms and conditions through market analysis.
* Conducts pre-bid meetings, facilitates RFP selection committee and participates on related procurement contract committees.
* Negotiates new contracts and contract extensions with vendors using best and final offer techniques and Request for Proposal procedures; recommends contract award, prepares award notice and notifies successful vendors.
* Recommends changes to existing state procurement and contract management processes.

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

**JOB REQUIREMENTS for State Contract Procurement Officer I**

Applicants must have education, training and/or experience demonstrating competence in each of the following areas:

* Six months experience in procurement services which includes purchasing goods and services in accordance with procurement procedures and contract specifications.

* Six months experience in contract management and control which includes ensuring compliance with terms of contracts; negotiating changes to existing contracts.

* Six months experience in interpreting laws, rules, regulations, standards, policies, and procedures.

* Knowledge of developing contracts for procurement of goods and services including researching and writing specifications, analyzing bids and recommending contract award.

**Conditions of Hire**
----------------------

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. The State of Delaware Executive Branch participates in the Federal E-Verify system where the State will provide the federal government with each new hires Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. For more information refer to our job seeker resources.

All new hires are required to report to the **Statewide New Employee Orientation (SNEO)** on their first day of employment. Sessions are held at designated locations in Kent or New Castle County.

**Benefits**
------------

To learn more about the comprehensive benefit package please visit our website at https://dhr.delaware.gov/benefits/

**Selection Process**
---------------------

The application and supplemental questionnaire are evaluated based upon a rating of your education, training and experience as they relate to the job requirements of the position. It is essential that you provide complete and accurate information on your application and the supplemental questionnaire to include dates of employment, job title and job duties. For education and training, list name of educational provider, training course titles and summary of course content. Narrative information supplied in response to the questions must be supported by the information supplied on the application including your employment, education and training history as it relates to the job requirements.

Once you have submitted your application on-line, all future correspondence related to your application will be sent via email. Please keep your contact information current. You may also view all correspondence sent to you by the State of Delawar
