description:
**Procurement Coordinator**
===========================

Riddleberger Brothers, Inc. (RBI), a leading mechanical contractor in the Shenandoah Valley, is seeking a Procurement Coordinator to join our service team in Mount Crawford, VA. This full-time position will manage purchasing processes, vendor relationships, inventory, and material logistics to support efficient service operations.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and manage purchasing processes that promote value and operational efficiency.
* Coordinate equipment and material purchasing to support project schedules and minimize work in progress.
* Prioritize and process call-in material orders.
* Issue purchase orders with accurate vendor, part, pricing, and job or truck-stock information.
* Follow up with vendors, technicians, customers, and dispatchers regarding material availability and delivery schedules.
* Negotiate with vendors to secure the best overall value.
* Utilize vendors participating in the Comfort Systems USA National Purchasing Program.
* Process material returns, warranty claims, and RMA requests.
* Develop and maintain a preferred vendor list.
* Safely operate forklifts and vehicles to transport materials as needed.
* Manage main stock inventory, including quarterly checks, inventory counts, and auditor coordination.
* Manage small-tool procurement and tracking by technician and vehicle.
* Stock and prepare vehicles for new hires.
* Assist with purchase order entry and pricing.
* Provide backup support for quote processing, work order processing, invoicing, quoting, and accounts payable invoice processing.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Minimum of three years of experience in the commercial HVAC industry.
* Experience in materials purchasing preferred.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Outlook, and Excel.
* Working knowledge of materials and systems related to the mechanical or HVAC industry.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, organizational, and follow-up skills.
* Excellent communication and customer service skills.
* Professional, positive, cooperative, and teachable attitude.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Ability to coordinate multiple activities and meet deadlines.
* Valid driver’s license required; ability to meet company driver qualification standards preferred.
* Ability to pass a background check and drug screening.

**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------

* Ability to climb stairs and ladders as needed.
* Ability to stand, squat, bend, and stoop.
* Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and frequently carry up to 40 pounds unassisted in a warehouse environment.
* Ability to accurately read a ruler or tape measure.
* Ability to work 8- to 10-hour days, maintain a flexible schedule, and work overtime when necessary.
* Some exposure to outdoor weather or elements may be required.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

We believe in investing in our employees and providing opportunities for long-term success. When you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

* Competitive pay: $23.50 - $29.00 an hour or $48,880 - $60,320 a year
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Growth and development opportunities
* Apprenticeship opportunities with a pathway to licensure
* Scholarship program for employees’ children
* Employee referral incentives
* Discounts at major automotive, computer, and cell phone companies
* Company vehicle, mobile phone/tablet, and uniforms when applicable
* Annual bonus opportunities
* Supportive team environment and strong safety culture

**Our Benefits Package Includes**
---------------------------------

* Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
* Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
* Accidental Death & Dismemberment Insurance
* Health Care and Dependent Care FSAs
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* 401(k) Plan with Roth IRA option
* Pet Insurance
* Generous vacation, holiday, and sick time
* And much more!

Riddleberger Brothers, Inc., a Comfort Systems USA company, is an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Herzog Energy, Inc. is currently seeking a **Procurement Coordinator** in **St. Joseph, MO** to join our team and support the growing Procurement and Supply Chain function within Herzog Energy.

The Procurement Coordinator supports the day-to-day administrative, data management, vendor coordination, and purchasing activities necessary to support Herzog Energy's construction projects.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* This is a non-exhaustive overview of the job duties for this position.

* Procurement & Administrative Support: Support the Procurement and Supply Chain Manager with daily purchasing and procurement activities across active and upcoming renewable energy projects, including general administrative duties, special projects, and process improvement initiatives as assigned.
* Records Management: Enter, maintain, and update procurement information within company systems, spreadsheets, and tracking tools.
* Vendor Records: Maintain current vendor contact information, capabilities, certifications, catalogs, and other supplier information.
* Contract Administration Support: Track contract and subcontract status, signatures, revisions, required documentation, and other administrative requirements.
* Invoice Support: Assist with matching invoices to purchase orders and supporting documentation and identify discrepancies for review.
* Reporting: Prepare routine procurement reports and provide accurate information regarding open purchase orders, pending approvals, upcoming deliveries, vendor documentation, and other procurement activities.
* Adhere to established company policies, procedures, terms and conditions, and legal matters that affect purchasing and procurement activities.
* Perform all duties in conformance with appropriate safety policies and procedures.
* Regular and consistent engagement, participation and promotion of Herzog’s Culture and its essential behaviors are a requirement for this position.
* Regular and predictable attendance and punctuality are a requirement for this position.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail are a must.
* Time-management skills are essential; must possess a natural sense of urgency and work well with pressure and deadlines.
* Must be a self-starter and able to excel in a fast-paced environment.
* Flexible and adaptive to change.
* Possess a high level of ingenuity.
* Must have strong interpersonal skills, ability to interact with all levels of employees and prospects.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Products and advanced computer literacy skills.
* Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality

**Pre-Employment Requirements:**

* Subject to pre-employment background check and motor vehicle report review.
* Subject to pre-employment physical, medical evaluation, and drug screen.
* Successfully complete and maintain any required safety certification and testing on an annual basis.

**Physical Requirements:**

The physical demands described below must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential job functions of this role. This is a non-exhaustive overview of the physical requirements for this position.

* Work primarily in an office environment.
* Frequently sits for extended periods of time.
* Frequently use a computer keyboard and office related equipment.
* Requires occasional standing, walking, lifting, stooping or bending.

**Safety:**

* Herzog is nationally recognized for its excellent corporate safety record which results from all employees at all levels, in all positions adhering to established policies and procedures. Reporting any and all safety violations to your immediate supervisor is a prerequisite for continued employment. Safety diligence by all results in a safe work environment for all.

**Benefits:**

* Herzog offers a robust benefits package including medical and dental coverage. The plans are specific to projects and locations.

**Why Herzog:**

Founded in 1969, Herzog is headquartered in St. Joseph, Missouri, with a satellite office in Fort Worth, Texas.

Over the course of our 50+ year history, Herzog has become a national leader in the construction, operations and maintenance of commuter rail, light rail, streetcar, and freight rail projects.

We believe our culture is at the heart of our existence. It is that belief which empowers every member of our professional family to act with purpose and passion as they advance their career throughout their personal pursuit of excellence.

Backed by over five decades of experience, Herzog delivers exceptional customer service and elite results.

Our success is the outcome of our relentless pursuit of excellence, our passion for our customers, safety without compromise, and a deep-rooted belief in the power of team.

We invite you to join us on our journey to excellence as we work to be better today than yesterday and better tomorr

description:
**Position Summary**

The Purchasing Coordinator, based in Las Vegas, NV, plays a pivotal role in managing procurement operations, product research, and vendor negotiations under the direction of the Purchasing Manager. This role is responsible for executing the end-to-end purchasing workflow utilizing enterprise procurement software (SpendMap) to source goods, manage purchase orders, track inventory par levels, and reconcile invoices. By driving strong vendor relationships and aggressive cost negotiation, the Purchasing Coordinator ensures high-quality products and supplies are delivered efficiently to support the luxury operational standards of Paws Up Montana.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Procurement & Order Management:** Enter, process, expedite, and track purchase requests and purchase orders from initial order creation through final delivery using SpendMap.
* **Vendor Negotiations & Cost Control:** Actively research products, conduct three-bid competitive sourcing, and negotiate pricing with suppliers to secure the best possible quality and price for resort supplies.
* **Inventory & Par Level Support:** Assist in maintaining optimal inventory par levels across multiple operational areas, with dedicated focus on guest supplies, small tools, and operational equipment.
* **Vendor Relations & Invoice Reconciliation:** Establish and maintain positive relationships with suppliers and representatives while managing invoice reconciliation and order tracking.
* **Interdepartmental Support & Collaboration:** Partner closely with internal property departments and executive offices to resolve procurement inquiries, maintain delivery timelines, and fulfill supply needs.
* **Accountability & Workspace Maintenance:** Maintain meticulous organized records, purchase order files, and vendor databases to ensure total compliance and operational efficiency.
* **Ad-Hoc Duties:** Perform additional small projects and duties as assigned by the Purchasing Manager.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:** Minimum of 2–3 years of purchasing experience handling a diverse range of product categories; familiarity with building materials or hospitality supplies is a plus.
* **Specialized Knowledge:** Deep understanding of the purchasing lifecycle, competitive three-bid processes, purchase order management, and contract negotiation.
* **Core Skills:** Superior negotiation, organization, and problem-solving skills; high detail orientation with an energetic, adaptable, and "think outside the box" work approach.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Strong working knowledge of enterprise procurement systems (SpendMap experience preferred), advanced internet research skills, and proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* **Work Style:** Ability to work effectively in an office setting, maintaining professionalism, discretion, and a neat presentation in all interdepartmental interactions.
* **Licensing/Certification:** High School Diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related field preferred.

**Physical Requirements**

* **Mobility & Stamina:** Ability to sit constantly for extended periods of daily computer, system, and telephone work, with occasional standing and walking throughout the office.
* **Scheduling:** Ability to work full-time hours, with flexibility as needed to accommodate operational demands and supply chain priorities.
* **Lifting & Handling:** Ability to occasionally lift, carry, reach, or handle office files, packages, and procurement samples weighing up to 15–20 lbs.

This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the position and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities, or working conditions associated with the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.*

* A proactive approach to problem-solving with a keen attention to detail.

R10102617 Purchasing Coordinator (Open)

Location:

Branchburg, NJ (HO) - US Hwy 22 W - Advanced materials

The science of electronics is transforming exponentially through innovation and connectivity around the planet. Every day, breakthroughs are making technologies – from micro-processors, memory chips and flat panels to photovoltaic cells – even smaller and more powerful, opening up countless new possibilities in how the world lives, works and connects. Air Liquide Advanced Materials grows by enabling our customers to innovate. Our ALOHA™ and Voltaix® products are critical to the manufacturer of the newest computer chips required for Big Data and the Internet of Things.

**How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?**
-------------------------------------

The Purchasing Coordinator is responsible for managing day-to-day procurement operations, including reviewing requisitions, placing purchase orders, and managing vendor relationships for MRO and raw materials. This role focuses on maintaining accurate PO data within ERP systems (preferably SAP), negotiating contract terms within budgetary guidelines, driving cost-reduction initiatives, and cross-functionally resolving invoice and supply chain discrepancies.

**Air Liquide is Hiring for a Purchasing Coordinator!**

**WE ARE LOOKING FOR YOU!**
===========================

* Pay Range: $57k - $72k annually
* Annual bonus: 5%
* Benefits starting on first day
Work Schedule: Hybrid (3 day in office required)

Responsibilities:

* Review purchase requisitions, place purchase orders, and follow up with vendors for MRO and raw materials orders
* Keep pertinent purchase order information up to date within SAP
* Follow up with vendors regarding delivery dates on POs and scheduling releases from blanket orders. Expedites purchases and purchase orders when required.
* Review supplier bid proposals and negotiate contracts within budgetary limitations and scope of authority
* Maintain certifications for pressure vessels and assist Supply Chain team in providing certifications to vendors
* Develop and implement cost reduction ideas for MRO items
* Assist the Purchasing Department staff in vendor sourcing and other projects as required
* Reconcile any purchase order / invoice discrepancies with AP as needed
* Troubleshoot errors within ERP system
* Create new part numbers and assist with the setup of new vendors within ERP system
* Maintain contractor approval documentation and status
* Interfaces with other departments within the organization to resolve issues with purchase orders and purchased items
* Assist with the sourcing of capital items for Engineering, R&D, Product Development, etc.
* Maintenance of Purchasing documents and procedures

**\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_**
----------------------------------------

**Are you a MATCH?**
--------------------

Required Qualifications:

* High School diploma or equivalent
* Ability to work in a team environment
* Strong attention to detail
* 3+ years of experience in Purchasing, Procurement, or Supply Chain
Bachelor's degree in Business or Supply Chain accepted in lieu of relevant work experience

Preferred Qualifications:

* Strong ERP system experience, especially with SAP
* Chemical or Electronics industry operations experience
* Knowledge of SAP
* Proficiency in Google Suite applications

**Our Differences make our Performance**

At Air Liquide, we are committed to build a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces the diversity of our employees, our customers, patients, community stakeholders and cultures across the world.

We welcome and consider applications from all qualified applicants, regardless of their background. We strongly believe a diverse organization opens up opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively and it helps foster our ability to innovate by living our fundamentals, acting for our success and creating an engaging environment in a changing world.

description:
**About BLCCS**

BLCCS, LLC is a San Antonio-based commercial MEP service company providing HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing, Building Automation & Controls, Energy Services, and Preventive Maintenance.

Founded in 2017, BLCCS supports commercial and mission-critical facilities throughout the San Antonio area. As we continue to grow, we are looking for someone who can take ownership of our tools, inventory, purchasing, vehicle stock, refrigerant tracking, and warehouse operations.

**Position Summary**

The **Inventory, Warehouse & Procurement Coordinator** is responsible for maintaining accurate records of company tools, equipment, materials, vehicle inventory, refrigerant, purchasing, and purchase orders.

This is a hands-on position that combines warehouse responsibilities with administrative and technology-based work. The ideal candidate is organized, comfortable working with technicians and vendors, strong with Excel and technology, and willing to take ownership of processes from start to finish.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain accurate inventory of company tools, equipment, and materials.
* Track tools assigned to employees, vehicles, jobsites, and the warehouse.
* Maintain serial numbers, purchase dates, warranty information, and assignment records.
* Manage tool check-in/check-out and replacement requests.
* Verify warranty or repair options before approving replacement purchases.
* Conduct periodic physical inventory audits.
* Maintain standard vehicle inventory and perform vehicle inventory checks.
* Track refrigerant purchases, technician usage, vehicle stock, and refrigerant logs.
* Reconcile refrigerant inventory and identify discrepancies.
* Create and process purchase orders.
* Purchase approved tools, parts, materials, equipment, and supplies.
* Obtain vendor pricing and availability and follow up on outstanding orders.
* Receive deliveries and verify materials against purchase orders.
* Coordinate returns, damaged materials, and vendor discrepancies.
* Help prevent unnecessary or duplicate purchases.
* Organize warehouse inventory and maintain designated storage locations.
* Prepare materials and equipment for technicians and projects.
* Maintain a clean, safe, and organized warehouse.
* Safely operate a forklift and assist with loading, unloading, and material movement.

**Excel & Technology Requirements**

**\\*\\*Strong Microsoft Excel skills are required.\\*\\***

The successful candidate must be comfortable using Excel to track and manage:

* Tool inventory
* Vehicle inventory
* Refrigerant logs
* Purchase orders
* Warehouse inventory
* Warranty information

Candidates should be comfortable with sorting, filtering, formulas, data organization, and basic reporting.

The position also requires the ability to learn and use inventory systems, purchasing software, mobile apps, electronic forms, ticketing systems, QR/barcode systems, and other technology used by BLCCS.

**Qualifications**

* Strong organizational and recordkeeping skills.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong Excel and overall technology skills.
* Ability to identify and resolve inventory discrepancies.
* Comfortable working with technicians, vendors, and management.
* Comfortable holding employees accountable for assigned company tools and equipment.
* Valid driver's license.
* Clean driving record required.
* Must meet company vehicle insurance requirements.
* Must successfully pass a background check.
* Ability to safely operate a forklift; certification preferred or ability to obtain certification required.
* Ability to perform normal warehouse and material-handling duties.
* Previous inventory, purchasing, warehouse, construction, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, or facilities experience is preferred.

**Compensation**

**$18.00–$24.00 per hour, depending on experience.**

Compensation will be based on relevant experience, Excel and technology proficiency, purchasing or inventory experience, and the candidate's ability to independently manage the responsibilities of the position.

**What Success Looks Like**

The right person will help BLCCS maintain clear accountability for:

What we own, where it is, who has it, what was purchased, what is under warranty, what needs to be reordered, and what needs attention.

We are looking for someone who is organized, proactive, technology-capable, and willing to take ownership as BLCCS continues to grow.

Pay: $18.00 - $24.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Opportunities for advancement
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Prescription drug insurance
* Vision insurance

**Company Description**

Rexel USA is one of the largest distributors of electrical products, data communication, wireless communication and related supplies in the United States. Rexel USA operates its electrical distribution business in the United States through eight Regions that go to market under various banner and trade names, including Rexel, Rexel Automation, Gexpro, Mayer, Talley and Platt Electric Supply. In addition to an online store, Rexel USA has a distribution network of over 460 warehouse storefront locations throughout the U.S.

**Job Description**

**We are looking for a Procurement Coordinator to join our Rexel USA team in Mesquite, TX!**

**Summary:**
The Procurement Coordinator is responsible for supporting the Procurement team on day-to-day tasks including monitoring inventory levels, expediting, and scheduling the delivery of purchase orders for inventory replenishment and customer backorders, as well as placing purchase orders when needed. Will work with various internal and external stakeholders to ensure problems are resolved in a timely manner.

**What You'll Do:**

* Support Procurement team with day-to-day tasks including monitoring inventory levels, expediting, and scheduling the delivery of purchase orders for inventory replenishment and customer backorders, as well as placing purchase orders when needed
* Daily review of critical items below minimum, allocations, or stock outs for regional Customer Solution Centers
* Meet or exceed defined fill rate/service level for regional branches and/or assigned supplier lines
* Work with suppliers when there are any shipping issues or discrepancies with product (e.g. non-conformity receipts issues including incorrect items, damaged boxes, quantity differences, poor quality, etc.)
* Assist payable variance resolution with Accounts Payable team when invoice matching issues arise
* Coordinate with warehouse on delivery status of purchase orders and communication to and from suppliers and freight forwarders on expedited shipment dates
* Monitor and push out communication on expedited shipments and updates from suppliers to sales teams and into ERP system
* Interface with multiple departments and resolve problems and issue as necessary
* Analyze and manage unhealthy inventory by updating stock flags, reviewing item minimums, and coordinating excess inventory transfers back to the Customer Solution Center
* Assist Inventory Planner with negotiations and execution of supplier returns
* Other duties as assigned

**Job Duties Disclaimer:**
The information contained in this job description is intended to describe the essential job functions required of those assigned to this job. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, knowledge, skills, and abilities needed to perform the job. Please note that management retains the right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The ability to competently perform all the essential duties of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, demonstrate commitment to effective customer service delivery, integrity, and the ability to work productively as a member of a team or work group are basic requirements of all positions at Rexel USA.

**Qualifications**

**What You'll Need**

* 2+ years of procurement experience preferred
* Prior experience in the electrical distribution industry preferred
* High School or GED - Required

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Excellent computer skills including Microsoft Office products
* Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills
* Ability to communicate effectively with partners at all levels
* Be a self-starter
* Attention to detail
* Excellent time management skills
* Ability to prioritize and organize

**Additional Information**

**Physical Demands:**

* Sit: Must be able to remain in a stationary position - Constantly – at least 51%
* Walk: Must be able to move about inside/outside office or work location - Frequently – 21% to 50%
* Use hands to finger, handle, or feel: Operates a computer and other office machinery - Constantly – at least 51%
* Stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl: Must be able to crouch down to stock shelves, pick up boxes, or position oneself to maintain computers in the lab/under desks/in server closet - Occasionally – up to 20%
* Climb or balance: Must be able to ascend/descend on a ladder, forklift, pallet jack, or other warehouse equipment - Occasionally – up to 20%
* Talk, hear, taste, smell: Must be able to use senses to effectively communicate with co-workers and clients and detect hazardous conditions - Constantly – at least 51%

**Weight and Force Demands:**

* Up to 10 pounds - Occasionally – up to 20%
* Up to 25 pounds - Occasionally – up to 20%

**Working Environment:**

* Exposed to unpleasant or disagreeable physical environment such as high noise level and/or exposure to heat and cold - Occasionally – up to 20%
* Travels to offsite locations

Plantain Products Company - Chifles, the number one plantain chip brand in the U.S. by dollar sales, is hiring a Logistics and Procurement Coordinator in Miami-Dade. You will own daily freight quoting and booking, shipment coordination, purchase orders for packaging, racks and displays, and fleet compliance scheduling. Execution done well and done reliably, reporting to the Director of Operations and Logistics.

This role keeps product moving and orders flowing every day. This is an individual contributor role; it does not manage people.

**Full-time, on-site.** Pay is $60,000 to $75,000 per year. Benefits include health insurance, a 401(k) match and paid time off.

**First 90 days**

* Take over daily logistics and purchasing through a 90-day handover, working beside the people who run it today.
* Run the freight quoting cycle and the weekly delivery schedule without supervision.
* Keep the carrier and supplier scorecard current.

**How we evaluate**

A conversation, then a practical exercise based on real logistics and purchasing work. Details are shared with candidates who move forward.

Chifles is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected characteristic.

**Compensation:**

$60,000 - $75,000 yearly

**Responsibilities:**

**Freight and daily logistics**

* Freight quoting and carrier booking, the largest single piece of the job. Solicit and compare FTL and LTL rates daily across our broker and carrier bench, hold a lane to a ceiling, and book.
* Live shipment coordination and exceptions: bills of lading and corrections, pickup confirmations and reschedules, trailer status, refused shipments, damage and shortage claims.
* Retailer purchase order cross-check, near daily, across our club and retail accounts: read each incoming PO against what was quoted and what will ship, and catch the leakage before it becomes a deduction. Order entry itself sits with the customer service team.
* Build and publish the weekly DSD delivery schedule to our independent distributor network and the internal sales and operations team.
* Purchase order reconciliation with brokers, mapping retailer PO lines and ship dates to SKUs.
* Packaging and inbound supplier documentation, including case and state-specific label specifications and inbound container paperwork.
* Share ship dates and order volumes with the warehouse team so it can plan the week.

**Purchase orders and follow-through**

* Place and manage purchase orders for film, packaging and other non-fruit inputs, tracking lead times and reorder points against the production plan.
* Own rack and display purchasing end to end: quantities against the program, lead times, delivery to the plant, and the paperwork behind each order.
* Approve packaging box purchase orders prepared by the warehouse team before they are sent.
* Keep the carrier and supplier scorecard current: on-time-in-full, fill rate, cost variance against quote.
* Check carrier invoices against the quoted rate and flag every variance.
* Work inside the freight and spend limits the Director sets, and escalate above them.
* Oversee the weekly inventory reconciliation in the ERP: check that each category owner completed their count, follow up on the ones that did not, and escalate variances.
* Handle day-to-day operational exceptions, including some outside normal hours.

**Fleet**

* DOT compliance for our trucks and drivers: files, inspections, renewals and the calendar behind them. Low frequency, zero tolerance for a lapse.
* Truck and trailer maintenance scheduling across owned and leased units, so a unit out of service never surprises the delivery schedule.

**Qualifications:**

* 2 to 4 years in logistics, freight, shipping or purchasing, in food, CPG, distribution or manufacturing.
* Hands-on experience booking FTL and LTL freight and working with brokers and carriers.
* Comfortable working inside an ERP rather than around it in spreadsheets. Acumatica experience is a plus.
* Solid Excel, and the care to keep a running scorecard accurate.
* Demonstrated AI proficiency. A requirement, not a preference. We use AI tools daily across the company, and you will be expected to do the same.
* Bilingual, Spanish and English. Much of the plant floor and warehouse work in Spanish.
* Organized under load, and willing to chase a carrier until you get an answer.

**About Company**

Plantain Products Company - Chifles is the number one plantain chip brand in the United States by dollar sales. We are family-owned, with about 65 employees. Our Miami operation bags cooked chips that arrive in bulk from our suppliers and builds the displays that ship to clubs and retailers. Our product moves through national retailers, warehouse clubs, a Florida DSD route network, and independent distributors.

**Senior Procurement Coordinator**
==================================

**Location:** On Site at Salt Lake City, UT **Employment Type:** Full-Time **Pay Type:** Salary **Reports To:** Head of Group Procurement

**About the Role**
------------------

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Senior Procurement Coordinator to manage sourcing, purchasing, supplier relations, and inventory alignment across six store-front locations. This role will serve as the central point of coordination for purchasing operations and will utilize Odoo ERP to track demand, manage purchase orders, optimize inventory, and ensure cost-effective buying decisions. The ideal candidate has strong experience in multi-location procurement, vendor performance management, and data-driven purchasing using Odoo or similar ERP. Coatings and construction materials background is considered a plus.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

PurchasingProcurement Execution

* Create, track, and manage purchase orders in Odoo ERP across six storefronts
* Consolidate purchasing needs across locations to leverage volume and pricing
* Ensure timely replenishment based on reorder points, safety stock, and demand forecasts
* Conduct competitive price reviews and cost benchmarking

ERPData Management

* Maintain accurate supplier catalogs, lead times, and pricing in Odoo
* Monitor product availability, landed cost, and purchase history
* Generate procurement and spend visibility reports in Odoo
* Support system improvements, workflow automation, and purchasing dashboards

VendorSupply Chain Management

* Build and maintain supplier relationships to ensure reliability and service quality
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and delivery schedules
* Resolve backorders, shortages, and quality issues
* Evaluate supplier performance using KPIs (on-time delivery, cost variance, defect rate)

Cross-Location Coordination

* Collaborate with store managers to validate demand planning and inventory needs
* Standardize SKUs and purchasing specifications to reduce complexity
* Participate in product substitutions and sourcing alternatives when needed
* Support logistics coordination and delivery routing for multiple locations

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3-5+ years of procurement, purchasing, or supply chain coordination experience
* Experience working with ERPs (plus)
* Strong understanding of purchase planning, inventory controls, and vendor negotiations
* Excellent Excel or ERP-based reporting skills
* Strong communication skills and high attention to detail
* Multi-location procurement experience preferred

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* ERP-based decision making
* Negotiation and supplier management
* Time-sensitive problem solving
* Cost awareness and continuous improvement mindset
* Process documentation / standardization
* Ownership and accountability
* ISO
* LEAN

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelors in a Business, Engineering, or Economics concertation required
* Masters degree preferred

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive compensation
* Growth opportunities in procurement / supply chain
* Exposure to multi-location operations and ERP optimization
* Matching 401K
* Full Insurance package available
* PTO

Join the Cleveland Clinic team where you will work alongside passionate caregivers and make a lasting, meaningful impact on patient care. Here, you will receive endless support and appreciation while building a rewarding career with one of the most respected healthcare organizations in the world.

At Cleveland Clinic's Transplant Center, experts perform a variety of transplantation procedures. Each year, thousands of lives are saved and transformed because of our innovative expertise. As Donor Procurement Coordinator, you will coordinate all activities related to the receipt of organ offers for transplant, evaluation of organ offers for suitability, procurement of organs and transplant set-ups. Your position is essential to the organization and functioning of the Transplant Center, allowing caregivers to supply patients with the necessary treatment they need.

**This is a remote role. A caregiver in this position works varying 12hr shifts on a day/night rotation.**

A caregiver who excels in this role will:

* Comply with OPTN/UNOS requirements for post-transplant documentation of donor and transplant activities.

* Serve as the contact for all potential offers for transplant from local, regional and national organ procurement organizations.

* Organize the procurement team and dispatch team to the donor site within the required time frame.

* Coordinate air or ground transportation of organs.

* Serve as a resource for organ recovery and preservation.

* Assist in training organ preservation caregivers.

* Orient new residents and fellows to renal procurement, renal allocation and regulatory requirements.

* Develop and present professional education programs as needed.

* Obtain, analyze and report pertinent data regarding potential donors and accepted organs for transplants.

* Attend selection committee meetings.

* Abstract data and enter data into the transplant database.

* Maintain valid licensure and required certificates (Registered Nurse, Registered Respiratory Therapist or Emergency Medical Technician – Paramedic).

Minimum qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:

* Bachelor’s Degree in a science-related field OR a degree/diploma from an accredited Nursing School, Respiratory Therapy Program or Paramedic Program

* One year of experience as an organ procurement coordinator OR clinical experience in critical care or in the field of organ procurement/transplant

* Maintain valid licenses and required certificates (Registered Nurse, Respiratory Therapist or Emergency Medical Technician – Paramedic)

Preferred qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:

* Certified Procurement Transplant Coordinator (CPTC) by the American Board for Transplant Certification (ABTC)
* Previous transplant or organ procurement experience

* Related healthcare experience, UNOS/UNET experience and knowledge

**Physical Requirements:**

* Clinical, Exposure to Risk. Ability to be available 24 hours a day when assigned.

**Personal Protective Equipment:**

* Follows standard precautions using personal protective equipment as required.

**Pay Range**

Minimum Annual Salary: $57,510.00

Maximum Annual Salary: $87,697.50

The pay range displayed on this job posting reflects the anticipated range for new hires. A successful candidate’s actual compensation will be determined after taking factors into consideration such as the candidate’s work history, experience, skill set and education. The pay range displayed does not include any applicable pay practices (e.g., shift differentials, overtime, etc.). **Company Description**

Aspen One renews the mind, body, and spirit with a portfolio that redefines luxury, adventure, and leisure. With world-class and innovative brands and businesses, including Aspen Skiing Company, Aspen Hospitality, and Aspen Ventures, Aspen One propels the expansion of the Aspen ethos globally.

Whether it's Aspen Skiing Company providing unforgettable experiences at the confluence of nature, culture, and recreation across its four legendary mountains—Aspen Mountain, Snowmass, Aspen Highlands, and Buttermilk; or Aspen Hospitality elevating guest experiences in unforgettable ways by developing, owning, and operating a growing set of luxury and upper-scale hotels, private clubs, and branded residential properties in prime locations under The Nell and Limelight brands; Aspen One is deeply committed to providing unparalleled service, creative programming, community engagement, and unique opportunities for exploration. The company’s commitment to innovation is central to its evolution, including Aspen Ventures' amplification of the Aspen brand globally through new business lines that embody its values and heritage such as Aspen Collection.

For more than 75 years, the Aspen brand and community has pointed its compass toward new paths, people, and possibilities—and today, as Aspen One, the future is limitless. The company is a leader in sustainability and advocacy, with a legacy of modeling leading-edge solutions and changing policy locally and globally. As a collection of brands driven by tightly held core values, Aspen One aims to inspire a better world. For more information, visit www.aspen.com.

Please note that all official communications from the Talent Acquisition or Human Resources team are sent from email addresses within the notifications@smartrecruiters.com, aspen.com, aspensnowmass.com, aspenhospitality.co, limelighthotels.com & thelittlenell.com domains.

**Job Description**

**Position Summary**

The Procurement Coordinator supports purchasing operations for both the ski resort and hotel divisions by ensuring timely, cost‑effective sourcing of goods, supplies, and services. Working within the Coupa, this role manages purchase orders, vendor communication, and inventory tracking to keep operational departments stocked and functioning smoothly. The Procurement Coordinator helps maintain high service standards by coordinating purchasing workflows that meet the unique needs of mountain operations and hospitality environments. This position reports to the Senior Director of Procurement.

The hourly pay range for this position is $24.50-29.00. Actual pay will be dependent on budget and experience.

**Job Posting Deadline**

Applications for this position will be accepted until October 19, 2026.

**Essential Job Functions/Key Job Responsibilities**

* Process purchase requests and generate purchase orders in accordance with company policies and spending guidelines
* Coordinate with department leaders across resort and hotel operations to identify purchasing needs and timelines
* Communicate with vendors to obtain quotes, confirm pricing, track shipments, and resolve delivery issues
* Maintain accurate purchasing records, documentation, and data entry within procurement systems
* Monitor inventory levels and assist with stock replenishment for key operational categories such as F&B, housekeeping, retail, and mountain supplies
* Support vendor onboarding, ensuring proper completion of agreements, compliance documents, and account setup
* Assist in negotiating pricing, order quantities, and delivery schedules under the guidance of procurement leadership
* Verify receipts of goods and review invoices for accuracy before submitting for payment processing
* Help coordinate seasonal ordering cycles
* Prepare purchasing reports and updates to support forecasting, budgeting, and departmental planning
* Maintain positive working relationships with internal teams, external vendors, and logistics partners
* Identify opportunities to streamline purchasing workflows and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency
* Performs other related tasks as assigned

**Qualifications**

**Education & Experience Requirements**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, or Hospitality preferred
* 1–2 years of purchasing, inventory management, administrative support, or hospitality operations experience
* 1+ years of experience using Coupa strongly preferred
* Experience working in resort, hotel, or multi‑department operational environments preferred

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Understanding of supply chain and inventory management systems
* Strong communication skills, using various channels (oral, written, presentations) to various internal and external audiences
* Ability to collaborate with internal and external groups and individuals effectively
* Proficient computer skills including working knowledge of Coupa and Microsoft Sui

**The Mission**
To communicate and assist with Procurement Director, Field Department, and outside growers/suppliers/drivers to deliver high quality raw materials to the Stahlbush processing plant. This role covers the documentation, planning, and coordination required to deliver materials in compliance with sustainable, organic, GAP, FSMA, SQF, DOT, and any other required 3rd party audit or process.
**Reporting Relationships**
This position will report directly to the Director of Procurement. The employee will work closely with multiple departments throughout the company along with outside growers/suppliers/contractors.
**Outcomes**

* Proactively resolve any issues related to raw product quality or delivery in a thorough and timely manner.
* Conduct internal audits of documentation to ensure compliance with third-party certification standards.
* Complete weight sheets for received products, ensuring all data aligns with traceability standards and providing accurate reports to Accounts Payable.
* Work with Procurement team to create and negotiate contracts with outside suppliers and growers to secure raw materials.
* Become an expert in our internal Transportation Management System (LOADS) to assist in transportation responsibilities, including creating, editing, and checking in shipments.
* Request freight quotes and issue Purchase Orders (POs) for inbound raw materials using the SIFI LOADS program and schedule shipments with vendors.
* Coordinate outside contract drivers and brokers to facilitate harvested crops for delivery to the processing plant.
* Assist the Field Department in pulling crop, soil, and moisture samples from the field.
* Assist in the maintenance and updating of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and specifications for raw products.
* Assist in DMV and DOT related tasks, including vehicle registrations, insurance cards, and overweight/over-width permits.
* Support and optimize Stahlbush sustainability initiatives to align with company mission statement.
* This position has been identified as holding responsibility for food safety and quality of the company. This responsibility extends over all shifts.
* During the absence, the following position serves as coverage to this position: Director of Procurement.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Agriculture, or related field preferred
* Passion to pursue a career in the agricultural, supply chain, or food production industry
* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills
* Proficient in Microsoft Office programs including Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Word
* Ability and willingness to work independently and improve processes
* Proficiency in procurement processes, vendor negotiations, and contract management
* Basic understanding of farming practices and the nature of the industry
* Willingness to learn current market pricing, food safety, and agriculture certifications.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Working Conditions**
General office environment with minimal physical effort. Requires sitting at a desk for majority of workday, but when needed, there will be periods of time work is performed outside.

**The Mission**  
To communicate and assist with Procurement Director, Field Department, and outside growers/suppliers/drivers to deliver high quality raw materials to the Stahlbush processing plant. This role covers the documentation, planning, and coordination required to deliver materials in compliance with sustainable, organic, GAP, FSMA, SQF, DOT, and any other required 3rd party audit or process.  
**Reporting Relationships**  
This position will report directly to the Director of Procurement. The employee will work closely with multiple departments throughout the company along with outside growers/suppliers/contractors.  
**Outcomes**

* Proactively resolve any issues related to raw product quality or delivery in a thorough and timely manner.
* Conduct internal audits of documentation to ensure compliance with third-party certification standards.
* Complete weight sheets for received products, ensuring all data aligns with traceability standards and providing accurate reports to Accounts Payable.
* Work with Procurement team to create and negotiate contracts with outside suppliers and growers to secure raw materials.
* Become an expert in our internal Transportation Management System (LOADS) to assist in transportation responsibilities, including creating, editing, and checking in shipments.
* Request freight quotes and issue Purchase Orders (POs) for inbound raw materials using the SIFI LOADS program and schedule shipments with vendors.
* Coordinate outside contract drivers and brokers to facilitate harvested crops for delivery to the processing plant.
* Assist the Field Department in pulling crop, soil, and moisture samples from the field.
* Assist in the maintenance and updating of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and specifications for raw products.
* Assist in DMV and DOT related tasks, including vehicle registrations, insurance cards, and overweight/over-width permits.
* Support and optimize Stahlbush sustainability initiatives to align with company mission statement.
* This position has been identified as holding responsibility for food safety and quality of the company. This responsibility extends over all shifts.
* During the absence, the following position serves as coverage to this position: Director of Procurement.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Agriculture, or related field preferred
* Passion to pursue a career in the agricultural, supply chain, or food production industry
* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills
* Proficient in Microsoft Office programs including Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Word
* Ability and willingness to work independently and improve processes
* Proficiency in procurement processes, vendor negotiations, and contract management
* Basic understanding of farming practices and the nature of the industry
* Willingness to learn current market pricing, food safety, and agriculture certifications.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Working Conditions**  
General office environment with minimal physical effort. Requires sitting at a desk for majority of workday, but when needed, there will be periods of time work is performed outside.

The statements made in any and all of the position postings are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed, as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.

**Job Title:** Procurement Coordinator

**Location:** Richmond or Staunton, VA

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Travel:** 5%–25%, domestic and international

**Compensation:** $75,000–$90,000 annually

**Benefits:** Medical, Dental, Vision, HSA with employer contributions, employer-paid Life/AD&D, employer-paid Short-Term Disability, and voluntary supplemental insurance options

**Job Summary**

Our client is seeking an experienced Procurement Coordinator to support and manage purchasing, sourcing, logistics, inventory, and supplier performance. This role is responsible for developing and maintaining effective supply chain processes that improve operational efficiency, control costs, maintain appropriate inventory levels, and support reliable product availability.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in purchasing and supply chain operations, including international sourcing, importing, supplier management, contracting, lean processes, and continuous improvement.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Review and update supply chain policies and procedures to comply with new or changing environmental policies, standards, regulations, and laws, including Proposition 65 and other location-specific requirements.
* Maximize inventory and working capital turns by developing suppliers with shorter delivery cycles, improved reliability, and smaller order quantities while maintaining appropriate safety stock levels and avoiding stockouts.
* Manage supplier quality and performance issues through the Supplier Corrective Action process.
* Maintain documentation and records of supplier issues, resolutions, corrective actions, and related communications.
* Participate in the customer complaint review process and remain informed of relevant customer complaints.
* Develop procedures to effectively coordinate supply chain activities with sales, marketing, finance, production, quality assurance, and other functional areas.
* Design and implement supply chain strategies that support overall business objectives.
* Adapt supply chain strategies in response to changing market conditions, new business opportunities, and cost-reduction initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve supplier performance, operational efficiency, and overall supply chain effectiveness.
* Support company objectives and demonstrate a strong commitment to continuous improvement.
* Model and uphold company values in daily responsibilities and interactions.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in purchasing, supply chain management, and logistics.
* Extensive experience with international supply chain management, importing, and global sourcing.
* Strong understanding of lean and continuous improvement principles.
* Demonstrated experience developing and implementing lean business processes within an international supply base.
* Thorough understanding of legal contracting and supplier agreements.
* Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills.
* Proven ability to develop and maintain positive working relationships with vendors, suppliers, shippers, customers, and internal stakeholders.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong financial analysis skills and a goal-oriented approach.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.
* Valid driver’s license.
* Valid U.S. passport.
* Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally approximately 5%–25% of the time.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated success improving inventory turns, supplier lead times, reliability, and purchasing efficiency.
* Experience managing supplier corrective actions and supplier quality issues.
* Experience working with environmental and product compliance requirements, including Proposition 65.
* Experience collaborating across sales, marketing, finance, production, and quality assurance functions.

**Work Environment / Schedule**

* Position is based in Richmond or Staunton, VA.
* May require extended periods of sitting at a desk, typing, and standing.
* Must be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-stress environment.
* May periodically work in construction or warehouse environments.
* Must be able to lift up to 25 pounds.
* Must adhere to the our clients Health & Safety Manual.
* Attendance at company safety meetings and participation in safety drills are required.
* Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn when applicable.
* Domestic and international travel may account for approximately 5%–25% of the role.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Annual salary range of $75,000–$90,000.
* Multiple Aetna medical plan options, including HSA-eligible plans.
* Dental coverage through Aetna.
* Voluntary vision coverage through Guardian.

Summary

As a Build to Rent (“BTR”) Purchasing Coordinator working for Taylor Morrison you will be responsible for generating purchase orders, job starts, administration of variance purchase orders, and various other administrative duties.

**Job Details**

**What You’ll Do**

We trust that as a BTR Purchasing Coordinator you will:

* Build purchasing data in Newstar Enterprise for all building plans
* Maintain takeoffs, costs, and budgets as needed for the Construction and Finance Departments
* Review takeoffs, costs, and budgets on every building prior to construction start to ensure accuracy and generate purchase orders for start package
* Review, process, and analyze variance purchase orders from Construction Managers and Purchasing Agents
* Analyze and reduce budget to actual costs on every building at time of service
* Assist agents with bidding and takeoffs when needed for special projects
* Coordinate with Homebuilding Divisions to confirm similar pricing structures
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Sound Like You?**

You might be just who we’re looking for if you have…

* 1-3 years’ experience in a similar position within a fast-paced office environment preferred
* Understanding of Multi-Family or Homebuilding process (parts, model subcontracts, etc.) preferred
* High School Diploma required
* Proficient in Excel required
* Must be highly organized and detail oriented
* Must be a team player with a strong sense of urgency and strong communication skills
* Must have the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines
* Newstar experience is a plus

**FLSA Status: Non-Exempt**

This position is considered a non-exempt position for purposes of wage-hour law, which means that you will be required to keep a time record and will be eligible for overtime pay.

**Essential Functions:**

Successful job applicants will be able to perform these functions. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Report to Division/Corporate Office/Community daily and adhere to schedule
* Ability to access, input, and retrieve information from a computer and/or electronic device
* Ability to have face to face conversations with customers, co-workers, and management
* Ability to sit or stand for long periods of time and move around work environment as needed
* Comply with company policies and procedure

**Physical Demands:**

* Must be able to able to remain in a stationary position up to 50% of the time
* The ability to frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds

* **Taylor Morrison experience and/or successful completion of training program may override required education and/or experience requirement.**

### **Job descriptions are not intended as, nor should be construed to be, exhaustive lists of all responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with a job. They are intended to be accurate reflections of those principal job duties and responsibilities essential for making fair pay decisions about the job.**

### **Taylor Morrison is an equal opportunity employer. Taylor Morrison does not discriminate against any candidate or employee based on race, national origin, sex, marital status, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion or veteran status.**

**Benefits of Working With Taylor Morrison**

We are looking for dedicated professionals that share our values of putting the customer - and their needs - first. In addition to a great team atmosphere, career development and advancement opportunities, we offer full-time employees an extensive benefits package, to include:

* Competitive Compensation
* Health Care - Medical/Dental/Vision/Prescription Drug Coverage
* 401(k) with Company Matching Contributions
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Disability Programs
* Employee & Dependent Life Insurance
* Vacation & Company Holidays
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Employee Home Purchase Rebate Program
* Home Mortgage Program
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

description:
Brand Overview:

Gilmore Heating, Air, & Plumbing has been serving Sacramento families since 1979. With multiple industry awards and a reputation for customer care, Gilmore has grown into one of Northern California’s most respected home service providers. Now part of TurnPoint Services, Gilmore employees benefit from advanced training, mentorship, and opportunities to grow across 62 brands nationwide. At Gilmore, excellence and innovation go hand in hand with career growth. Build your future with Gilmore HAP — where California service excellence builds lasting careers.

Role Overview:

**Position Summary**

The Purchasing Coordinator is responsible for the procurement of materials, equipment, and supplies necessary to support HVAC and plumbing operations. This role ensures that technicians and installers have the materials needed to complete jobs efficiently while maintaining inventory accuracy, controlling costs, and fostering strong relationships with vendors and suppliers.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Purchase HVAC, plumbing, and related materials, equipment, and supplies in a timely manner.
* Monitor inventory levels and reorder stock to prevent shortages and delays.
* Coordinate with service, installation, and warehouse teams to ensure materials are available for scheduled jobs.
* Obtain pricing, negotiate costs, and maintain favorable vendor relationships.
* Process purchase orders and ensure accurate documentation of all purchases.
* Track orders from placement through delivery and resolve any shipping or delivery issues.
* Maintain accurate inventory records and conduct periodic inventory audits.
* Research alternative suppliers and products to improve quality, availability, and cost savings.
* Review vendor invoices and reconcile discrepancies with purchase orders and receipts.
* Monitor warranty claims and manufacturer credits to ensure reimbursement opportunities are captured.
* Assist with fleet, warehouse, and operational supply purchasing as needed.

Fisher Industries is a vertically integrated family of businesses that provides heavy civil construction and aggregate products across the United States. With over 70 years of experience, the company specializes in highways, bridges, aggregates, and large-scale infrastructure projects, supported by in-house capabilities in drilling, blasting, crushing, asphalt, and concrete production. Fisher is committed to delivering innovative, cost-effective solutions with an emphasis on safety and quality. As a proven industry leader, Fisher Industries continues to grow while maintaining the integrity and values of a family-owned company. For additional information about our company, visit our website at www.fisherind.com

**POSITION SCOPE**

The **Parts & Procurement Coordinator** serves as the central communication and coordination hub between Field Operations, Procurement, Warehouse personnel, vendors, and management. This role is responsible for managing procurement request intake, tracking request status, prioritizing operational needs, maintaining procurement records, and ensuring timely communication throughout the purchasing process. By centralizing request management and status reporting, this position allows Procurement Specialists to focus on sourcing, purchasing, vendor management, and expediting activities that support critical construction, aggregate, and equipment operations.

**PRIMARY DUTIES**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for incoming parts, material, and procurement requests from field personnel, supervisors, project managers, mechanics, and operational teams.
* Manage a high volume of incoming communications and procurement-related requests daily.
* Create, document, and maintain procurement requests and work orders within department tracking systems and dashboards.
* Capture and verify required request details including equipment numbers, project information, quantities, priorities, delivery locations, and required completion dates.
* Review requests for accuracy and completeness and route them to the appropriate Procurement Specialist based on business segment, equipment type, or operational need.
* Prioritize requests based on equipment downtime, project schedules, operational urgency, and management direction.
* Maintain current status information for active procurement requests and provide updates to requesting departments.
* Communicate estimated delivery dates, shipment tracking information, backorders, delays, substitutions, and order status updates.
* Escalate urgent, delayed, or stalled requests to Procurement Specialists or department leadership as necessary.
* Track procurement requests from initial intake through completion and verify accurate closeout documentation.
* Coordinate parts and material pickups, transfers, and deliveries with warehouse personnel, drivers, and field teams.
* Maintain organized records including quotes, purchase orders, invoices, tracking information, vendor communications, and procurement documentation.
* Maintain current vendor and supplier contact information and identify potential duplicate requests or communication gaps.
* Document emergency purchases and after-hours procurement activity.
* Prepare and distribute procurement status reports for department leadership and operational stakeholders.
* Assist Procurement Specialists with administrative and reporting responsibilities during periods of high purchasing volume.
* Maintain effective communication between Field Operations, Procurement, Warehouse personnel, and delivery teams.
* Promote safety, efficiency, and teamwork across all business operations.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* High school diploma or GED required; associate degree in business, supply chain, logistics, or related field preferred.
* Previous experience in procurement coordination, purchasing support, parts administration, inventory control, construction operations, fleet maintenance, or related field preferred.
* Strong organizational, multitasking, and time-management skills.
* Ability to prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Outlook, and Teams.
* Experience with purchasing, inventory, ERP, fleet management, or work-order tracking systems preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work effectively with personnel at all organizational levels, vendors, and external partners.
* Knowledge of heavy equipment, construction, aggregate production, trucking, or fleet operations preferred.

Fisher Industries is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are a drug-free work environment requiring pre-employment and random drug testing.

If you require an accommodation with applying, please email hrdept@fisherind.com or call the HR Department at (701) 456-9184 to request accommodations. This email is only to request accommodation for

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive **Purchasing Coordinator** to join our growing team. This role is responsible for managing the purchasing process from order placement through fulfillment, building strong vendor relationships, negotiating competitive pricing, and ensuring timely delivery of products. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys problem-solving, and excels at coordinating with suppliers, customers, and internal teams.

If you are highly organized, customer-focused, and enjoy working with vendors and sales teams to keep operations running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.

* Create, process, and manage purchase orders with suppliers, vendors, and manufacturers.
* Coordinate product procurement and fulfillment to ensure accurate and timely delivery.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, and delivery schedules with suppliers to maximize value and cost savings.
* Maintain strong relationships with vendors and manufacturers while monitoring supplier performance.
* Track and follow up on order status, shipments, backorders, and delivery schedules.
* Process and distribute purchase orders, invoices, and related purchasing documentation.
* Review and analyze purchasing reports and ad hoc data to support business decisions.
* Ensure customer requirements are accurately communicated and executed, including:
+ Product specifications and configurations
+ Quantity increases or decreases
+ Split shipments and multiple orders
+ Special customer requirements
+ Multiple shipping locations
* Serve as a liaison between suppliers, customers, sales teams, and internal departments regarding order status, updates, delays, and fulfillment issues.
* Resolve purchasing and fulfillment discrepancies while maintaining a high level of customer service.
* Maintain accurate records and data within company systems and purchasing platforms.

**Qualifications Required:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel and Word.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer service and relationship-building abilities.
* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

* Experience in purchasing, procurement, order management, supply chain, inside sales support, or related roles.
* Knowledge of IT, technology, or Audio Visual (AV) products and solutions.

* A sense of urgency and ownership.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
* A customer-first mindset.
* The ability to build productive relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* A commitment to accuracy, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

* Competitive salary

* Additional company perks

At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

**JOB SUMMARY**
---------------

As a Procurement Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting procurement operations and cross-functional business activities to ensure materials, services, and resources are available when and where they are needed. This position provides administrative and operational support to the Procurement team while partnering with multiple departments to drive efficient purchasing processes, inventory accuracy, equipment maintenance coordination, facility initiatives, and operational continuity.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------------------

* Support procurement activities by preparing and issuing Requests for Quotation (RFQs) and organizing supplier quotations for review and analysis.
* Assist procurement team members with purchasing activities to support customer sales, repair, and operational requirements.
* Create, process, and maintain purchase orders for direct materials, indirect materials, tooling, maintenance, repair services, and other business needs.
* Support Bill of Materials (BOM) purchasing activities to ensure timely availability of required components.
* Maintain inventory-related data and assist with inventory management initiatives to support operational objectives.
* Provide administrative and transactional support to Procurement Buyers, including data entry, supplier information maintenance, pricing updates, virtual inventory management, and system record accuracy.
* Coordinate equipment and machine maintenance service requests in partnership with production leadership and service providers.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders across manufacturing, operations, facilities, shipping and receiving, and other functional teams to support business initiatives and continuous improvement projects.
* Assist in the planning and coordination of company events and facility-related improvement activities.
* Provide backup support for shipping and receiving operations, as required.
* Gather and analyze information to support procurement decisions, recommendations, and special projects.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, procurement procedures, quality standards, and applicable business requirements.
Participate in continuous improvement activities that enhance efficiency, service levels, and operational effectiveness.

**JOB QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to analyze information, exercise sound judgment, and make recommendations based on available data.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build effective working relationships across all levels of the organization.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Customer-focused mindset with the ability to provide responsive support to internal stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Ability to work independently while contributing as an engaged team member.
* Solutions-oriented approach with a willingness to learn and continuously improve.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and adapt to changing business needs.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Experience with ERP systems and account management databases preferred; Epicor experience is a plus.

### **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Associate degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related field preferred.
* Previous experience in purchasing, procurement, inventory management, customer service, or administrative support preferred.
Manufacturing environment experience is a plus.

**BENEFITS WITH JABIL**
-----------------------

Along with growth, stability, and the opportunity to be challenged, Jabil offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

* Medical, Dental, Prescription Drug, and Vision Insurance with HRA and HSA options
* 401(k) Match
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance
* Commuter Benefits
* Employee Assistance Program
* Pet Insurance
* Adoption Assistance
* Annual Merit Increases
* Community Volunteer Opportunities

**Role Description**: Entry Level Purchasing Assistant

**Company Background**

Denier Electric is a family-owned business with a rich history that goes back over 8 decades. The business started as a small electrical contractor business in 1942 and has grown into a multi-division business capable of meeting the needs of just about any construction project. We are a regional leader amongst our peers specializing in commercial, mission critical, multi-family housing, healthcare, institutional and specialty electrical projects.

Denier is seeking eager, hardworking individuals to join our team. If you have a dedicated work ethic and enjoy working in a safety-focused, productive team environment this job is for you.

**Opportunity**

Denier is looking to expand our Purchasing team with an entry level Purchasing Agent. Experience in the electrical distribution or contracting business is preferred but not required.

**Job Responsibilities & Requirements**

* Solicit quotes for product/material needed
* Issue and process purchase orders for product/material
* Data entry, monitoring, and tracking of purchase orders, including back orders
* Inspect product/material in the warehouse
* Infrequent light warehouse duties
* Basic computer skills using Microsoft Word and Excel

**Skills**

* Ability to work well with others in a team oriented environment
* Self-motivated with a willingness to learn
* Punctual

**What We Offer**

* Competitive Pay
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* 401K with a Company match
* A fully paid medical plan.
* Dental and vision insurance available
* Provided Short-Term Disability
* Long-Term Disability available
* Provided Basic Life Insurance
* Supplemental Life Insurance available

Visit our website at www.denier.com to learn more about us and email your resume to our Human Resources Department at HR@denier.com.

Job Type: Full-time

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
